title: Repurposing adult AI radiograph models for neonatal care through continual learning: an international multicentre study
zh_title: 成人胸片AI模型经持续学习适配新生儿：国际多中心研究
summary: 一项覆盖20个国家地区、30个新生儿ICU的国际回顾性研究，评估持续学习作为隐私保护方法，将成人气管插管评估模型适配至新生儿胸片。
key_points: 30个新生儿ICU、20个国家地区的国际回顾性研究
持续学习为不共享数据的模型适配方式
不足两成商用影像模型获准用于儿科
reason: 跨20国30个NICU的多中心外部验证，属重要档
abstract: Continual learning, a privacy-preserving approach, was shown to be effective in addressing a critical gap in paediatric AI by adapting a deep learning model for adult endotracheal tube assessment to neonatal care. Despite growing clinical adoption of artificial intelligence in radiology, fewer than one in five commercially available models are cleared for paediatric use. Existing systems are trained predominantly on adult data and generalize poorly to neonates, yet efficient strategies for repurposing them without data sharing or large-scale local data curation are lacking. Here we present an international retrospective study of neonatal chest radiographs from 30 neonatal intensive care units across 20 countries and territories, evaluating continual learning as a privacy-preserving approach to adapt a deep learning model for adult endotracheal tube assessment to neonatal care. Each hospital contributed 50 radiographs for sequential model retraining without centralized data pooling. Continual learning achieved lower anatomical landmark localization error (0.67 cm versus 1.29 cm for hospital-specific fine-tuning and 4.30 cm for adult-only models) at 29 of 30 sites, with improved detection of deep intubations at 27 of 30 sites. These findings demonstrate that privacy-preserving collaborative learning can address critical gaps in paediatric AI deployment.
zh_abstract: 持续学习（continual learning）是一种隐私保护方法，已被证明能有效弥补儿科人工智能（AI）中的关键空白，其做法是将用于成人气管插管评估的深度学习模型适配到新生儿护理。尽管人工智能在放射学中的临床采用日益增长，但只有不到五分之一的市售模型获准用于儿科。现有系统主要基于成人数据训练，对新生儿的泛化能力很差，而目前缺乏在不共享数据或不大规模本地数据整理的情况下将其再利用的高效策略。此处我们介绍一项国际回顾性研究，纳入来自20个国家和地区、30个新生儿重症监护病房的新生儿胸部X线片，评估持续学习作为一种隐私保护方法，将用于成人气管插管评估的深度学习模型适配到新生儿护理。每家医院贡献50张X线片用于序贯模型再训练，而不进行集中式数据汇集。持续学习在30个中心中的29个实现了更低的解剖标志定位误差（0.67 cm，对比医院特定微调的1.29 cm和仅成人模型的4.30 cm），并在30个中心中的27个改善了深部插管的检测。这些发现表明，隐私保护协作学习可以解决儿科AI部署中的关键空白。

title: An artificial intelligence framework for end-to-end rare disease phenotyping from clinical notes using large language models
zh_title: RARE-PHENIX：LLM端到端罕见病表型提取框架
summary: 整合大模型表型抽取、HPO标准化与监督排序的端到端框架，用11家UDN中心数据训练并在外部真实病历验证。
key_points: 融合LLM抽取、HPO标准化与监督排序
2671例、11家Undiagnosed Diseases Network中心训练
外部队列16,357份病历、143例验证
reason: 多中心训练并做独立机构外部验证，属重要档
abstract: Phenotyping is fundamental to rare disease diagnosis, but manually curating structured phenotypes from clinical notes is labor intensive and difficult to scale. Existing artificial intelligence (AI) approaches optimize individual components of phenotyping but generally do not operationalize the full workflow of extracting features from clinical text, standardizing them to Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) terms, and prioritizing rare disease-relevant HPO terms. We developed RARE-PHENIX, an end-to-end AI framework for rare disease phenotyping that integrates large language model-based phenotype extraction, ontology-grounded standardization to HPO terms, and supervised ranking of HPO terms. We trained RARE-PHENIX using data from 2671 patients across 11 Undiagnosed Diseases Network clinical sites, and externally validated it on 16,357 real-world clinical notes from 143 patients at Vanderbilt University Medical Center. Our findings suggest RARE-PHENIX generates structured, prioritized HPO terms highly concordant with clinician curation, demonstrates potential downstream disease-prioritization signal, and may support human-in-the-loop rare disease phenotyping in real-world settings.
zh_abstract: 表型分型是罕见病诊断的基础，但从临床笔记中人工整理结构化表型费力且难以扩展。现有的人工智能（AI）方法优化表型分型的各个组成部分，但通常未将完整工作流付诸实施，即从临床文本中提取特征、将其标准化为人类表型本体（HPO）术语，并对罕见病相关 HPO 术语进行优先级排序。我们开发了 RARE-PHENIX，一个用于罕见病表型分型的端到端 AI 框架，整合了基于大语言模型的表型提取、基于本体的 HPO 术语标准化以及对 HPO 术语的监督排序。我们使用来自 11 个未诊断疾病网络（Undiagnosed Diseases Network）临床中心的 2671 名患者数据训练 RARE-PHENIX，并在范德堡大学医学中心（Vanderbilt University Medical Center）143 名患者的 16,357 份真实世界临床笔记上进行外部验证。我们的发现表明，RARE-PHENIX 生成的结构化、优先排序的 HPO 术语与临床医生整理高度一致，展示出潜在的下游疾病优先级排序信号，并可能支持真实世界环境中人在回路（human-in-the-loop）的罕见病表型分型。

title: Artificial intelligence-enabled clinical phenotyping of human brown fat.
zh_title: 人工智能实现人棕色脂肪临床表型分析
summary: Nature研究用大数据与机器学习在101,243例患者中量化棕色脂肪活性，发现其与心血管及精神疾病患病率较低相关。
key_points: 基于大型癌症中心101,243例患者队列
机器学习半自动量化约8,700例患者的棕色脂肪活性
分析显示有棕色脂肪者心血管与精神疾病患病率更低
reason: 同行评审、十万例级大队列并有客观量化表型，属重要档
abstract: [Nature] Adipose tissue has a central role in systemic energy balance and the pathogenesis of obesity and its sequelae1,2. In contrast to white adipose tissue, brown adipose tissue (BAT) uses energy to produce heat3. Detectable BAT in humans is associated with decreased prevalence of cardiometabolic diseases4. However, the complete spectrum of health conditions associated with BAT remains unknown, and high-throughput methods to quantify BAT activity in humans are lacking5,6. Here we leveraged big data and artificial intelligence to systematically define the clinical impact of BAT in a cohort of 101,243 patients from a large cancer centre. Our unbiased analyses revealed that, across all diagnoses, cardiovascular and psychiatric diseases were less prevalent in people with BAT. Using a machine learning approach, we semi-automatically quantified BAT activity in approximately 8,700 patients and demonstrated that higher BAT activity, especially in the axillary depot, is associated with lower odds of cardiometabolic diseases and healthier white fat distribution. People with BAT also exhibited more favourable glycaemic parameters, lipid profiles, inflammatory markers and echocardiographic indices. Analysis of medication usage demonstrated that angiotensin receptor blocker use was positively associated with BAT presence. As proof of concept, we showed that the angiotensin receptor blocker losartan increased brown adipocyte activity and whole-body energy expenditure. Altogether, our studies harnessing artificial intelligence and big data identify new clinical phenotypes linked to BAT and serve as a platform for drug repurposing to activate this tissue in humans.
zh_abstract: 《自然》脂肪组织在全身能量平衡以及肥胖及其后遗症的发病机制中具有核心作用1,2。与白色脂肪组织相比，棕色脂肪组织（BAT）利用能量产热3。在人类中可检测到的 BAT 与心血管代谢疾病患病率降低相关4。然而，与 BAT 相关的完整健康状况谱仍未知，且缺乏高通量方法量化人类 BAT 活性5,6。在此，我们利用大数据和人工智能，在一个来自大型癌症中心的 101,243 名患者队列中系统定义 BAT 的临床影响。我们的无偏分析显示，在所有诊断中，心血管和精神疾病在具有 BAT 的人群中患病率较低。使用机器学习方法，我们半自动量化了约 8,700 名患者的 BAT 活性，并证明较高的 BAT 活性，尤其是在腋窝脂肪库，与心脏代谢疾病几率降低和更健康的白色脂肪分布相关。具有 BAT 的人也表现出更有利的血糖参数、血脂谱、炎症标志物和超声心动图指标。对药物使用的分析表明，血管紧张素受体阻滞剂使用与 BAT 存在正相关。作为概念验证，我们显示血管紧张素受体阻滞剂氯沙坦（losartan）增加了棕色脂肪细胞活性和全身能量消耗。总之，我们利用人工智能和大数据的研究识别了与 BAT 相关的新临床表型，并作为药物重定位平台，以在人类中激活该组织。

title: An all-in-one foundation model for multimodal medical image restoration and enhancement
zh_title: 全能医学图像恢复与增强基础模型AMIFound
summary: 研究提出AMIFound基础模型，覆盖CT、MRI、PET、内镜、超声、眼底与X线7种模态，在376万对图像上训练评估，性能超越38个基线。
key_points: 覆盖7种模态、7类退化模式
训练评估使用376万对高低质量图像
在图像质量指标上超越38个基线
reason: 多模态基础模型且训练数据规模大，属重要档
abstract: Medical image quality is essential for reliable clinical diagnosis and downstream artificial intelligence analysis, yet routine images are often degraded by noise, motion artefacts, low contrast, low-dose acquisition or modality-specific artefacts. Here we present AMIFound, an all-in-one foundation model for medical image enhancement and restoration across computed tomography, magnetic resonance imaging, positron emission tomography, endoscopy, ultrasound, fundus imaging and X-ray. AMIFound is trained and evaluated on 3.76 million paired high-quality and degraded images spanning 7 representative degradation patterns. A shared encoder captures modality and degradation cues, while a dynamically routed expert restoration pool adapts the enhancement pathway for each input. Across 7 modalities, AMIFound outperforms 38 task-specific and generalist baselines on full-reference image quality metrics, clinician assessment and robustness tests under combined degradations as well as on naturally degraded clinical images. Enhanced images further improve 44 disease detection tasks, tumour stage prediction and survival risk stratification in non-small-cell lung cancer, including improved individual-level prognostic ranking. These results support AMIFound as a domain-specific foundation model for improving low-quality clinical images and strengthening downstream medical artificial intelligence workflows while preserving clinically relevant information. Cao et al. present AMIFound, a foundation model that unifies medical image restoration across seven imaging modalities, delivering robust enhancement across diverse degradations and preserving clinically relevant information for diagnosis.
zh_abstract: 医学图像质量对于可靠的临床诊断和下游人工智能分析至关重要，然而常规图像常因噪声、运动伪影、低对比度、低剂量采集或模态特异性伪影而质量下降。此处我们介绍AMIFound，一种一体化基础模型，用于跨计算机断层扫描（CT）、磁共振成像（MRI）、正电子发射断层扫描（PET）、内窥镜、超声、眼底成像和X线的医学图像增强与恢复。AMIFound在376万对高质量与退化图像上进行训练和评估，涵盖7种代表性退化模式。共享编码器捕捉模态和退化线索，而动态路由的专家恢复池为每个输入调整增强路径。在7种模态中，AMIFound在全参考图像质量指标、临床医生评估以及组合退化下的鲁棒性测试中，以及在自然退化的临床图像上，均优于38个任务特定和通用基线。增强后的图像进一步改善了44项疾病检测任务、肿瘤分期预测和非小细胞肺癌的生存风险分层，包括改善了个体水平的预后排序。这些结果支持AMIFound作为一种领域特定基础模型，可改善低质量临床图像并加强下游医学人工智能工作流程，同时保留临床相关信息。Cao等人提出了AMIFound，一种统一了七种成像模态的医学图像恢复的基础模型，能在多种退化下提供稳健增强，并保留用于诊断的临床相关信息。

title: Interpretable AI model reveals spatial codes of cell recruitment in tissues
zh_title: 可解释 AI 模型 SPACER 解析组织细胞募集空间编码
summary: 可解释多实例学习框架 SPACER 直接从空间转录组数据解码基因水平细胞募集规则，在 37 个数据集上较现有方法提升 4–21 倍。
key_points: 多实例学习框架，可解释地解码基因级募集规则
覆盖 37 个空间转录组数据集与多种肿瘤
揭示黏蛋白屏障与免疫检查点抑制剂耐药相关
reason: 同行评审，37 个多来源数据集验证并给出预后相关生物学发现，属重要档
abstract: Understanding which molecular signals recruit specific cells to precise tissue locations is fundamental to tissue biology, immunity and disease. Existing computational tools for spatially resolved transcriptomics (SRT) describe where cells reside but cannot explain why. Here we introduce SPACER, a fully interpretable multi-instance learning framework that decodes gene-level recruitment rules directly from SRT data. Applied to 37 SRT datasets spanning multiple human tumour types and mouse heart, SPACER achieved 4–21-fold improvement over existing methods in various tasks of recovering biologically meaningful recruitment signals. SPACER revealed (1) that tumour-expressed mucins are associated with physical barriers to T cell engagement, which predicts resistance to immune checkpoint inhibitors and patient prognosis, (2) that local antigen presentation is the dominant correlate of T cell engagement across cancer types and (3) that Cd4^+ T cells are the dominant functional effectors in severe immune checkpoint inhibitor-induced myocarditis. These findings establish SPACER as a discovery engine for cellular recruitment biology with direct translational applications. A fully interpretable multi-instance learning framework, SPACER, helps elucidate which molecular signals recruit specific cells to their precise locations by decoding gene-level recruitment rules from spatially resolved transcriptomics data.
zh_abstract: 理解哪些分子信号将特定细胞募集到精确的组织位置，是组织生物学、免疫学和疾病的基础。现有的空间分辨转录组学（SRT）计算工具描述了细胞驻留在何处，但无法解释原因。在此，我们介绍SPACER，一种完全可解释的多实例学习框架，可直接从SRT数据中解码基因水平的募集规则。应用于涵盖多种人类肿瘤类型和小鼠心脏的37个SRT数据集，SPACER在恢复具有生物学意义的募集信号的各种任务中，相比现有方法实现了4–21倍的提升。SPACER揭示：(1) 肿瘤表达的黏蛋白与T细胞接合的物理屏障相关，这预测了对免疫检查点抑制剂的耐药性和患者预后；(2) 局部抗原呈递是跨癌种T细胞接合的主要相关因素；(3) Cd4^+ T细胞是严重免疫检查点抑制剂诱导的心肌炎中的主要功能性效应细胞。这些发现确立了SPACER作为细胞募集生物学的发现引擎，具有直接的转化应用。一个完全可解释的多实例学习框架SPACER，通过从空间分辨转录组学数据中解码基因水平募集规则，帮助阐明哪些分子信号将特定细胞募集到其精确位置。

title: A language model framework for sequence modeling of audit logs to characterize clinician-electronic health record interactions.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 用语言模型对EHR审计日志做序列建模
summary: JAMIA研究用超2.95亿条住院EHR审计日志微调Llama-3-8B，以动作预测检验临床医生工作流序列建模。
key_points: 使用2019–2024年超2.95亿条住院EHR审计日志
Llama-3-8B按符号与语义两种编码微调
以首序马尔可夫模型为基线，含时序外部测试集
reason: 超大规模日志加时序外部测试集评估，属重要档，但未报告临床结局
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Electronic health record (EHR) audit logs capture clinician-EHR interaction patterns, but most audit log research relies on aggregated measures (eg, total time). We investigated how audit logs could be modeled using large language model (LLM) architectures to learn underlying workflow sequences during clinician-EHR interactions. Using >295 million EHR-based audit log actions from inpatient settings spanning 2019 to 2024, we fine-tuned Llama-3-8B under 2 encodings: (1) symbolic (field-based) tokens and (2) semantic (word-based) natural language-based audit log action descriptions. A first-order Markov model, using only the immediate prior action, served as a baseline minimal context comparator. Model representation was assessed using next-action prediction accuracy in an early-period test set and 2 temporally distinct out-of-sample (OOS) periods. In the early-period test set, the word-based LLM achieved the highest accuracy (0.7473; 95% CI, 0.7468-0.7478) compared to the field-based LLM (0.3464; 95% CI, 0.3456-0.3472) and Markov baseline (0.4230; 95% CI, 0.4223-0.4236). The word-based approach retained a substantial performance advantage over the Markov baseline across the OOS periods, although accuracy declined over time (word-based LLM vs Markov accuracy, OOS-1: 0.6555 vs 0.3139, OOS-2: 0.6286 vs 0.2720). Word-based LLM relying on audit log action descriptions yielded the highest next-action prediction accuracy and demonstrated relative robustness to temporal drift, suggesting that longer sequential context and word-based action descriptions may improve audit log-based sequence modeling. These findings support the development of natural language-based LLM models for audit log research for task identification, workflow characterization, and safety-focused analyses of clinician-EHR interaction patterns.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 电子健康记录（EHR）审计日志捕获临床医生与EHR的交互模式，但大多数审计日志研究依赖聚合指标（例如总时间）。我们研究了如何使用大型语言模型（LLM）架构对审计日志建模，以学习临床医生与EHR交互期间的潜在工作流程序列。使用来自住院环境、横跨2019年至2024年的超过2.95亿条基于EHR的审计日志操作，我们在2种编码下微调Llama-3-8B：（1）符号（基于字段）标记和（2）语义（基于词）的自然语言审计日志操作描述。一个仅使用紧邻前一动作的一阶马尔可夫模型作为基线最小上下文比较器。模型表征使用早期测试集和2个时间上不同的样本外（OOS）时期中的下一动作预测准确率进行评估。在早期测试集中，基于词的LLM取得了最高准确率（0.7473；95% CI，0.7468-0.7478），相比之下基于字段的LLM（0.3464；95% CI，0.3456-0.3472）和马尔可夫基线（0.4230；95% CI，0.4223-0.4236）。基于词的方法在各个OOS时期均较马尔可夫基线保持显著性能优势，尽管准确率随时间下降（基于词的LLM vs 马尔可夫准确率，OOS-1：0.6555 vs 0.3139，OOS-2：0.6286 vs 0.2720）。依赖审计日志操作描述的基于词LLM产生最高的下一动作预测准确率，并表现出对时间漂移的相对稳健性，表明更长的序列上下文和基于词的动作描述可能改善基于审计日志的序列建模。这些发现支持开发基于自然语言的LLM模型，用于审计日志研究，以进行任务识别、工作流程表征以及针对临床医生-EHR交互模式的安全导向分析。

title: [Articles] Generalisability of an adult-trained AI model to paediatric coeliac disease diagnosis: a multicentre external validation study
zh_title: 成人训练AI模型用于儿童乳糜泻诊断的多中心外部验证
summary: 多中心外部验证显示，基于成人活检训练的AI模型可跨中心与扫描平台泛化至儿童乳糜泻诊断，校准良好的概率输出具临床可解释性。
key_points: 成人活检训练模型接受跨中心外部验证
覆盖不同中心与扫描平台
概率输出校准良好，可提示诊断信心
reason: 多中心外部验证并报告校准与临床可解释输出，属重要档
abstract: Our AI model, trained on adult biopsies, generalises to paediatric coeliac disease diagnosis across centres and scanner platforms. Well calibrated probability outputs provide clinically interpretable measures of diagnostic confidence and could support safe identification of coeliac disease-negative biopsies within defined thresholds. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of applying adult-derived AI models in paediatric populations and reinforce the importance of multi-site (D1 & D2) biopsy sampling.
zh_abstract: 我们的人工智能模型基于成人活检训练，可泛化至跨中心、跨扫描仪平台的儿童乳糜泻诊断。校准良好的概率输出提供了临床可解释的诊断置信度指标，并可在既定阈值内支持安全识别乳糜泻阴性活检。这些发现证明了将成人来源的人工智能模型应用于儿童人群的可行性，并强调了多部位（D1 和 D2）活检采样的重要性。

title: TrajOnco: a multi-agent framework for temporal reasoning over longitudinal EHR for multi-cancer early detection
_abs_err: page: no abstract in meta (3036 bytes, best 199 chars)
zh_title: TrajOnco：多智能体框架用于EHR多癌早筛
summary: 基于Truveta纵向电子病历，无需训练的多智能体大模型框架在15种癌症上预测1年诊断风险，AUROC 0.64–0.80。
key_points: 无需训练的多智能体链式架构，含长期记忆
15种癌症、匹配病例对照，预测1年风险
零样本AUROC 0.64–0.80，肺癌基准接近监督模型
reason: 大规模EHR多癌评估但无外部验证与临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Accurate estimation of cancer risk from longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) could support earlier detection and improved care, but modeling such complex patient trajectories remains challenging. We present TrajOnco, a training-free, multi-agent large language model (LLM) framework designed for scalable multi-cancer early detection. Using a chain-of-agents architecture with long-term memory, TrajOnco performs temporal reasoning over sequential clinical events to generate patient-level summaries, evidence-linked rationales, and predicted risk scores. We evaluated TrajOnco on de-identified Truveta EHR data across 15 cancer types using matched case-control cohorts, predicting risk of cancer diagnosis at 1 year. In zero-shot evaluation, TrajOnco achieved AUROCs of 0.64–0.80, performing comparably to supervised machine learning in a lung cancer benchmark while demonstrating better temporal reasoning than single-agent LLMs. The multi-agent design also enabled effective temporal reasoning with smaller-capacity models such as GPT-4.1-mini. The groundedness of TrajOnco’s output was supported by human evaluation. Furthermore, TrajOnco’s interpretable reasoning outputs can be aggregated to reveal population-level risk patterns that align with established clinical knowledge. These findings highlight the potential of multi-agent LLMs to execute interpretable temporal reasoning over longitudinal EHRs, advancing both scalable multi-cancer early detection and clinical insight generation.
zh_abstract: 从纵向电子健康记录（EHRs）中准确估计癌症风险可支持更早发现和改善照护，但对这种复杂患者轨迹进行建模仍具挑战性。我们提出了 TrajOnco，一个免训练、多智能体大语言模型（LLM）框架，旨在实现可扩展的多癌种早期检测。采用具有长期记忆的智能体链（chain-of-agents）架构，TrajOnco 对序贯临床事件进行时间推理，以生成患者层面的摘要、与证据关联的推理依据以及预测风险评分。我们在去标识化的 Truveta EHR 数据上，使用匹配病例-对照队列，跨 15 种癌症类型评估 TrajOnco，预测 1 年时癌症诊断的风险。在零样本评估中，TrajOnco 达到 0.64–0.80 的 AUROC，在肺癌基准中与监督机器学习表现相当，同时展现出优于单智能体 LLM 的时间推理能力。多智能体设计还使较小容量模型（如 GPT-4.1-mini）能够进行有效的时间推理。人工评估支持了 TrajOnco 输出的有据性。此外，TrajOnco 的可解释推理输出可被汇总，以揭示与既有临床知识一致的人群层面风险模式。这些发现凸显了多智能体 LLM 对纵向 EHRs 执行可解释时间推理的潜力，从而推进可扩展的多癌种早期检测和临床洞见生成。

title: Transparency features alone are insufficient for trust calibration in artificial intelligence diagnostic support.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 透明度功能不足以校准临床医生对AI诊断的信任
summary: 220名临床医生的随机对照实验显示，数字置信度分数或带引用的叙述性解释均未影响工具信任、整体信任或信息可信度评价，但任何AI辅助后信心均上升。
key_points: 随机对照实验，220名临床医生分三组
透明性对工具信任、整体信任均无显著影响

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Clinician trust in artificial intelligence (AI) is a frequently cited barrier to adoption, yet there is limited empirical evidence on how transparency features influence trust. This study aimed to address this evidence gap. We conducted a randomized controlled experiment in which 220 clinicians were randomized to 1 of 3 conditions: no transparency (control), numeric confidence scores, or narrative explanations with citations, using simulated AI diagnostic assistance across clinical case vignettes. Transparency did not influence tool-specific trust [F(2, 214) = 0.38, P = .68], global trust [F(2, 217) = 0.13, P = .88], or perceived information credibility [F(2, 210) = 0.42, P = .66]. Confidence increased following any AI assistance (+6.7%), but narrative explanations were associated with greater change in confidence compared with both control (P = .024) and numeric confidence (P = .0051). Participants changed or refined diagnoses after reviewing AI output 45.8% (SD 23.4%) of the time, with participants in the control group demonstrating higher levels of behavioral influence than transparency conditions (P = .0006). Trust, confidence, and behavioral influence represent distinct constructs and are impacted differently by transparency methods. The difference in these contributions to clinician-AI partnerships should be considered when designing for safe trust calibration, with particular consideration for the dissociation between trust and confidence. These findings suggest common interface transparency features alone failed to produce a detectable, meaningful shift in clinician trust in AI assistance and that changes may instead alter behavioral influence and confidence without a corresponding change in trust.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 临床医生对人工智能（AI）的信任是常被提及的采用障碍，但关于透明度特征如何影响信任的实证证据有限。本研究旨在填补这一证据空白。我们进行了一项随机对照实验，其中 220 名临床医生被随机分配到 3 种条件中的 1 种：无透明度（对照）、数字置信分数、或带引用的叙述性解释，在临床病例情景中使用模拟 AI 诊断辅助。透明度未影响工具特定信任 [F(2, 214) = 0.38, P = .68]、总体信任 [F(2, 217) = 0.13, P = .88] 或感知信息可信度 [F(2, 210) = 0.42, P = .66]。在任何 AI 辅助后置信度增加（+6.7%），但与对照（P = .024）和数字置信（P = .0051）相比，叙述性解释与更大的置信度变化相关。参与者在查看 AI 输出后 45.8%（SD 23.4%）的时间里改变或细化了诊断，其中对照组参与者表现出比透明度条件更高的行为影响水平（P = .0006）。信任、置信度和行为影响代表不同的构念，并受到透明度方法的不同影响。在设计安全信任校准时应考虑这些对临床医生-AI 伙伴关系的贡献差异，尤其要考虑信任与置信度之间的分离。这些发现表明，仅常见的界面透明度特征未能对临床医生对 AI 辅助的信任产生可检测的、有意义的转变，并且变化可能反而改变行为影响和置信度，而没有相应的信任变化。

source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging

summary: IEEE TMI论文提出含知识图谱推理的眼科视觉语言基础模型EyeGraph，并发布多粒度眼科VQA数据集IT-Retinal。

abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] The exponential growth of large vision-language models (VLMs) has created significant opportunities for advancing multimodal artificial intelligence in specialized domains such as ophthalmology. However, progress in ophthalmic VLMs remains limited, primarily due to the lack of large-scale, high-quality image-text pairs. Moreover, existing VLMs frequently generate hallucinations, leading to uncertainty and unreliability that are unacceptable in clinical practice. To address the data scarcity issue, we introduce IT-Retinal, a dedicated ophthalmic Vision Question Answering (VQA) dataset that providesmultigranularity tasks and high-quality long-form textual content in image-text pairs. To mitigate hallucinations, we propose EyeGraph, a framework for ophthalmic VLMs that consists of two training stages, targeted pre-training and fine-tuning, and one inference stage that integrates Graph of Thought (GoT) and Think on Graph (ToG) reasoning, referred to as G2T. This design enables EyeGraph to incorporate structured external knowledge, constrain the output space, and produce more clinically consistent results. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EyeGraph achieves state-of-the-art performance across seven clinically relevant benchmarks, spanning disease diagnosis, structural detection and localization, and report generation. Notably, the proposed G2T reasoning module consistently improves the factual consistency and reliability of ophthalmic report generation. All source code, along with an interactive demo, is publicly available at: https://github.com/ZardCAI/EyeGraph.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 大型视觉-语言模型（VLM）的指数级增长为在眼科等专业领域推进多模态人工智能创造了重大机遇。然而，眼科VLM的进展仍然有限，主要原因是缺乏大规模、高质量的图文对。此外，现有VLM经常产生幻觉，导致临床实践中不可接受的不确定性和不可靠性。为解决数据稀缺问题，我们引入IT-Retinal，一个专门的眼科视觉问答（VQA）数据集，在图文对中提供多粒度任务和高质量长文本内容。为减轻幻觉，我们提出EyeGraph，一个用于眼科VLM的框架，由两个训练阶段（定向预训练和微调）和一个推理阶段组成，该推理阶段整合思维图（Graph of Thought，GoT）和图上思考（Think on Graph，ToG）推理，称为G2T。该设计使EyeGraph能够纳入结构化外部知识、约束输出空间并产生更临床一致的结果。大量实验表明，EyeGraph在七个临床相关基准上达到最先进性能，涵盖疾病诊断、结构检测与定位以及报告生成。值得注意的是，所提出的G2T推理模块持续改善眼科报告生成的事实一致性和可靠性。所有源代码以及交互式演示已公开提供：https://github.com/ZardCAI/EyeGraph。

key_points: 训练数据为800034对心电图与报告

reason: 大样本(80万对)且含外部验证，属重要档
abstract: [Health information science and systems] Most artificial intelligence models for electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation rely on task-specific supervised learning, requiring dedicated labeled datasets for each diagnostic task and limiting scalability across diverse cardiac conditions. This study investigated whether vision-language learning from paired ECG recordings and summary reports could enable transferable ECG representations without task-specific supervised training. We developed ECG-VLM, a contrastive vision-language model consisting of a Transformer-based image encoder and a text encoder, trained on 800,034 paired 10-s ECG recordings and summary reports from the MIMIC-IV-ECG database. Cardiac condition detection was performed using natural-language prompts without condition-specific retraining or fine-tuning. Performance was evaluated on an internal test set and externally validated using the LSAS-ECG dataset (45,151 recordings) across 14 cardiac conditions, together with retrieval and subgroup analysis. ECG-VLM achieved diagnostic performance across 14 cardiac conditions, with AUROC ranging from 0.679 to 0.981 on the internal test set and from 0.691 to 0.991 on external validation. Performance was strongest for rhythm abnormalities (mean AUROC 0.948 internally and 0.921 externally) and lower for morphological conditions. Compared with the previously reported signal-based ECG-CLIP framework, ECG-VLM achieved comparable performance for rhythm abnormalities while improving AUPRC for several morphological conditions. Performance remained broadly consistent across external validation and demographic and clinical subgroups. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of vision-language supervision from paired ECG recordings and summary reports for learning transferable ECG representations without task-specific supervised training. This framework provides a basis for future extension of vision-language learning to ECG images encountered in routine clinical practice. The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s13755-026-00482-7.
zh_abstract: [Health information science and systems] 大多数用于心电图（ECG）解读的人工智能模型依赖于任务特定的监督学习，需要为每个诊断任务专门准备标注数据集，并限制了其在不同心脏状况中的可扩展性。本研究探讨了从配对的 ECG 记录和摘要报告中进行的视觉-语言学习是否能在没有任务特定监督训练的情况下实现可迁移的 ECG 表示。我们开发了 ECG-VLM，一种对比视觉-语言模型，由基于 Transformer 的图像编码器和文本编码器组成，在来自 MIMIC-IV-ECG 数据库的 800,034 对 10 秒 ECG 记录和摘要报告上进行训练。心脏状况检测使用自然语言提示进行，无需状况特定的重新训练或微调。性能在内部测试集上评估，并使用 LSAS-ECG 数据集（45,151 条记录）在 14 种心脏状况中进行外部验证，同时进行检索和亚组分析。ECG-VLM 在 14 种心脏状况中取得了诊断性能，内部测试集上 AUROC 范围为 0.679 至 0.981，外部验证上为 0.691 至 0.991。性能在节律异常方面最强（内部平均 AUROC 0.948，外部 0.921），在形态学状况方面较低。与先前报道的基于信号的 ECG-CLIP 框架相比，ECG-VLM 在节律异常方面取得相当的性能，同时改善了几种形态学状况的 AUPRC。性能在外部验证以及人口学和临床亚组中保持大致一致。这些发现证明了从配对的 ECG 记录和摘要报告中进行视觉-语言监督，以在没有任务特定监督训练的情况下学习可迁移 ECG 表示的可行性。该框架为未来将视觉-语言学习扩展到常规临床实践中遇到的 ECG 图像提供了基础。在线版本包含补充材料，可在 https://doi.org/10.1007/s13755-026-00482-7 获取。

abstract: Efficient operating room scheduling is a complex task due to the diversity of surgical types, high patient demand, and limited hospital resources. Since OR operations account for a substantial share of hospital costs, effective scheduling solutions are critical. Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems offer new opportunities to support optimization for this problem. This study evaluates an LLM-based multi-agent framework for generating and refining optimization code for OR scheduling. Leveraging iterative collaboration among specialized agents, the proposed iterative multi-agent (IMA) framework consistently outperformed both single-agent and traditional multi-agent baselines. Across 10 LLMs and 35 scenarios, IMA achieved an average feasible schedule rate of 82.91%, compared with 65.59% and 52.53% for the baselines. Experiments on 1050 synthetic cases and three real OR datasets further showed that IMA-generated code produced solutions close to those of expert-written mixed-integer programming models, while a case study of hospital as-is schedules demonstrated improvements in OR utilization and overtime reduction. These results suggest that LLM-based multi-agent systems can provide a practical and effective approach for OR scheduling optimization.
zh_abstract: 高效的手术室排程是一项复杂任务，因为手术类型多样、患者需求高且医院资源有限。由于手术室运营占医院成本的很大一部分，有效的排程解决方案至关重要。基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统为支持该问题的优化提供了新机会。本研究评估了一个基于 LLM 的多智能体框架，用于生成和优化手术室排程的优化代码。通过专用智能体之间的迭代协作，所提出的迭代多智能体（IMA）框架持续优于单智能体和传统多智能体基线。在 10 个 LLM 和 35 个场景中，IMA 实现了 82.91% 的平均可行排程率，而基线分别为 65.59% 和 52.53%。在 1050 个合成案例和三个真实手术室数据集上的实验进一步表明，IMA 生成的代码产生的解决方案接近专家编写的混合整数规划模型，而对医院现状排程的案例研究显示手术室利用率提高且加班减少。这些结果表明，基于 LLM 的多智能体系统可为手术室排程优化提供一种实用且有效的方法。

title: Artificial intelligence EEG biomarkers for schizophrenia diagnosis: Systematic review with PROBAST+AI assessment.
source: PubMed · European psychiatry : the journal of the Association of European Psychiatrists

abstract: [European psychiatry : the journal of the Association of European Psychiatrists] The application of artificial intelligence (AI) to resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) data represents a burgeoning frontier in schizophrenia diagnostics. However, the inferential validity of findings is frequently compromised by methodological heterogeneity. This systematic review rigorously evaluates the diagnostic efficacy and methodological robustness of AI-generated EEG biomarkers by implementing the Prediction model Risk Of Bias Assessment Tool for Artificial Intelligence (PROBAST+AI). Following PRISMA guidelines, a systematic search of PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science identified 43 primary studies encompassing 3,420 patients with schizophrenia or first-episode psychosis and 3,164 healthy controls (total N = 6,584). Methodological quality and validation strategies were assessed using the 34 signaling questions of the PROBAST+AI framework. The aggregate mean diagnostic accuracy across the literature was 93.38%, with deep learning architectures demonstrating superior metrics relative to classical machine learning (96.83% vs. 87.68%). Critically, external validation was restricted to 4.7% of the included studies. A pronounced performance discrepancy was observed between subject-wise (88.22%) and segment-wise (98.14%) validation protocols, indicating pervasive data leakage. Overall, 76.7% of the analyzed studies were characterized by a high risk of bias, predominantly stemming from suboptimal data partitioning and inadequate independent verification. Contemporary diagnostic accuracies appear to be artifactually elevated due to structural methodological deficiencies and data leakage. Consequently, current evidence does not support the immediate clinical implementation of AI-EEG biomarkers in schizophrenia. To facilitate translational progress, we propose a standardized methodological framework optimizing validation strategies.
zh_abstract: [European psychiatry : the journal of the Association of European Psychiatrists] 将人工智能（AI）应用于静息态脑电图（EEG）数据是精神分裂症诊断中一个新兴前沿。然而，研究结果的推断有效性常因方法学异质性而受损。本系统综述通过实施人工智能预测模型偏倚风险评估工具（PROBAST+AI），严格评估 AI 生成的 EEG 生物标志物的诊断效能和方法学稳健性。遵循 PRISMA 指南，对 PubMed、Scopus 和 Web of Science 的系统检索识别出 43 项原始研究，涵盖 3,420 名精神分裂症或首发精神病患者和 3,164 名健康对照（总计 N = 6,584）。使用 PROBAST+AI 框架的 34 个信号问题评估方法学质量和验证策略。文献中的总体平均诊断准确率为 93.38%，深度学习架构相较于经典机器学习表现出更优的指标（96.83% 对 87.68%）。关键的是，外部验证仅限于 4.7% 的纳入研究。在被试层面（subject-wise，88.22%）与片段层面（segment-wise，98.14%）验证方案之间观察到明显的性能差异，提示普遍存在数据泄漏。总体而言，76.7% 的分析研究具有高偏倚风险，主要源于次优的数据划分和不充分的独立验证。当前的诊断准确率似乎因结构性方法学缺陷和数据泄漏而被人为抬高。因此，当前证据不支持将 AI-EEG 生物标志物立即用于精神分裂症的临床实践。为促进转化进展，我们提出一个优化验证策略的标准化方法学框架。

title: MechaScreener: Large language model-based automated screening for systematic reviews and research.

abstract: [Research synthesis methods] Systematic reviews are the gold standard for evidence synthesis, but the manual title and abstract screening of thousands of references creates a severe bottleneck. Existing automated tools have historically struggled to achieve the near-perfect recall (sensitivity) required for reliable reviews. We developed MechaScreener as a 'zero-shot' automated screening tool that utilises a large language model to rank article relevance. The tool requires no initial training data or manual pre-screening, as MechaScreener directly applies user-provided question elements (PICO) or inclusion/exclusion criteria to assign an ordinal relevance score (1-5) to each reference. We evaluated the tool in two phases: a development phase using five reference libraries to optimise prompts, and an independent evaluation phase using 10 diverse Cochrane review libraries (comprising both randomised controlled trials [RCTs] and non-RCTs) containing over 58,000 references. In the evaluation dataset, MechaScreener achieved a perfect recall of 1.00 (100%) in all 10 reviews, ensuring that no relevant articles were missed (pooled record-level 95% CI: 0.98-1.00). Concurrently, it achieved an overall macro-average specificity of 0.61 (61%, cluster bootstrap 95% CI: 0.46-0.75; pooled record-level specificity 0.59, 95% CI: 0.59-0.60). Specificity varied from 0.21 in broad public health topics to 0.91 in precise pharmacological interventions, reflecting the tool's built-in conservatism when evaluating ambiguous abstracts. By safely eliminating over 60% of irrelevant literature during the initial screening phase without compromising recall, MechaScreener functions as a highly reliable but low-effort 'first-pass' filter, allowing researchers to substantially reduce manual workloads and reallocate resources towards full-text review and data extraction.
zh_abstract: [Research synthesis methods] 系统综述是证据合成的金标准，但对数千条参考文献进行人工标题和摘要筛选造成了严重瓶颈。现有自动化工具历来难以达到可靠综述所需的近乎完美的召回率（灵敏度）。我们开发了MechaScreener，一种“零样本”（zero-shot）自动化筛选工具，利用大型语言模型对文章相关性进行排序。该工具不需要初始训练数据或人工预筛选，因为MechaScreener直接应用用户提供的问题要素（PICO）或纳入/排除标准，为每条参考文献分配一个序数相关性评分（1-5）。我们在两个阶段评估该工具：一个开发阶段，使用五个参考文献库优化提示词；以及一个独立评估阶段，使用10个多样化的Cochrane综述库（包含随机对照试验[RCT]和非RCT），共超过58,000条参考文献。在评估数据集中，MechaScreener在所有10篇综述中均达到完美召回率1.00（100%），确保没有遗漏相关文章（合并记录级95% CI：0.98-1.00）。同时，它达到总体宏观平均特异度0.61（61%，聚类自助法95% CI：0.46-0.75；合并记录级特异度0.59，95% CI：0.59-0.60）。特异度从广泛公共卫生主题中的0.21到精确药理学干预中的0.91不等，反映了该工具在评估模糊摘要时内置的保守性。通过在初始筛选阶段安全地排除超过60%的不相关文献而不损害召回率，MechaScreener充当高可靠性但低工作量的“第一遍”过滤器，使研究人员能够大幅减少人工工作量，并将资源重新分配到全文审查和数据提取。

abstract: [Journal of biomedical optics] Deep learning (DL)-based image reconstruction methods for photoacoustic computed tomography (PACT) have developed rapidly in recent years. However, most existing methods have not employed standardized datasets, and their evaluations rely on traditional image quality (IQ) metrics that may lack clinical relevance. The absence of a standardized framework for clinically meaningful IQ assessment hinders fair comparison and raises concerns about the reproducibility and reliability of reported advancements in PACT. A benchmarking framework is proposed that provides open-source, anatomically plausible synthetic datasets and evaluation strategies for DL-based acoustic inversion methods in PACT. The datasets each include over 10,000 two-dimensional (2D) stochastic breast objects with clinically relevant lesions and paired measurements at varying modeling complexity. The evaluation strategies incorporate both traditional and task-based IQ measures to assess fidelity and clinical utility. A preliminary benchmarking study is conducted to demonstrate the framework's utility by comparing DL-based and physics-based reconstruction methods. The benchmarking study demonstrated that the proposed framework enabled comprehensive, quantitative comparisons of reconstruction performance and revealed important limitations in certain DL-based methods. Although they performed well according to traditional IQ measures, they often failed to accurately recover lesions. This highlights the inadequacy of traditional metrics and motivates the need for task-based assessments. The proposed benchmarking framework enables systematic comparisons of DL-based acoustic inversion methods for 2D PACT. By integrating clinically relevant synthetic datasets with rigorous evaluation protocols, it enables reproducible, objective assessments and facilitates method development and system optimization in PACT.
zh_abstract: [Journal of biomedical optics] 近年来，用于光声计算机断层成像（PACT）的基于深度学习（DL）的图像重建方法发展迅速。然而，大多数现有方法尚未采用标准化数据集，其评估依赖于可能缺乏临床相关性的传统图像质量（IQ）指标。缺乏用于具有临床意义的IQ评估的标准化框架，阻碍了公平比较，并引发了人们对PACT中已报告进展的可重复性和可靠性的担忧。提出了一种基准测试框架，为PACT中基于DL的声学反演方法提供开源、解剖学上合理的合成数据集和评估策略。这些数据集每个都包含超过10,000个带有临床相关病灶的二维（2D）随机乳腺对象，以及在不同建模复杂度下的配对测量。评估策略纳入传统IQ指标和基于任务的IQ指标，以评估保真度和临床实用性。开展了一项初步基准测试研究，通过比较基于DL和基于物理的重建方法来展示该框架的实用性。该基准测试研究表明，所提出的框架能够对重建性能进行全面、定量比较，并揭示了某些基于DL方法的重要局限性。尽管根据传统IQ指标它们表现良好，但它们往往无法准确恢复病灶。这突显了传统指标的不足，并促使人们需要基于任务的评估。所提出的基准测试框架能够对2D PACT中基于DL的声学反演方法进行系统比较。通过将临床相关合成数据集与严格评估协议相结合，它能够实现可重复、客观的评估，并促进PACT中的方法开发和系统优化。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Predicting Amputation and Related Outcomes in Peripheral Artery Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.

abstract: [Annals of vascular surgery] Peripheral artery disease (PAD) affects over 236 million individuals globally and carries substantial risks of amputation, major adverse limb events (MALE), and mortality. Existing clinical scoring systems focus on short-term surgical outcomes and lack generalizability. Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a promising tool for PAD outcome prediction. To conduct the first quantitative meta-analysis evaluating the discriminative performance, methodological rigor, and certainty of evidence of ML-based prognostic models for adverse limb outcomes in PAD. Following PRISMA/PRISMA-S guidelines, PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, and Web of Science were searched from inception through March 15, 2026. Two reviewers independently performed study selection, data extraction, and PROBAST risk-of-bias assessment. Random-effects meta-analysis (DerSimonian-Laird with Hartung-Knapp-Sidik-Jonkman correction) and hierarchical summary ROC (HSROC) analysis were performed; certainty was rated with GRADE. Ten studies were included. The pooled AUC for amputation-related outcomes was 0.88 (95% CI, 0.83-0.94; prediction interval, 0.79-0.98) with substantial heterogeneity (I2 = 95.4%). HSROC yielded pooled sensitivity 0.855 and specificity 0.836. Registry-based studies showed higher pooled AUC than non-registry studies (0.92 vs 0.80; p = 0.004). All models had high or unclear risk of bias in the analysis domain; none underwent independent external validation. GRADE certainty was very low. ML models demonstrate high discriminative performance for predicting amputation-related outcomes in PAD, but very low certainty of evidence, absence of external validation, and high risk of bias currently limit clinical implementation. Prospective multicenter validation and adherence to AI reporting guidelines are essential before clinical translation.
zh_abstract: [Annals of vascular surgery] 外周动脉疾病（PAD）影响全球超过 2.36 亿人，并带来截肢、主要不良肢体事件（MALE）和死亡的重大风险。现有临床评分系统关注短期手术结局，缺乏可推广性。机器学习（ML）已成为预测 PAD 结局的有前景工具。旨在进行首个定量荟萃分析，评估基于 ML 的 PAD 不良肢体结局预后模型的判别性能、方法学严谨性和证据确定性。遵循 PRISMA/PRISMA-S 指南，检索了 PubMed、Embase、Cochrane Library 和 Web of Science，从建库至 2026 年 3 月 15 日。两名评价者独立进行研究选择、数据提取和 PROBAST 偏倚风险评估。进行了随机效应荟萃分析（DerSimonian-Laird 法，采用 Hartung-Knapp-Sidik-Jonkman 校正）和分层汇总 ROC（HSROC）分析；使用 GRADE 评定确定性。共纳入 10 项研究。截肢相关结局的合并 AUC 为 0.88（95% CI，0.83-0.94；预测区间，0.79-0.98），存在显著异质性（I2 = 95.4%）。HSROC 得出合并灵敏度 0.855 和特异度 0.836。基于注册登记的研究比非注册登记研究显示更高的合并 AUC（0.92 对 0.80；p = 0.004）。所有模型在分析域均具有高或不明确的偏倚风险；均未进行独立外部验证。GRADE 确定性极低。ML 模型在预测 PAD 截肢相关结局方面表现出高判别性能，但极低的证据确定性、缺乏外部验证和高偏倚风险目前限制了临床实施。在临床转化之前，前瞻性多中心验证和遵守 AI 报告指南至关重要。

title: SurvICL: a Foundation Model for in-context Survival Analysis
zh_title: SurvICL：面向上下文生存分析的基础模型
summary: 提出可在上下文中直接预测生存曲线的表格基础模型SurvICL，以合成数据预训练并在103个数据集基准上评测。

reason: 大规模多数据集留出评测与最大生存基准，属重要档，预印本不超8
abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) now outperform gradient-boosted trees in classification and regression. Yet in survival analysis, which predicts when an event occurs from censored data, often on small clinical cohorts, we find that no existing TFM beats the half-century-old Cox model. We address this issue by introducing SurvICL, a TFM that predicts survival curves in-context. SurvICL is pretrained on purely synthetic datasets generated from a novel flexible proportional-odds prior that outperforms other prior types in our ablation study. Unlike most other survival models, SurvICL is trained with a plain quantile regression loss, which is possible because its synthetic pre-training data generator can provide uncensored event times. Additionally, we introduce the largest survival benchmark to date spanning 103 datasets. On the 63 datasets held out from all design decisions, SurvICL outperforms 20 tree-based, deep, and foundation-model baselines without any tuning: it wins 82.9\% of pairwise comparisons in integrated Brier score, against 71.3\% for the runner-up, the Cox model, and is the first model to rank above Cox on small datasets.
zh_abstract: 表格基础模型（Tabular foundation models, TFMs）目前在分类和回归中优于梯度提升树。然而，在生存分析中——其从删失数据预测事件何时发生，且常在小规模临床队列上进行——我们发现没有现有 TFM 能胜过已有半个世纪历史的 Cox 模型。我们通过引入 SurvICL 来解决这一问题，这是一种在上下文内预测生存曲线的 TFM。SurvICL 在完全合成数据集上进行预训练，这些数据集由一种新颖的灵活比例优势先验（proportional-odds prior）生成，该先验在我们的消融研究中优于其他先验类型。与大多数其他生存模型不同，SurvICL 使用普通分位数回归损失进行训练，这之所以可行，是因为其合成预训练数据生成器能够提供未删失的事件时间。此外，我们引入了迄今最大的生存基准，涵盖 103 个数据集。在从所有设计决策中留出的 63 个数据集上，SurvICL 在无需任何调参的情况下优于 20 个基于树、深度和基础模型的基线：在积分 Brier 分数（integrated Brier score）的成对比较中，它赢得 82.9%，而亚军 Cox 模型为 71.3%，并且是首个在小数据集上排名高于 Cox 的模型。

summary: 该系统综述考察 2007 年至 2025 年文献中 AI 如何在儿科初级保健及相关临床场景支持儿童青少年超重/肥胖管理。
key_points: PROSPERO 注册，遵循 PRISMA 2020 报告规范
检索 MEDLINE、Embase、CINAHL 等五个数据库

abstract: [Childhood obesity (Print)] Pediatric overweight and obesity (OW/OB) is a major public health concern associated with significant short- and long-term health risks. Primary care is a key setting for early identification and management, yet current approaches face barriers related to implementation, workflow, and family engagement. This systematic review examined how artificial intelligence (AI) has been used in pediatric primary care and closely connected clinical settings to support OW/OB management. We conducted a systematic review registered in PROSPERO (CRD420251103662) and reported according to Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses 2020 guidelines. MEDLINE, Embase, CINAHL Ultimate, Compendex, and CENTRAL were searched for English-language studies published from 2007 to July 9, 2025. Eligible studies included children and adolescents ages 5-19 years with OW/OB, were conducted in or linked to primary care, and included at least one AI-based approach. Dual-reviewer screening, structured data extraction, and methodological appraisal using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool were completed. Of 3854 records identified, 20 studies met inclusion criteria. Most studies (80%) targeted patient families, while 20% included both families and clinicians. Machine learning was the most common AI approach (60%) and was primarily used for obesity risk prediction or stratification. Fewer studies examined family engagement, counseling, documentation review, or generative AI tools. Methodological quality ranged from moderate to high. AI tools in pediatric primary care primarily support early identification of OW/OB risk, but evidence on workflow integration, sustained engagement, and long-term clinical impact remains limited. Future research should prioritize prospective, workflow-embedded studies, meaningful clinical outcomes, equity, privacy, governance, clinician training, and policy oversight.
zh_abstract: 【Childhood obesity (Print)】儿童超重与肥胖（OW/OB）是一个重大公共卫生问题，与显著的短期和长期健康风险相关。初级保健是早期识别和管理的关键场所，但当前方法面临与实施、工作流程和家庭参与相关的障碍。本系统综述考察了人工智能（AI）如何被用于儿科初级保健及与之密切相关的临床环境，以支持 OW/OB 管理。我们开展了一项在 PROSPERO 注册（CRD420251103662）的系统综述，并按照《系统综述和荟萃分析首选报告条目 2020》（Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses 2020）指南进行报告。检索了 MEDLINE、Embase、CINAHL Ultimate、Compendex 和 CENTRAL，以查找 2007 年至 2025 年 7 月 9 日发表的英文研究。符合条件的研究纳入 5-19 岁患有 OW/OB 的儿童和青少年，在初级保健中开展或与初级保健相关联，并包含至少一种基于 AI 的方法。由两名评价者完成筛选、结构化数据提取，并使用混合方法评价工具（Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool）进行方法学评价。在识别出的 3854 条记录中，20 项研究符合纳入标准。大多数研究（80%）以患者家庭为对象，而 20% 同时纳入家庭和临床医生。机器学习是最常见的 AI 方法（60%），主要用于肥胖风险预测或分层。较少研究考察家庭参与、咨询、病历文档审查或生成式 AI 工具。方法学质量从中等到高不等。儿科初级保健中的 AI 工具主要支持 OW/OB 风险的早期识别，但关于工作流程整合、持续参与和长期临床影响的证据仍然有限。未来研究应优先开展前瞻性、嵌入工作流程的研究，关注有意义的临床结局、公平性、隐私、治理、临床医生培训和政策监督。

title: AI in Neuro-Oncology: An Overarching Review.
zh_title: AI 在神经肿瘤学中的应用：总览性综述
summary: RANO 各工作组联合综述 AI 在神经影像、神经病理、检验、外科、药物发现与临床试验六个领域的应用。
key_points: 由 RANO 各工作组联合撰写
覆盖神经肿瘤六个关键领域
指出影像类应用最接近临床使用
reason: 多工作组联合的综合性综述，但综述类最高按 6 分处理
abstract: [Neuro-oncology] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being applied across neuro-oncology domains to analyze complex, high-dimensional, multimodal data. Despite major advances in the biological understanding and classification of CNS tumors, clinical outcomes for many of them remain poor, reflecting intra- and inter-tumor heterogeneity and limitations of conventional reductionist approaches. AI offers a paradigm shift to capture this heterogeneity and provide quantitative, reproducible diagnostic, predictive, and prognostic insights. This article describes a joint effort across the Response Assessment in Neuro-Oncology (RANO) working groups to provide an overarching review of the AI use across six key domains of neuro-oncology: neuroimaging, neuropathology, laboratory medicine, neurosurgery, drug discovery, and clinical trials. Applications closest to clinical use include imaging segmentation and quantification, AI-assisted image reconstruction, DNA methylation-based classification, and workflow optimization. Radiogenomics, WSI-based molecular prediction, AI-guided surgical targeting, liquid biopsy interpretation, AI-guided drug discovery, digital twins, and in silico trials remain promising but require stronger prospective validation. Key challenges include limited availability of large diverse datasets, variability in data acquisition and reference standards, and limited external validation. This review provides a unifying framework for understanding the role of AI across neuro-oncology and highlights key considerations for its responsible implementation, emphasizing standardization, reproducibility, multi-institutional validation, and human oversight.
zh_abstract: [神经肿瘤学] 人工智能（AI）正越来越多地应用于神经肿瘤学各领域，以分析复杂、高维、多模态数据。尽管在中枢神经系统（CNS）肿瘤的生物学理解和分类方面取得了重大进展，但其中许多肿瘤的临床结局仍然较差，这反映了肿瘤内和肿瘤间异质性以及传统还原论方法的局限性。AI提供了一种范式转变，以捕捉这种异质性，并提供定量、可重复的诊断、预测和预后见解。本文描述了神经肿瘤学反应评估（RANO）工作组之间的联合努力，旨在对AI在神经肿瘤学六个关键领域中的应用进行全面综述：神经影像学、神经病理学、检验医学、神经外科、药物发现和临床试验。最接近临床应用的包括影像分割和量化、AI辅助图像重建、基于DNA甲基化的分类以及工作流程优化。放射基因组学、基于全切片图像（WSI）的分子预测、AI引导的手术靶向、液体活检解读、AI引导的药物发现、数字孪生和计算机模拟试验仍然前景广阔，但需要更强的前瞻性验证。关键挑战包括大型多样化数据集的可用性有限、数据采集和参考标准存在变异性，以及外部验证有限。本综述提供了一个统一框架，用于理解AI在神经肿瘤学中的作用，并强调了负责任实施的关键考虑因素，强调标准化、可重复性、多机构验证和人工监督。

abstract: [Journal of otolaryngology - head & neck surgery = Le Journal d'oto-rhino-laryngologie et de chirurgie cervico-faciale] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into clinical decision-making, including applications in pathology, radiomics, and multidisciplinary tumor boards (MDT) for head and neck (ENT) cancer. However, the current scope and performance of AI tools within MDT settings remain unclear. To systematically evaluate the existing literature on the use and performance of AI models in MDT decision-making for ENT cancer. Systematic review. Studies assessing AI applications in MDT for head and neck (ENT) cancer. A systematic search of Cochrane, Embase, Medline, PubMed, and Scopus was conducted from database inception to March 4, 2025. Studies were included without language or date restrictions. The review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA guidelines. AI performance across 4 key domains: therapy option selection, clinical recommendations, explanation capabilities, and summarization abilities. Of 791 records screened, 37 underwent full-text review and 7 met inclusion criteria. Six AI models were evaluated, with ChatGPT-4 featured in 71% of included studies. Across assessed domains, ChatGPT-4 demonstrated superior performance compared to other models, particularly in therapy selection, recommendation quality, and explanatory capacity. The current evidence base regarding AI integration in MDT decision-making for ENT cancer remains limited and heterogeneous. Although ChatGPT-4 shows promising performance across multiple domains, concerns regarding clinical accuracy, consistency, and transparency persist. Further research is required to optimize AI reliability and validate its clinical utility. Clarifying the capabilities and limitations of AI within MDT settings is essential to ensure safe integration into oncologic decision-making and to support future development of reliable, transparent AI-assisted clinical tools.
zh_abstract: [Journal of otolaryngology - head & neck surgery = Le Journal d'oto-rhino-laryngologie et de chirurgie cervico-faciale] 人工智能（AI）正越来越多地融入临床决策，包括在头颈（ENT）癌的病理学、放射组学和多学科肿瘤委员会（MDT）中的应用。然而，AI工具在MDT环境中的当前范围和性能仍不清楚。系统评估关于AI模型在ENT癌MDT决策中的使用和性能的现有文献。系统综述。评估AI在头颈（ENT）癌MDT中应用的研究。对Cochrane、Embase、Medline、PubMed和Scopus进行了系统检索，检索时间从数据库建库至2025年3月4日。纳入研究无语言或日期限制。本综述按照PRISMA指南进行。AI在4个关键领域的性能：治疗选择、临床推荐、解释能力和总结能力。在筛选的791条记录中，37篇进行了全文审查，7篇符合纳入标准。评估了六种AI模型，其中ChatGPT-4出现在71%的纳入研究中。在评估的领域中，ChatGPT-4相比其他模型表现出更优的性能，尤其是在治疗选择、推荐质量和解释能力方面。关于AI整合到ENT癌MDT决策中的当前证据基础仍然有限且异质性较大。尽管ChatGPT-4在多个领域显示出有前景的性能，但关于临床准确性、一致性和透明度的担忧仍然存在。需要进一步研究以优化AI的可靠性并验证其临床实用性。阐明AI在MDT环境中的能力和局限性对于确保其安全整合到肿瘤学决策中，以及支持未来开发可靠、透明的AI辅助临床工具至关重要。

abstract: [Breathe (Sheffield, England)] Artificial intelligence (AI) and procedure-linked digital health technologies are beginning to transform bronchoscopy across three interconnected domains. In terms of diagnostic accuracy, deep learning models applied to endobronchial ultrasound images and bronchoscopic videos can match or exceed human readers in differentiating benign from malignant lesions, although nearly all evidence remains at the level of test-accuracy metrics rather than clinical outcomes. In real-time navigation, AI-augmented fluoroscopy and tomosynthesis platforms represent the clearest example of clinically deployed AI that improves lesion localisation and diagnostic yield for peripheral pulmonary nodules, while camera-based localisation and shared-control robotic systems remain largely preclinical. In training, multiple randomised controlled trials demonstrate that AI-guided simulators significantly improve performance across experience levels, and that AI-derived metrics can objectively assess competence, although the first attempt to show impact on real-world clinical performance was inconclusive. This review synthesises the current literature across these three domains, distinguishing technologies that are currently used in clinical practice with supportive published evidence from those that remain investigational. It provides practising bronchoscopists and trainees with a balanced appraisal of what AI can realistically offer today, what limitations persist, and what developments are likely over the coming decade.
zh_abstract: [Breathe (Sheffield, England)] 人工智能（AI）和与操作相关的数字健康技术正开始在三个相互关联的领域改变支气管镜检查。在诊断准确性方面，应用于支气管内超声图像和支气管镜视频的深度学习模型，在区分良恶性病变方面可匹配或超过人类阅片者，尽管几乎所有证据仍停留在检测准确性指标层面，而非临床结局。在实时导航方面，AI 增强透视和断层合成平台是临床部署的 AI 提高外周肺结节病灶定位和诊断率的最明确例子，而基于摄像头的定位和共享控制机器人系统在很大程度上仍处于临床前阶段。在培训方面，多项随机对照试验表明，AI 引导的模拟器可显著改善不同经验水平的操作表现，并且 AI 衍生的指标可以客观评估胜任力，尽管首次尝试证明其对真实世界临床表现影响的试验未得出结论。本综述综合了这三个领域的当前文献，区分了已有支持性发表证据、当前用于临床实践的技术与仍处于研究阶段的技术。它为执业支气管镜医师和受训者提供了平衡评估：AI 今天现实上能提供什么、哪些局限持续存在，以及未来十年可能有哪些发展。

title: How much do language and context affect the accuracy of AI health advice?
zh_title: 语言与语境如何影响AI健康建议的准确性
summary: 研究用7个主流大模型评测21种语言与不同来源的健康声明，发现准确率随语言与语境变化。

reason: 大规模多语言评测、样本近万条，但非临床结局研究，属值得一看
abstract: [BMJ health & care informatics] Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for health advice, but evidence on how performance varies across languages, topics and sources remains limited. We assess linguistic and contextual variation in Artificial Intelligence (AI) health-claim verification. We evaluated seven widely accessible LLMs using UK and European Union (EU) health-claim registers and 9088 journalist-vetted PUBHEALTH claims. The register-language analysis used authorised entries translated into 21 languages; status-labelled UK/EU extensions added non-authorised entries for diagnostic checks. PUBHEALTH claims spanned COVID-19, abortion, politics and general health across government, media and other source domains, including nature.com. Models classified claims as supported or unsupported using modal responses across repeated runs. Authorised-claim sensitivity was highest in English and closely related European languages and declined with syntactic distance from English. In status-labelled UK and EU register extensions, models recognised authorised claims but often overclassified non-authorised claims as supported. PUBHEALTH accuracy was lower and varied by topic and source; inaccuracy was highest for general-health claims and claims linked to nature.com. High authorised-claim sensitivity for English register claims can hide lower sensitivity in other languages and weaker performance in other public-health contexts. Training-data exposure, editorial framing and topic-specific tuning are plausible contributors to these gaps. LLM performance in health-claim verification varies substantially by language, topic and source. English-language performance does not reliably generalise across contexts, underscoring the need for multilingual, domain-specific evaluation before public-health deployment.
zh_abstract: [BMJ health & care informatics] 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于健康建议，但关于其性能如何因语言、主题和来源而变化的证据仍然有限。我们评估了人工智能（AI）健康声明验证中的语言和情境变异。我们使用英国和欧盟（EU）健康声明登记册以及9088条经记者审查的PUBHEALTH声明，评估了七个广泛可用的LLM。登记册语言分析使用翻译成21种语言的授权条目；带有状态标签的英国/欧盟扩展增加了非授权条目用于诊断检查。PUBHEALTH声明涵盖COVID-19、堕胎、政治和一般健康，来自政府、媒体和其他来源领域，包括nature.com。模型使用重复运行中的众数响应将声明分类为支持或不支持。授权声明敏感性在英语和密切相关的欧洲语言中最高，并随着与英语的句法距离而下降。在带有状态标签的英国和欧盟登记册扩展中，模型识别出授权声明，但经常将非授权声明过度分类为支持。PUBHEALTH准确率较低，并因主题和来源而异；一般健康声明和与nature.com相关的声明不准确率最高。英语登记册声明的高授权声明敏感性可能掩盖其他语言中较低的敏感性以及其他公共卫生环境中较弱的表现。训练数据暴露、编辑框架和主题特定调整是这些差距的可能促成因素。LLM在健康声明验证中的性能因语言、主题和来源而存在显著差异。英语性能不能可靠地跨情境泛化，强调在公共卫生部署前需要进行多语言、领域特定的评估。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Prediction and Diagnosis of Fetal Growth Restriction: A Systematic Review.

abstract: [Indian journal of pediatrics] This systematic review evaluates evidence on artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) models for prediction and diagnosis of fetal growth restriction (FGR). The authors searched PubMed, Scopus, Embase, Web of Science, and Google Scholar, through June 2026 following PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Studies on AI/ML-based prediction or diagnosis techniques for FGR, Intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) or Small for gestational age (SGA) fetuses. The prediction model risk of bias assessment Tool (PROBAST) was used to perform data extraction and risk of bias assessment. Twenty-seven studies were eligible for inclusion. AI applications were biophysical (n = 10), Doppler-based (n = 10), clinical (n = 7), ultrasound (n = 7), MRI (n = 7), radiomics imaging (n = 10), cardiotocography (n = 10), genomics (n = 10), and metabolomics-based biomarker models (n = 10). The model performance was good, with area under the receiver operating characteristic curves (AUC) of 0.71-0.91 and classification accuracies of 78.9-93.3%. Imaging and multimodal data-based models showed the highest predictive performance. The PROBAST assessment showed that the risk of bias was low for the participant, predictor and outcome domains, but the analytical domain raised methodological concerns; nine studies were low risk, 14 moderate and 4 high. The AI and ML models for FGR detection performed promisingly. Multimodal approaches that combine clinical, imaging and molecular data consistently outperform single modality models and constitute a major advance in precision obstetrics. However, there remains substantial heterogeneity, limited external validation and methodological issues. Future prospective multicenter studies, standardized reporting, and real-world implementation research are needed for routine clinical adoption.
zh_abstract: [Indian journal of pediatrics] 本系统综述评估关于人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）模型用于胎儿生长受限（FGR）预测和诊断的证据。作者遵循PRISMA 2020指南，检索了PubMed、Scopus、Embase、Web of Science和Google Scholar，截至2026年6月。关于针对FGR、宫内生长受限（IUGR）或小于胎龄（SGA）胎儿的基于AI/ML的预测或诊断技术的研究。使用预测模型偏倚风险评估工具（PROBAST）进行数据提取和偏倚风险评估。27项研究符合纳入条件。AI应用包括生物物理（n = 10）、基于多普勒（n = 10）、临床（n = 7）、超声（n = 7）、MRI（n = 7）、影像组学成像（n = 10）、胎心监护（cardiotocography）（n = 10）、基因组学（n = 10）和基于代谢组学的生物标志物模型（n = 10）。模型性能良好，受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）为0.71-0.91，分类准确率为78.9-93.3%。基于成像和多模态数据的模型显示出最高的预测性能。PROBAST评估显示，在参与者、预测因子和结局领域的偏倚风险较低，但分析领域引起了方法学方面的担忧；9项研究为低风险，14项为中等风险，4项为高风险。用于FGR检测的AI和ML模型表现出了良好前景。结合临床、影像和分子数据的多模态方法始终优于单模态模型，是精准产科的一项重大进展。然而，仍存在显著异质性、有限的外部验证和方法学问题。未来需要开展前瞻性多中心研究、标准化报告和真实世界实施研究，以便常规临床采用。

abstract: Accurate boundary delineation in medical ultrasound (US) images remains challenging because of speckle noise, low contrast, acoustic shadowing, and acquisition variability. We propose Risk-routed Implicit Boundary Refinement (RIBR), a compact framework that refines convolutional segmentation through spatially weighted implicit residuals. A coordinate-conditioned implicit branch uses regional features to predict logit corrections, and a learned gate controls their contribution using predictive uncertainty and local appearance. Geometry- and speckle-aware regularization provides contour supervision and discourages probability fluctuations away from boundaries. We compare RIBR with ten baselines on nine datasets covering lymph nodes, breast lesions, thyroid nodules, and prostate, including four external lymph-node and breast cohorts. Across three seeds, RIBR achieves the best overall datase

This retrospective multicentre study used OCT scans from five centres in four countries and the UK Biobank. Data covered four OCT devices, including table mounted and handheld systems. A ResNet50 based Domain Adversarial Neural Network was trained using labelled images from a source device and unlabelled images from a target device. abstract: Foundation models can serve as clinical agents through tool-use harnesses. title: Decoupling Multi-Contrast Super-Resolution: Self-Supervised Implicit Re-Representation for Unpaired Cross-Modal Synthesis.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
zh_title: 解耦式多对比度MRI超分辨：自监督隐式再表征
summary: 提出解耦框架，将多对比度MRI超分辨分为无配对跨模态合成与患者自监督隐式再表征两阶段，无需配对高低分辨率数据且不限定放大倍数。
key_points: 用无配对群体数据训练跨模态合成模块学习解剖先验
第二阶段为轻量患者特异隐式再表征，自监督优化

reason: 方法有新意但无外部验证与临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] Multi-contrast super-resolution (MCSR) is crucial for enhancing MRI but current deep learning methods are limited. They typically require large, paired low- and high-resolution (LR/HR) training datasets, which are scarce, and are trained for fixed upsampling scales. While recent self-supervised methods remove the paired data requirement, they fail to leverage valuable population-level priors. In this work, we propose a novel, decoupled MCSR framework that resolves both limitations. We reformulate MCSR into two stages: (1) an unpaired cross-modal synthesis (uCMS) module, trained once on unpaired population data to learn a robust anatomical prior; and (2) a lightweight, patient-specific implicit re-representation (IrR) module. This IrR module is optimized in a self-supervised manner to fuse the population prior with the subject's own LR target data. This design uniquely fuses population-level knowledge with patient-specific fidelity without requiring paired target-domain LR/HR training data or paired cross-modal HR reference-target training data. Here, 'unpaired' refers to the population-level training setting; at subject-specific inference, as in standard MCSR, the method uses a matched HR reference image from another contrast together with the subject's LR target image. By building the IrR module on an implicit neural representation, our framework is also inherently scale-agnostic. Our method demonstrates superior quantitative performance on different datasets, with exceptional robustness at extreme scales (16×, 32×), a regime where competing methods fail. Our work presents a data-efficient, flexible, and computationally lightweight paradigm for MCSR, enabling high-fidelity, arbitrary-scale reconstruction without the need for paired population-level supervision.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 多对比度超分辨率（multi-contrast super-resolution, MCSR）对增强MRI至关重要，但当前的深度学习方法存在局限。它们通常需要大型的成对低分辨率和高分辨率（LR/HR）训练数据集，而这类数据稀缺，并且它们针对固定上采样倍数进行训练。尽管近来的自监督方法消除了对成对数据的需求，但它们未能利用有价值的群体水平先验。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的解耦MCSR框架，可解决这两个局限。我们将MCSR重新表述为两个阶段：（1）非配对跨模态合成（unpaired cross-modal synthesis, uCMS）模块，在非配对群体数据上训练一次，以学习稳健的解剖学先验；（2）轻量级、患者特异性的隐式重表示（implicit re-representation, IrR）模块。该IrR模块以自监督方式优化，将群体先验与受试者自身的LR目标数据融合。这一设计独特地将群体水平知识与患者特异性保真度融合，无需成对的目标域LR/HR训练数据，也无需成对的跨模态HR参考-目标训练数据。在此，“非配对”指的是群体水平训练设置；在受试者特异性推理时，如标准MCSR中那样，该方法使用来自另一对比度的匹配HR参考图像以及受试者的LR目标图像。通过将IrR模块构建在隐式神经表示上，我们的框架也天然与尺度无关。我们的方法在不同数据集上展现出优越的定量性能，并在极端尺度（16×、32×）下具有出色稳健性，而竞争方法在该情形下会失败。我们的工作提出了一种数据高效、灵活且计算轻量的MCSR范式，无需成对的群体水平监督即可实现高保真、任意尺度重建。

abstract: Adaptive radiotherapy must account for anatomical changes during treatment, but doing so depends on reliably mapping targets, organs at risk and dose across serial images. Existing registration methods treat each image pair independently, without using radiotherapy-specific context or the patient's preceding anatomical trajectory. We developed Clinical-context-Aware and Patient-adaptive Deformable Image Registration (CAP-DIR), integrating source contours, dose, clinical text and prior-registration features. We evaluated 16,361 CT examinations from 3,473 patients across four institutional cohorts and five public benchmarks. CAP-DIR increased internal-test organ-at-risk-region normalized cross-correlation from 84.76% to 96.92% relative to the strongest learning-based comparator, with low deformation folding, and remained superior across seven external cohorts. title: How Safe Is ChatGPT Health Advice? Evidence from Real User Conversations in Four Global South Countries

abstract: People increasingly bring their health questions to ChatGPT, yet safety evaluations of LLM health advice rest almost entirely on clinician-authored vignettes, synthetic prompts, or simulated user profiles. The gap is widest for the Global South, where concerns about demographic bias and unsafe recommendations are well documented but have never been tested on real usage. We present, to our knowledge, the first demographically grounded safety evaluation of real-world health conversations with ChatGPT. From a consent-based data-donation corpus of 202,590 conversations from 1,252 users in India, Nigeria, Brazil, and Pakistan (December 2022 to February 2026), each linked to self-reported age and gender, we identify 15,555 health conversations, classify their health intent using an LLM classifier adapted from an established taxonomy, and score response safety under both a context-blind and a u
zh_abstract: 人们越来越多地将自己的健康问题带给 ChatGPT，然而对 LLM 健康建议的安全性评估几乎完全依赖于临床医生撰写的案例短文、合成提示或模拟用户画像。全球南方（Global South）的差距最大，那里关于人口学偏倚和不安全建议的担忧已有充分记录，但从未在真实使用中受到检验。据我们所知，我们提出了首个基于人口学特征、针对与 ChatGPT 真实世界健康对话的安全性评估。基于一个基于同意的数据捐赠语料库，该语料库包含来自印度、尼日利亚、巴西和巴基斯坦的 1,252 名用户的 202,590 段对话（2022 年 12 月至 2026 年 2 月），每段对话都与自我报告的年龄和性别相关联，我们识别出 15,555 段健康对话，使用改编自已确立分类体系的 LLM 分类器对其健康意图进行分类，并在 context-blind 和 a u 两者下对回应安全性进行评分

title: Artificial intelligence-enabled drug discovery: A growing but largely early-stage clinical pipeline.
zh_title: AI赋能药物发现：临床管线仍处早期阶段
summary: 截至2026年3月共识别129个进入临床试验的AI相关治疗资产，肿瘤占57.3%，仅5个进入或完成III期。
key_points: 129个AI相关资产，来自69家公司
肿瘤领域74个（57.3%），小分子103个
I期成功率77.8%，II期19.5%，III期仅5个
reason: 同行评审横断面分析，提供管线全景数据，但无前瞻验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [Cancer treatment reviews] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into pharmaceutical discovery, yet the extent to which AI-enabled assets have translated into clinical-stage programs remains incompletely characterized. We performed a cross-sectional descriptive analysis of therapeutic assets discovered or developed using AI approaches that had entered at least one interventional human clinical trial through March 1, 2026. We identified 129 AI-enabled therapeutic assets across 69 companies. Oncology was the dominant therapeutic area (74 assets, 57.3%), and small molecules accounted for the majority of the pipeline (103 assets, 79.8%). Among these assets, 72 (55.8%) had completed Phase 1 and 24 (18.9%) had completed Phase 2; only five had entered or completed Phase 3. The observed probability of success was 77.8% for Phase 1 and 19.5% for Phase 2. Forty-eight assets (37.2%) were classified as targeting a novel biological target. Among companies with available data, the median time from founding to Phase 1 entry was 6.5 years (IQR 4.0-9.2), median total funding raised was $186.7 million (IQR $48.1-$595.0 million), and the median employee count at clinical entry was 73 (IQR 32-129), with a median operational intensity of $2.72 million per employee. AI-enabled therapeutics are entering clinical testing at increasing scale, but most programs remain early in development, with few having advanced beyond Phase 2. This dataset provides a baseline for future evaluation of whether AI-enabled discovery ultimately improves regulatory approval rates and clinical outcomes.
zh_abstract: [Cancer treatment reviews] 人工智能（AI）正日益融入药物发现，但AI赋能的资产转化为临床阶段项目的程度仍未被充分描述。我们对使用AI方法发现或开发、且截至2026年3月1日已进入至少一项介入性人体临床试验的治疗性资产进行了横断面描述性分析。我们在69家公司中识别出129项AI赋能的治疗性资产。肿瘤学是主要治疗领域（74项资产，57.3%），小分子占研发管线的大多数（103项资产，79.8%）。在这些资产中，72项（55.8%）已完成1期，24项（18.9%）已完成2期；只有5项已进入或完成3期。观察到的成功概率为1期77.8%，2期19.5%。48项资产（37.2%）被归类为靶向新型生物靶点。在有可用数据的公司中，从成立到进入1期的中位时间为6.5年（IQR 4.0–9.2），筹集的总资金中位数为1.867亿美元（IQR 4810万–5.950亿美元），进入临床时的员工人数中位数为73（IQR 32–129），中位运营强度为每位员工272万美元。AI赋能的治疗药物正以越来越大规模进入临床测试，但大多数项目仍处于开发早期，很少有项目推进到2期之后。该数据集为未来评估AI赋能的发现是否最终提高监管批准率和临床结局提供了基线。

title: AI and Deep Learning in Cardiovascular Imaging: From Risk Stratification to Precision Phenotyping.
source: PubMed · Arteriosclerosis, thrombosis, and vascular biology
zh_title: 心血管影像中的人工智能与深度学习综述
summary: 综述梳理AI与深度学习在心血管影像中从风险分层到精准表型的技术与应用。
key_points: 覆盖模型架构与训练策略基础
涉及胸片、CT、CMR、超声、核医学

reason: 同行评审综述，非系统综述/meta分析，按规则上限6分，取5分
abstract: [Arteriosclerosis, thrombosis, and vascular biology] Cardiovascular imaging plays a central role in the diagnosis, risk stratification, and management of cardiovascular disease, yet the complexity and volume of imaging data increasingly exceed the capacity of conventional interpretation. Artificial intelligence (AI) and deep learning offer new tools to extract quantitative, prognostic, and phenotypic information from routine cardiovascular images. This review summarizes the fundamentals of AI and deep learning, including model architectures, training strategies, and their relevance to cardiovascular imaging, followed by a focused discussion of current applications across chest radiography, chest computed tomography, computed tomography angiography/cardiac computed tomography, cardiac magnetic resonance imaging, echocardiography, and nuclear cardiology imaging. Studies were selected with emphasis on original investigations, large cohort analyses, and external validation studies reflecting current applications of AI in cardiovascular risk stratification and precision phenotyping. Across these modalities, AI applications in automated image processing and analysis have become relatively mature. Multiple multicenter and real-world studies have validated their value in improving efficiency and supporting cardiovascular management. Approaches that move beyond conventional human-defined imaging metrics to infer cardiovascular risk and disease phenotype remain at an earlier stage, requiring further standardization, validation, and clinical evaluation. AI is expanding the role of cardiovascular imaging from visual interpretation toward integrated assessment for risk stratification and precision phenotyping, though further work is needed to confirm generalizability and real-world performance before these tools can guide individual patient management.
zh_abstract: [Arteriosclerosis, thrombosis, and vascular biology] 心血管影像学在心血管疾病的诊断、风险分层和管理中发挥核心作用，但影像数据的复杂性和数量日益超出传统判读的能力。人工智能（AI）和深度学习提供了从常规心血管图像中提取定量、预后和表型信息的新工具。本综述总结了 AI 和深度学习的基础知识，包括模型架构、训练策略及其与心血管影像学的相关性，随后重点讨论其在胸部 X 线摄影、胸部计算机断层扫描、计算机断层扫描血管造影/心脏计算机断层扫描、心脏磁共振成像、超声心动图和核心脏病学成像中的当前应用。研究选择侧重于原始研究、大队列分析和外部验证研究，这些研究反映了 AI 在心血管风险分层和精准表型分析中的当前应用。在这些模态中，AI 在自动图像处理和分析中的应用已相对成熟。多项多中心研究和真实世界研究已验证其在提高效率和支持心血管管理方面的价值。超越传统人工定义的影像指标来推断心血管风险和疾病表型的方法仍处于较早阶段，需要进一步的标准化、验证和临床评估。AI 正在将心血管影像学的作用从视觉判读扩展到用于风险分层和精准表型分析的综合评估，尽管在这些工具有望指导个体患者管理之前，还需要进一步工作来确认其泛化性和真实世界性能。

title: Artificial Intelligence Software (Prostate Intelligence) for Detecting Clinically Significant Prostate Cancer on MRI
zh_title: 前列腺MRI AI软件Prostate Intelligence诊断试验
summary: 前瞻性试验拟入组226例，评估AI软件Prostate Intelligence单独及联合放射科医生检出临床显著前列腺癌的效能。
key_points: 计划入组226例，尚未开始招募
主要指标为患者层面敏感度与特异度

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Agostino Gemelli IRCCS; conditions: Prostate Cancer; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 226; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] The goal of this study is to learn how accurately an artificial intelligence (AI) software called Prostate Intelligence (Pi) detects clinically significant prostate cancer on prostate MRI in adults with a prostate gland who are referred for MRI because prostate cancer is suspected. The main question it aims to answer is: \- How sensitive and specific is Pi, used on its own, in detecting clinically significant prostate cancer (Gleason grade 3+4 or higher) at the patient level? Researchers will also compare Pi, the radiologist alone, and the radiologist assisted by Pi, to see whether AI assistance changes cancer detection. Participants will: * Undergo prostate MRI as part of their usual clinical care. Each MRI is first read by a radiologist without the AI result; the Pi report is then shown to the radiologist, who produces a final combined report. * Undergo targeted prostate biopsy (up to two lesions) if the MRI is suspicious, as in routine practice. Areas flagged only by Pi may also be biopsied. * If not biopsied, be followed for 12 months after MRI with PSA tests at 6 and 12 months and clinical assessment, to confirm the absence of clinically significant cancer. About 226 participants will be enrolled at two Italian centres (Fondazione Policlinico Universitario A. Gemelli IRCCS, Rome, and IRCCS Ospedale San Raffaele, Milan).

Gemelli IRCCS 和米兰 IRCCS Ospedale San Raffaele）入组。

title: Large Language Model-Assisted Prediction and Virtual Screening of Near-Infrared-II Fluorescent Molecules.
source: PubMed · Small (Weinheim an der Bergstrasse, Germany)
zh_title: 大模型辅助近红外二区荧光分子预测与虚拟筛选
summary: 整合现有荧光数据集与NIR-II荧光团数据，构建覆盖可见光至NIR-II发射波长的数据集，并基于大模型预测分子最大发射波长，与传统机器学习和深度学习模型比较。
key_points: 构建覆盖可见光到NIR-II的最大发射波长数据集
提出基于大语言模型的分子发射波长预测框架
