reason: 有新意的分子性质预测应用，但摘要未给出外部验证或结果规模
abstract: [Small (Weinheim an der Bergstrasse, Germany)] Fluorescence imaging in the second near-infrared window (NIR-II, 1000-1700 nm) has attracted increasing attention in biomedical applications owing to its deep tissue penetration, high spatial resolution, and low background autofluorescence. However, the rational optimization of high-performance NIR-II fluorophores remains challenging because of the complex relationship between molecular structure and optical properties. In this study, we integrated existing fluorescence datasets with NIR-II fluorophore data to construct a comprehensive dataset covering maximum emission wavelengths from the visible region to the NIR-II window. Based on this dataset, we developed a large language model (LLM)-based framework for predicting molecular maximum emission wavelengths and compared its performance with conventional machine learning and deep learning models. The results demonstrated that the LLM achieved competitive predictive performance compared with the baseline models, highlighting the feasibility of LLM-based structure-property prediction for fluorescent molecules. Model-guided virtual screening was subsequently performed to prioritize candidate NIR-II fluorophores, leading to the identification of two promising candidates that were experimentally characterized and exhibited favorable imaging performance in vitro and in vivo. Overall, this study demonstrates the feasibility of LLM-assisted structure-property prediction and virtual screening for NIR-II fluorophores, providing an efficient computational strategy for candidate prioritization and molecular optimization.
zh_abstract: [Small (Weinheim an der Bergstrasse, Germany)] 第二近红外窗口（NIR-II，1000-1700 nm）荧光成像因其深组织穿透、高空间分辨率和低背景自发荧光而在生物医学应用中受到越来越多的关注。然而，由于分子结构与光学性质之间关系复杂，高性能NIR-II荧光团的合理优化仍然具有挑战性。在本研究中，我们将现有荧光数据集与NIR-II荧光团数据整合，构建了一个覆盖从可见光区域到NIR-II窗口最大发射波长的综合数据集。基于该数据集，我们开发了一个基于大语言模型（large language model, LLM）的框架，用于预测分子最大发射波长，并将其性能与传统机器学习和深度学习模型进行比较。结果表明，与基线模型相比，LLM取得了具有竞争力的预测性能，凸显了基于LLM的荧光分子结构-性质预测的可行性。随后进行了模型引导的虚拟筛选，以优先选出候选NIR-II荧光团，最终鉴定出两个有前景的候选物，并对其进行了实验表征，在体外和体内均表现出良好的成像性能。总体而言，本研究证明了LLM辅助的结构-性质预测和虚拟筛选用于NIR-II荧光团的可行性，为候选物优先级排序和分子优化提供了一种高效的计算策略。

title: Beyond prediction: The evolving role of artificial intelligence in genome editing.
zh_title: 超越预测：AI在基因组编辑中演变的角色
summary: 综述AI在基因组编辑中的应用，从预测gRNA活性与脱靶效应扩展到蛋白质语言模型与生成式分子设计。
key_points: 早期AI用于预测gRNA活性与脱靶效应
蛋白质语言模型与生成式AI用于分子设计
可进化编辑蛋白并生成新型编辑酶
reason: 综述类文章，覆盖面广但无新数据，按规则上限内取中档
abstract: [Molecular cell] Since the discovery of the clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeat (CRISPR)-associated (Cas) system, genome-editing technologies have advanced rapidly, and the field has expanded substantially. In parallel, artificial intelligence (AI) has progressed at an unprecedented pace and is transforming genetic engineering. Early AI applications primarily addressed predictive tasks, including guide RNA (gRNA) activity, off-target effects, and editing outcomes for CRISPR-Cas nucleases, base editors, and prime editors. Recently, transformer-based protein language models (PLMs) and generative AI have expanded the role of AI beyond prediction to direct molecular design. Thus, AI-driven frameworks can now evolve genome-editing proteins, design molecular architectures, and generate de novo genome-editing enzymes. This review discusses how AI is reshaping genome engineering, from gRNA activity prediction to the design of next-generation editors.
zh_abstract: [《分子细胞》（Molecular cell）] 自成簇规律间隔短回文重复（CRISPR）相关（Cas）系统被发现以来，基因组编辑技术发展迅速，该领域已大幅扩展。与此同时，人工智能（AI）以前所未有的速度进步，并正在改变基因工程。早期AI应用主要处理预测任务，包括指导RNA（gRNA）活性、脱靶效应，以及CRISPR-Cas核酸酶、碱基编辑器和先导编辑器的编辑结果。最近，基于Transformer的蛋白质语言模型（PLM）和生成式AI已将AI的作用从预测扩展到直接分子设计。因此，AI驱动的框架现在可以进化基因组编辑蛋白、设计分子架构，并从头生成基因组编辑酶。这篇综述讨论了AI如何重塑基因组工程，从gRNA活性预测到下一代编辑器的设计。

title: Artificial intelligence for stromal cell quality assessment: A systematic review of human mesenchymal stromal cell properties and viability.
zh_title: AI评估间充质基质细胞质量的系统综述
summary: 系统综述按PRISMA检索5个数据库，评估AI自动评估人间充质基质细胞活力与干性相关属性的准确性及临床实用性。
key_points: 检索Cochrane、Scopus、PubMed等5个数据库
聚焦MSC活力与干性相关属性的自动评估
指出AI方法性能与临床相关性尚未被系统评估
reason: 系统综述但未见外部验证或结局数据，属值得一看档
abstract: [Cell and tissue research] Reliable assessment of mesenchymal stromal cell (MSC) viability and stem cell-associated properties is essential for ensuring the consistency, safety, and therapeutic potential of MSC cultures before clinical use. However, incomplete understanding of the mechanisms underlying MSC therapeutic effects remains a major barrier to clinical translation and to establishing reliable, standardised quality attributes. Artificial intelligence (AI) may enable automated assessment of these properties, but the performance and clinical relevance of AI-based approaches have not been systematically evaluated. This systematic review evaluated the accuracy and clinical utility of AI for assessing viability and stem cell-associated properties in human MSC cultures. Following PRISMA guidelines, we searched five electronic databases (Cochrane, Scopus, PubMed, EMBASE, and MEDLINE) for eligible studies reporting quantitative AI-based assessments of human MSC cultures. Two reviewers independently screened studies, extracted data, and assessed risk of bias using PROBAST. The review protocol was prospectively registered with PROSPERO (CRD420256393235). Of 3,872 records identified, 18 studies met the inclusion criteria. Supervised AI models, particularly convolutional neural networks, were most used. Across included studies, reported performance metrics varied substantially because of differences in AI models, imaging modalities, datasets, and outcome definitions. Considerable heterogeneity in AI model architectures, imaging modalities, outcome definitions, and reporting metrics limited direct comparison across studies. Overall, available evidence suggests that AI can assess key MSC quality attributes and may support more objective, scalable, and standardised quality-control workflows. However, broader validation, standardised reporting, external testing, and evaluation across a wider range of MSC characteristics are required before routine clinical implementation can be recommended.
zh_abstract: [Cell and Tissue Research] 可靠评估间充质基质细胞（mesenchymal stromal cell, MSC）活力和干细胞相关特性，对于确保 MSC 培养物在临床使用前的一致性、安全性和治疗潜力至关重要。然而，对 MSC 治疗效应背后机制的理解不完整，仍然是临床转化以及建立可靠、标准化质量属性的主要障碍。人工智能（Artificial Intelligence, AI）可能实现这些特性的自动化评估，但基于 AI 的方法的性能和临床相关性尚未被系统评价。本系统综述评价了 AI 在评估人 MSC 培养物活力和干细胞相关特性方面的准确性和临床实用性。遵循 PRISMA 指南，我们检索了五个电子数据库（Cochrane、Scopus、PubMed、EMBASE 和 MEDLINE），以寻找报告对人 MSC 培养物进行基于 AI 的定量评估的符合条件研究。两名评价者独立筛选研究、提取数据，并使用 PROBAST 评估偏倚风险。该综述方案已前瞻性注册于 PROSPERO（CRD420256393235）。在识别出的 3,872 条记录中，18 项研究符合纳入标准。监督式 AI 模型，尤其是卷积神经网络，使用最多。在纳入研究中，由于 AI 模型、成像模式、数据集和结局定义的差异，报告的绩效指标差异很大。AI 模型架构、成像模式、结局定义和报告指标的显著异质性限制了研究间的直接比较。总体而言，现有证据提示，AI 可以评估关键的 MSC 质量属性，并可能支持更客观、可扩展和标准化的质量控制工作流程。然而，在推荐常规临床实施之前，需要进行更广泛的验证、标准化报告、外部测试，并在更广泛的 MSC 特征范围内进行评估。

title: Development and Exploratory Evaluation of a Large Language Model-Supported Scoping Review Workflow.
zh_title: 大语言模型辅助范围综述工作流开发与评估
summary: 开发模块化LLM范围综述流程，以GPT-5与gpt-oss-20b对1336条检索结果筛查，与人工决策比对。
key_points: 参考综述关键词检索结果共1336条
两模型输出与人工审阅决策比对一致性
分歧经人工裁决并入复合参考标准
reason: 同行评审并与人工对照，但非临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of medical systems] Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated human-level performance in literature review screening phases and have been evaluated in systematic-review workflows. However, LLM performance in scoping reviews, which are broader and more heterogeneous, remains understudied. We developed a modular LLM-supported framework for scoping-review workflows and compared the performance of two general-purpose LLMs against human reviewers on a reference scoping review. The reference review's keyword search results (n = 1336) and prompt sets mirroring workflow stages were provided to GPT-5 and gpt-oss-20b (OpenAI, August 2025). Outputs were benchmarked against human decisions for agreement; disagreements were adjudicated. For title-abstract screening and final-inclusion concordance, unanimous and adjudicated decisions were combined into a composite reference standard. In title-abstract screening, GPT-5 and gpt-oss-20b workflows showed substantial interrater agreement with human consensus (AC1: 0.769; 0.722); reference concordance was 90.9% (p = 0.08) and 92.4% (p = 0.004) versus humans' 89.0%. For final inclusion status, interrater agreement was almost-perfect (AC1: 0.948; 0.853); reference concordance was 95.4% (p = 0.23) and 92.4% (p < 0.001) versus humans' 96.1%. Across data categorization/synthesis, interrater agreement was fair to almost-perfect (AC1: 0.493-0.949; 0.342-0.929); total variation distances (representing distribution divergence) were 1.55%-28.0%. All sources found comparably low definition-adherent use rates of the term "human digital twin" (humans 12.1%; GPT-5 13.0%; gpt-oss-20b 18.0%). Both LLM-supported workflows achieved fair to almost-perfect agreement and high screening/final-inclusion reference concordance. The main synthesis finding was directionally consistent across workflows, with all sources identifying infrequent correct use of "human digital twin"; total variation distance may be useful in assessing distribution-level concordance. Limitations include a single domain/vendor, fixed prompts, and predefined taxonomies; broader evaluations are warranted. In this single-domain benchmark, LLM-supported scoping-review workflows showed feasibility for supporting and potentially streamlining selected review stages, with broadly comparable performance on evaluated endpoints and conclusion-level concordance. Generalizability, reproducibility, and operational efficiency beyond this benchmark remain to be established.
zh_abstract: [Journal of Medical Systems] 大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）已在文献综述筛选阶段展现出人类水平的表现，并已在系统综述工作流程中接受评估。然而，LLM 在范围综述中的表现——范围综述更广泛且更具异质性——仍未得到充分研究。我们开发了一个用于范围综述工作流程的模块化 LLM 支持框架，并在一项参考范围综述中将两个通用 LLM 的表现与人类审阅者进行比较。该参考综述的关键词检索结果（n = 1336）以及镜像工作流程阶段的提示词集被提供给 GPT-5 和 gpt-oss-20b（OpenAI，2025 年 8 月）。将输出与人类决策进行一致性基准比较；分歧经过裁定。对于标题-摘要筛选和最终纳入一致性，将一致同意和裁定后的决策合并为复合参考标准。在标题-摘要筛选中，GPT-5 和 gpt-oss-20b 工作流程与人类共识显示出实质性评分者间一致性（AC1：0.769；0.722）；参考一致性分别为 90.9%（p = 0.08）和 92.4%（p = 0.004），而人类为 89.0%。对于最终纳入状态，评分者间一致性几乎完美（AC1：0.948；0.853）；参考一致性分别为 95.4%（p = 0.23）和 92.4%（p < 0.001），而人类为 96.1%。在数据分类/综合方面，评分者间一致性为一般至几乎完美（AC1：0.493-0.949；0.342-0.929）；总变差距离（表示分布差异）为 1.55%-28.0%。所有来源均发现术语“人类数字孪生”（human digital twin）符合定义的使用率相当低（人类 12.1%；GPT-5 13.0%；gpt-oss-20b 18.0%）。两个 LLM 支持的工作流程均达到一般至几乎完美的一致性，以及较高的筛选/最终纳入参考一致性。主要综合发现在各工作流程间方向一致，所有来源均识别出“人类数字孪生”的正确使用不常见；总变差距离可能有助于评估分布层面的一致性。局限性包括单一领域/供应商、固定提示词和预定义分类体系；需要进行更广泛的评估。在这项单一领域基准测试中，LLM 支持的范围综述工作流程显示出支持并可能精简所选综述阶段的可行性，在评估终点和结论层面一致性上表现大致相当。该基准之外的可推广性、可重复性和运营效率仍有待确立。

title: Evaluating Large Language Model-Derived Outputs as Psychological Measures: A Five-Domain Psychometric Framework With Application to Daily Stress.
source: PubMed · Journal of medical Internet research
zh_title: 以五域心理测量框架评估LLM心理测量输出
summary: 对LLM从自然语言量化心理构念提出五域测量导向评估框架，并以日常压力研究为例应用。
key_points: 涵盖提取可重复性与收敛效度
区分个体内与个体间生态共时效度
纳入四臂比较与方法盲法专家评估
reason: 同行评审的方法学评估，无临床结局指标，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to quantify psychological constructs from natural language, yet their outputs are typically evaluated only as predictions of an external label. When that label is itself imperfect, optimizing prediction conflates label agreement with construct measurement. No study has applied a multidomain measurement-oriented evaluation to LLM-derived psychological outputs. We applied 5 psychometric evaluation domains to LLM-derived outputs to test whether measurement-oriented evaluation surfaces properties that prediction-oriented evaluation does not: extraction repeatability, convergent validity with a lexicon-based tool, ecological concurrent validity decomposed into within-person and between-person components, incremental value in a 4-arm comparison with that tool, and method-blinded expert evaluation with structured error attribution. Thirteen linguistic features were extracted by GPT-5.2 (OpenAI) from 3556 person-days of daily voice narratives collected from 279 call center workers over 15 days via ecological momentary assessment. Features were evaluated across the 5 domains, with Linguistic Inquiry and Word Count, version 22, as the lexicon-based comparator. Multimodel robustness was assessed by re-extracting all features with Google Gemini 2.5 Flash. Features showed high repeatability (mean intraclass correlation coefficient=0.987), construct-dependent convergent validity (Spearman ρ=0.08 to 0.79), and within-person tracking of same-day stress (negative emotion β=0.68). In a 4-arm comparison (baseline, baseline plus lexicon features, baseline plus LLM-derived features, and baseline plus both), LLM features increased explained variance in daily stress from 13.2% to 30.4%, versus 16.9% for the lexicon-based comparator. Among transcripts sampled for maximal method discordance, experts preferred LLM-derived profiles in 83.7% (261/312) of blinded decisions. Error analysis showed that 53% (35/66) of false-positive attributions reflected reference-label limitations, not model failures. Re-extraction with Google Gemini 2.5 Flash replicated key properties (person-level r=0.94). Three phenomena were visible under measurement-oriented evaluation that prediction-oriented evaluation does not typically examine: divergence between within-person and between-person effects, reference-label limitations as a dominant error source, and moderation of feature meaning by individual differences. Prediction metrics alone are insufficient
zh_abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] 大型语言模型（large language models, LLMs）越来越多地用于从自然语言中量化心理构念，但其输出通常仅作为外部标签的预测来评估。当该标签本身不完美时，优化预测会将标签一致性与构念测量混为一谈。尚无研究对LLM衍生的心理输出应用多领域、以测量为导向的评估。我们将5个心理测量学评估领域应用于LLM衍生的输出，以检验以测量为导向的评估是否揭示出以预测为导向的评估所不能揭示的属性：提取可重复性、与基于词典的工具的收敛效度、分解为个体内和个体间成分的生态学同时效度、在与该工具进行的4臂比较中的增量价值，以及对方法设盲的专家评估并附结构化错误归因。GPT-5.2（OpenAI）从279名呼叫中心员工在15天内通过生态瞬时评估收集的3556人日的每日语音叙述中提取了13个语言特征。特征在5个领域中接受评估，以语言探究与词计数（Linguistic Inquiry and Word Count）第22版作为基于词典的比较器。通过使用Google Gemini 2.5 Flash重新提取所有特征来评估多模型稳健性。特征显示出高可重复性（平均组内相关系数=0.987）、取决于构念的收敛效度（Spearman ρ=0.08至0.79），以及对同日压力的个体内追踪（负性情绪 β=0.68）。在4臂比较（基线、基线加词典特征、基线加LLM衍生特征、基线加两者）中，LLM特征将每日压力的解释方差从13.2%提高到30.4%，而基于词典的比较器为16.9%。在为最大方法不一致性抽样的转录文本中，专家在83.7%（261/312）的盲法决策中偏好LLM衍生画像。错误分析显示，53%（35/66）的假阳性归因反映的是参考标签的局限性，而非模型失败。使用Google Gemini 2.5 Flash重新提取复制了关键属性（个体层面 r=0.94）。在以测量为导向的评估下可见三种以预测为导向的评估通常不考察的现象：个体内效应与个体间效应之间的分离、参考标签局限性作为主要错误来源，以及个体差异对特征含义的调节。仅凭预测指标是不够的

title: Beyond SELEX: AI-driven aptamers from sequence to structure to function.
zh_title: 超越SELEX：AI驱动的适配体序列、结构与功能设计
summary: 综述AI在适配体开发全流程的应用，重点介绍2024至2026年在结构预测与理性设计方面的进展。
key_points: 梳理SELEX数据分析的数据库与计算工具
覆盖二级三级结构预测含AlphaFold 3等
强调机器学习驱动的理性设计取代经验筛选
reason: 叙述性综述而非系统综述，按规则上限受限，属值得一看档
abstract: [Biotechnology advances] Conventional aptamer discovery by systematic evolution of ligands by exponential enrichment (SELEX) is often constrained by limited library capacity, PCR bias, and multi-round screening. The recent convergence of artificial intelligence with aptamer development is driving a paradigm shift from empirical screening toward rational, data-driven design. This Review presents a timely and comprehensive overview of AI integration across the entire aptamer development pipeline, with a particular emphasis on advances reported in 2024-2026. We begin by discussing bioinformatics databases and computational tools for high-throughput SELEX data analysis. We then review state-of-the-art strategies for secondary and tertiary structure prediction, including recent breakthroughs such as AlphaFold 3, RoseTTAFoldNA, and diffusion-based approaches. We also cover machine learning methods for aptamer-target interaction prediction, molecular docking, dynamics simulations, and free energy calculations. A major focus is placed on very recent AI-driven generative design, including diffusion models (AptaDiff), language model-based frameworks (InstructNA, GRAPE-LM), and reinforcement learning approaches (AiDTA) for de novo aptamer generation and optimization. Emerging applications of AI-designed aptamers in precision diagnostics, targeted therapy, and biosensing are also surveyed. Finally, we discuss current challenges and outline future directions toward closed-loop, interpretable AI frameworks for translational aptamer development. By synthesizing the latest computational and experimental advances, this Review aims to serve as a timely resource for researchers seeking to leverage AI for next-generation aptamer discovery.
zh_abstract: [Biotechnology advances] 通过指数富集配体系统进化（SELEX）进行的传统适配体发现通常受到文库容量有限、PCR偏倚和多轮筛选的制约。最近人工智能与适配体开发的融合正在推动从经验筛选向理性、数据驱动设计的范式转变。本综述及时且全面地概述了AI在整个适配体开发流程中的整合，特别强调了2024-2026年报道的进展。我们首先讨论用于高通量SELEX数据分析的生物信息学数据库和计算工具。然后，我们回顾二级和三级结构预测的最先进策略，包括最近的突破，如AlphaFold 3、RoseTTAFoldNA和基于扩散的方法。我们还涵盖了用于适配体-靶标相互作用预测、分子对接、动力学模拟和自由能计算的机器学习方法。一个主要焦点放在最新的AI驱动生成设计上，包括用于从头适配体生成和优化的扩散模型（AptaDiff）、基于语言模型的框架（InstructNA、GRAPE-LM）和强化学习方法（AiDTA）。还调查了AI设计的适配体在精准诊断、靶向治疗和生物传感中的新兴应用。最后，我们讨论了当前的挑战，并概述了面向转化适配体开发的闭环、可解释AI框架的未来方向。通过综合最新的计算和实验进展，本综述旨在为寻求利用AI进行下一代适配体发现的研究人员提供及时的参考资料。

title: Do Large Language Models Link to Incorrect Citations? A PubMed and DOI Benchmark.
zh_title: 大语言模型引用元数据不一致性基准评测
summary: 用30条内科提示词测试五个大模型快照共300条引用单元，检验其PMID、DOI与期刊等元数据是否相互矛盾。
key_points: 五个模型各答30条提示，共150条回答
26条提示要求引用，4条测试拒答
交叉核对PubMed与Crossref的PMID/DOI
reason: 设计规范的回顾性评测但样本仅150条回答，无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [Applied clinical informatics] BACKGROUND: Large language models can return citations whose PubMed Identifier (PMID), digital object identifier (DOI), title, and journal appear plausible but identify different papers. Checking one valid identifier may therefore fail to detect an incorrect citation bundle. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to measure citation metadata incoherence in responses from five large language model snapshots to an internal medicine prompt benchmark. METHODS: Five models answered 30 synthetic prompts each, producing 150 model-by-prompt responses. Twenty-six prompts per model requested citations, and four were designed to elicit abstention. A corrected parser extracted 300 citation units. We checked reported PMIDs against PubMed metadata, queried reported DOIs separately, and rechecked DOI strings not found in PubMed through Crossref. Response-level outcomes were primary because citation units were nested within responses. The author reviewed a deterministic stratified sample of 50 units for parser capture and citation identity. RESULTS: Among 130 citation-expected responses, 69 contained a DOI that resolved to a different PMID than the PMID supplied by the model, 100 contained at least one automated metadata mismatch, and 28 contained no citation. Those 100 were 69 DOI-PMID, 29 other, and 2 unresolvable. All 20 abstention trap responses abstained. Among 116 units whose reported DOI resolved in PubMed, 99 resolved to a different PMID and 17 to the reported PMID. Human review found correct parser capture in 48 of 50 sampled units. Two section boundary errors were corrected before the final rerun; the primary counts did not change. Human review classified 32 sampled units as incoherent, 7 as coherent, 6 as having an unresolvable PMID, and 5 as containing no citation. Clinical claim support was not assessed. CONCLUSION: Citation identity failures occurred in all five tested model snapshots. Evaluation and clinical evidence workflows should confirm that the PMID, DOI, title, and journal identify the same source before treating a model-supplied citation as evidence.
zh_abstract: [Applied clinical informatics] 【背景】大型语言模型可能返回引用，其PubMed标识符（PubMed Identifier, PMID）、数字对象标识符（digital object identifier, DOI）、标题和期刊看起来合理，但指向不同的论文。因此，检查一个有效标识符可能无法发现错误的引用组合。【目的】本研究旨在测量五个大型语言模型快照对内科提示基准的响应中的引用元数据不一致。【方法】五个模型各回答30个合成提示，产生150个模型-提示响应。每个模型有26个提示要求提供引用，4个提示旨在引发弃答。一个经过校正的解析器提取了300个引用单元。我们将报告的PMID与PubMed元数据进行核对，单独查询报告的DOI，并通过Crossref重新核查未在PubMed中找到的DOI字符串。响应层面的结局为主要结局，因为引用单元嵌套在响应内。作者审查了一个确定性分层样本，共50个单元，以检查解析器捕获和引用身份。【结果】在130个预期包含引用的响应中，69个包含一个DOI，其解析到的PMID与模型提供的PMID不同；100个包含至少一处自动化元数据不匹配；28个未包含引用。这100个中，69个为DOI-PMID，29个为其他，2个无法解析。所有20个弃答陷阱响应均弃答。在116个其报告DOI可在PubMed中解析的单元中，99个解析到不同的PMID，17个解析到所报告的PMID。人工审查发现，50个抽样单元中有48个解析器捕获正确。两个章节边界错误在最终重跑前得到纠正；主要计数未改变。人工审查将32个抽样单元归类为不一致，7个为一致，6个为具有无法解析的PMID，5个为未包含引用。未评估临床主张支持。【结论】引用身份失败在所有五个测试的模型快照中均发生。评估和临床证据工作流程应在将模型提供的引用视为证据之前，确认PMID、DOI、标题和期刊指向同一来源。

title: BigCell: Generating Gigapixel Whole-Slide Images
zh_title: BigCell：生成千兆像素全切片病理图像
summary: 预印本提出BigCell，在超12万张公开全切片图像上训练2048×2048流匹配Transformer，可生成原生千兆像素级连贯病理图像。
key_points: 首个按原生千兆像素生成全切片图像
训练于超12万张公开WSI、多器官
条件为病理基础模型嵌入

预印本，未经同行评审

abstract: Whole-slide images (WSIs) are gigapixel-scale digital scans of histopathology tissue and serve as the primary basis for cancer diagnosis. Existing histopathology generative models operate at the patch scale, producing fixed-size tiles of at most 1024times1024 pixels which encompass only a small fraction of the WSI. In contrast, text reports for clinical diagnoses and slide-level diagnostic labels -- the supervision that exists at scale -- operate at the whole-slide level. We present BigCell, the first approach to generate coherent whole-slide histopathology images at native gigapixel resolution. BigCell trains a flow-matching transformer at 2048times2048 pixels on over 120,000 publicly available WSIs spanning multiple organ types. Conditioning on embeddings from pathology foundation models and using an inference-time sliding-window pipeline, BigCell generates coherent images of up to 32,768times32,768 pixels, outperforming prior tile generators on both tile-level and slide-level fidelity metrics. To make gigapixel synthesis practical, we introduce an adaptive scheduling strategy that prioritizes important slide regions, speeding up image generation by over 3\ttimes with minimal quality degradation. Furthermore, we propose the first text-to-image synthesis at 8k resolution by training a separate model that produces dense conditioning grids directly from pathology text reports. We demonstrate that augmenting with synthetic samples improves slide-level few-shot classification performance by up to 18 % over baselines trained on real data.
zh_abstract: 全切片图像（WSIs）是组织病理学组织的十亿像素级数字扫描，并作为癌症诊断的主要基础。现有的组织病理学生成模型在图像块尺度上运行，生成至多 1024×1024 像素的固定尺寸图块，仅涵盖 WSI 的一小部分。相比之下，用于临床诊断的文本报告和切片级诊断标签——即大规模存在的监督信号——在全切片层面运作。我们提出 BigCell，这是首个以原生十亿像素分辨率生成连贯全切片组织病理学图像的方法。BigCell 在超过 120,000 张公开可用、涵盖多种器官类型的 WSI 上，以 2048×2048 像素训练一个流匹配 transformer。以病理基础模型的嵌入为条件，并使用推理时滑动窗口流水线，BigCell 生成高达 32,768×32,768 像素的连贯图像，在图像块级和切片级保真度指标上均优于先前的图块生成器。为使十亿像素合成变得实用，我们引入一种自适应调度策略，优先处理重要的切片区域，在质量下降极小的情况下将图像生成速度提高 3 倍以上。此外，我们通过训练一个单独模型，直接从病理文本报告生成密集条件网格，提出首个 8k 分辨率的文本到图像合成。我们证明，使用合成样本进行增强可将切片级少样本分类性能相较于在真实数据上训练的基线提高最多 18%。

title: Grounded ophthalmic AI beyond the electronic health record trap: a critical narrative review.
zh_title: 超越电子病历陷阱的眼科AI：批判性叙述综述
summary: BMJ子刊综述以眼科视觉语言模型为案例，指出糖尿病视网膜病变筛查AI虽在既定任务上成功，但临床解读不等于分类，仍有未解问题。

abstract: [BMJ health & care informatics] Electronic health records (EHRs) show that health information technology can digitise clinical work while increasing documentation burden, workflow rigidity and professional burnout. Artificial intelligence (AI) may enter a deeper layer of medicine than the EHR because it can draft summaries, interpret images, recommend follow-up and influence decisions. This critical narrative review uses ophthalmic vision-language models as a concrete case study. Diabetic retinopathy screening AI and lesion-level deep learning have achieved important successes in defined tasks, but clinical interpretation is not classification. A sentence such as ‘hard exudates have increased in the macula’ requires localisation of the fovea and macula, lesion segmentation, longitudinal registration, change quantification and faithful language generation. We argue that the unresolved informatics challenge is grounded in clinical interpretation: the auditable translation of images into finding-location-change triples that remain inspectable by clinicians. The article proposes a three-layer architecture: globally standardised objective observation, explicit local policy and workflow adaptation and clinician-authored AI operations governed by safety gates. Customisation should not be monetised as bespoke vendor work; it should be a safety function built into procurement, audit and lifecycle regulation. The three-layer architecture is a conceptual governance framework derived from published evidence rather than a prospectively validated implementation, and we specify the observable failure modes and metrics that would refute it. Ophthalmology illustrates the broader design principle for medical AI: automation should make evidence more visible, not convert care into another opaque information-processing layer.
zh_abstract: [BMJ health & care informatics] 电子健康记录（Electronic Health Records, EHRs）表明，卫生信息技术可以使临床工作数字化，同时增加文档负担、工作流程僵化和职业倦怠。人工智能（Artificial Intelligence, AI）可能比 EHR 进入医学更深层次，因为它可以起草摘要、解读图像、推荐随访并影响决策。这篇批判性叙事综述以眼科视觉-语言模型作为具体案例研究。糖尿病视网膜病变筛查 AI 和病灶级深度学习已在界定明确的任务中取得重要成功，但临床解读不是分类。诸如“黄斑区硬性渗出增多”这样的句子，需要定位中央凹和黄斑、病灶分割、纵向配准、变化量化和忠实的语言生成。我们认为，尚未解决的信息学挑战根植于临床解读：将图像可审计地转化为临床医生仍可检查的“发现-位置-变化”三元组。本文提出一种三层架构：全球标准化的客观观察，明确的本地政策和工作流程适配，以及由临床医生编写、受安全门控管理的 AI 操作。定制化不应被货币化为供应商的定制工作；它应成为内置于采购、审计和生命周期监管中的安全功能。该三层架构是一个源自已发表证据的概念性治理框架，而非经过前瞻性验证的实施；我们指明了可观察的失效模式以及可反驳该框架的指标。眼科阐释了医学 AI 的更广泛设计原则：自动化应使证据更可见，而不是将医疗照护转化为另一个不透明的信息处理层。

title: Artificial intelligence-based prediction of cerebrospinal fluid leak in skull base surgery: a scoping review.
source: PubMed · European archives of oto-rhino-laryngology : official journal of the European Federation of Oto-Rhino-Laryngological Societies (EUFOS) : affiliated with the German Society for Oto-Rhino-Laryngology - Head and Neck Surgery
zh_title: AI预测颅底手术脑脊液漏：范围综述
summary: 范围综述汇总AI模型预测颅底手术脑脊液漏的数据来源、建模方法、验证策略与性能，指出证据异质性明显。
key_points: 关注内镜经鼻与经蝶窦手术并发症
总结数据来源、建模与验证策略
指出现有证据方法学异质性大
reason: 范围综述，综述类最高6分档，无原始数据
abstract: [European archives of oto-rhino-laryngology : official journal of the European Federation of Oto-Rhino-Laryngological Societies (EUFOS) : affiliated with the German Society for Oto-Rhino-Laryngology - Head and Neck Surgery] Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) leak remains one of the most significant complications of skull base surgery, particularly in endoscopic endonasal and transsphenoidal approaches. Accurate risk stratification may improve surgical planning and reconstruction strategies. Artificial intelligence (AI)-based models have been increasingly investigated for CSF leak prediction; however, the evidence remains methodologically heterogeneous. This scoping review aimed to map the current literature and summarize data sources, modeling approaches, validation strategies, and reported performance. This scoping review followed PRISMA-ScR guidance. Eligibility was structured using the Population-Concept-Context framework. PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science were searched for English-language studies published from 2019 to 2025. Two authors independently screened titles/abstracts and full texts and independently charted data using a standardized table; disagreements were resolved by consensus. Eligible original human studies applied AI/ML to predict perioperative surgical CSF leak or to derive an imaging biomarker for identifying spontaneous lateral skull-base CSF leak/encephalocele relevant to surgical assessment. No formal protocol was prepared or registered. Fifty-five records were identified, and nine primary studies met the eligibility criteria after duplicate removal and full-text assessment. Six studies predicted intraoperative CSF leak, two predicted postoperative leak, and one evaluated a deep-learning-derived CT biomarker for identifying spontaneous lateral skull-base CSF leak or encephalocele relevant to surgical assessment. Three studies used classical machine-learning methods, four used predominantly deep neural-network or convolutional-neural-network approaches, one compared classical models with a feedforward neural network, and one used a BERT-based natural-language-processing model. One study reported prospective temporal validation; none reported independent external validation at another institution. Among studies reporting AUC, values ranged from 0.69 to 1.00; accuracy, where reported, ranged from 70% to 98.33%. AI-based prediction of CSF leak is a promising but evolving field. Methodological heterogeneity and the absence of independent external validation constrain clinical translation. Future studies should prioritize standardized outcomes, multicenter datasets, and prospective validation to support integration into clinical decision-making.
zh_abstract: 【欧洲耳鼻咽喉头颈外科档案：欧洲耳鼻咽喉头颈外科学会联合会（EUFOS）官方期刊：与德国耳鼻咽喉头颈外科学会合作】脑脊液（CSF）漏仍然是颅底手术最重要的并发症之一，尤其是在内镜经鼻和经蝶入路中。准确的风险分层可能改善手术规划和重建策略。基于人工智能（AI）的模型在CSF漏预测方面受到越来越多的研究；然而，证据在方法学上仍存在异质性。本范围综述旨在梳理当前文献，并总结数据来源、建模方法、验证策略和已报告的性能。本范围综述遵循PRISMA-ScR指南。纳入标准采用人群-概念-情境（Population-Concept-Context）框架构建。检索了PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus和Web of Science，以查找2019年至2025年发表的英文研究。两名作者独立筛选题目/摘要和全文，并使用标准化表格独立提取数据；分歧通过共识解决。符合条件的人类原始研究为：应用AI/ML预测围手术期手术性CSF漏，或推导用于识别与手术评估相关的自发性侧颅底CSF漏/脑膨出的影像学生物标志物。未制定或注册正式方案。共识别出55条记录，去除重复并进行全文评估后，9项原始研究符合纳入标准。6项研究预测术中CSF漏，2项预测术后漏，1项评估深度学习衍生的CT生物标志物，用于识别与手术评估相关的自发性侧颅底CSF漏或脑膨出。3项研究使用经典机器学习方法，4项主要使用深度神经网络或卷积神经网络方法，1项将经典模型与前馈神经网络进行比较，1项使用基于BERT的自然语言处理模型。1项研究报告了前瞻性时间验证；无一项报告在其他机构的独立外部验证。在报告AUC的研究中，数值范围为0.69至1.00；在报告准确率的研究中，准确率范围为70 %至98.33 %。基于AI的CSF漏预测是一个有前景但仍在不断发展的领域。方法学异质性以及缺乏独立外部验证限制了临床转化。未来研究应优先采用标准化结局、多中心数据集和前瞻性验证，以支持其整合到临床决策中。

title: Deep learning-based metal artifact reduction in CT for head and neck radiotherapy.
source: PubMed · Physics and imaging in radiation oncology
zh_title: 头颈放疗CT深度学习金属伪影减少的系统综述
summary: 系统综述评估头颈放疗CT中深度学习金属伪影减少方法的技术进展与临床剂量学验证。
key_points: 检索227条记录，纳入40项研究
含11项传统MAR与29项DL-MAR研究
强调放疗剂量学验证而非仅图像质量
reason: PRISMA系统综述纳入40项研究，但无新外部验证数据，属值得一看档
abstract: [Physics and imaging in radiation oncology] Metal artifacts from dental fillings and implants compromise CT image quality, target delineation, and dose calculation accuracy in head and neck (H&N) radiotherapy. Previous reviews have largely focused on traditional metal artifact reduction methods and image quality metrics rather than radiotherapy-specific endpoints. This systematic review evaluates deep learning-based metal artifact reduction (DL-MAR) approaches for H&N radiotherapy, emphasizing technical advances and clinical dosimetric validation. Following PRISMA guidelines, PubMed, IEEE Xplore, and Scopus were systematically searched (updated April 2026) for studies assessing DL-MAR methods in H&N CT imaging and radiotherapy. Of 227 identified records, 40 studies (11 traditional MAR and 29 DL-MAR studies) met the inclusion criteria. Reported DL architectures included convolutional neural networks, generative adversarial networks, dual-domain networks, diffusion models, and task-oriented loss functions. Among studies with clinical dosimetric validation, GAN-based and task-oriented approaches consistently reported dose deviations below 3%. Gamma pass rates exceeding 95% (3%/3 mm) were reported in a subset of these studies. Dual-domain and diffusion-based methods were evaluated primarily using image quality metrics without direct radiotherapy-specific dosimetric validation. Current evidence suggests that DL-MAR may achieve clinically acceptable dosimetric accuracy while improving artifact suppression and target visualization in H&N radiotherapy planning. Task-oriented loss functions currently demonstrate promising potential for clinical translation based on available retrospective evidence. Broader clinical implementation remains limited by reliance on synthetic training data, restricted access to sinogram data, and the absence of prospective multicenter validation studies.
zh_abstract: [Physics and imaging in radiation oncology] 牙科填充物和植入物产生的金属伪影会损害头颈部（H&N）放疗中的CT图像质量、靶区勾画和剂量计算准确性。既往综述在很大程度上聚焦于传统金属伪影减少方法和图像质量指标，而非放疗特异性终点。本系统综述评估用于H&N放疗的基于深度学习的金属伪影减少（DL-MAR）方法，重点强调技术进展和临床剂量学校验。遵循PRISMA指南，系统检索了PubMed、IEEE Xplore和Scopus（更新至2026年4月），以纳入评估H&N CT成像和放疗中DL-MAR方法的研究。在227条识别到的记录中，40项研究（11项传统MAR研究和29项DL-MAR研究）符合纳入标准。报告的DL架构包括卷积神经网络、生成对抗网络、双域网络、扩散模型和任务导向损失函数。在具有临床剂量学校验的研究中，基于GAN和任务导向的方法一致报告剂量偏差低于3%。其中一部分研究报告了超过95%（3%/3 mm）的伽马通过率。双域和基于扩散的方法主要使用图像质量指标进行评估，而没有直接进行放疗特异性剂量学校验。当前证据表明，DL-MAR可能在H&N放疗计划中实现临床可接受的剂量学准确性，同时改善伪影抑制和靶区可视化。基于现有回顾性证据，任务导向损失函数目前显示出有前景的临床转化潜力。更广泛的临床实施仍受限于对合成训练数据的依赖、正弦图数据获取受限以及缺乏前瞻性多中心验证研究。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Triage in Primary Care: A Scoping Review of Clinical Applicability.
source: PubMed · International journal of medical informatics
zh_title: 初级保健分诊AI的临床适用性：范围综述
summary: 范围综述纳入17项研究，梳理初级保健分诊AI系统的特征、性能、验证方式与临床适用性。
key_points: 纳入17项研究，发表于2013至2026年
覆盖12个国家，其中14项来自高收入国家
14/17为面向临床医生的决策支持系统
reason: 范围综述、17项研究，属综述类最高6分档，取中位
abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] To map artificial intelligence (AI) systems developed for triage in primary care and describe their characteristics, performance and clinical applicability. A scoping review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA-ScR. PubMed, MEDLINE (via Ovid), Embase, Web of Science, CINAHL (via EBSCOhost), IEEE Xplore and the ACM Digital Library were searched until March 14th 2026. Two reviewers independently screened studies and extracted data on system characteristics, triage function, performance, validation, safety, equity and implementation. Each system was charted by triage function and by whether it was patient-facing, clinician-facing or fully automated. Seventeen studies were included, published between 2013 and 2026 across 12 countries (14/17 high-income). Most were clinician-facing decision support (14/17), three had a patient-facing component and none were autonomous. Diagnostic or screening triage was the most common function (n = 7), followed by prioritisation (n = 4) and referral routing (n = 4). Only two performed urgency classification or self-triage. As a clinician aid, AI improved performance (fundus accuracy 82.8 % to 91.1 %; dermoscopy management sensitivity 72.9 % to 94.2 %), but standalone models sometimes fell below clinicians. Reported accuracy ranged from 41.2 % to 98.28 % and AUROC from 0.65 to 0.90, on heterogeneous outcomes. Validation was mostly internal (11/17), external in four. None reported a prospective randomised comparison or measured patient outcomes. AI triage in primary care is concentrated on clinician-facing diagnostic and referral tasks and is most valuable for augmenting clinician workflows, particularly non-specialists. The evidence base remains immature, constrained by internal validation, unreliable reference standards, sparse equity assessment and absent prospective outcome data. Future work should prioritise prospective, outcome-anchored evaluation, with attention to safety and equity.
zh_abstract: 【国际医学信息学杂志】旨在梳理为基层医疗分诊开发的人工智能（AI）系统，并描述其特征、性能和临床适用性。按照PRISMA-ScR开展了范围综述。检索了PubMed、MEDLINE（通过Ovid）、Embase、Web of Science、CINAHL（通过EBSCOhost）、IEEE Xplore和ACM Digital Library，检索截止至2026年3月14日。两名评价者独立筛选研究，并提取关于系统特征、分诊功能、性能、验证、安全性、公平性和实施的数据。每个系统均按分诊功能以及属于面向患者、面向临床医生还是完全自动化进行归类。共纳入17项研究，发表于2013年至2026年间，覆盖12个国家（14/17为高收入国家）。大多数为面向临床医生的决策支持（14/17），3项包含面向患者的组成部分，无一项为自主运行。诊断性或筛查性分诊是最常见的功能（n = 7），其次是优先排序（n = 4）和转诊路径分流（n = 4）。仅有两项执行紧急程度分类或自我分诊。作为临床医生的辅助工具，AI提升了性能（眼底准确率从82.8 %提高到91.1 %；皮肤镜检查管理敏感度从72.9 %提高到94.2 %），但独立模型有时低于临床医生。在异质性结局中，报告的准确率范围为41.2 %至98.28 %，AUROC为0.65至0.90。验证多为内部验证（11/17），4项为外部验证。无一项报告前瞻性随机比较或测量患者结局。基层医疗中的AI分诊集中于面向临床医生的诊断和转诊任务，其最大价值在于增强临床医生的工作流程，尤其是非专科医生。证据基础仍不成熟，受限于内部验证、参考标准不可靠、公平性评估稀少以及缺乏前瞻性结局数据。未来工作应优先开展前瞻性、以结局为锚定的评价，并关注安全性和公平性。

title: Artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled RNA therapeutic design: from molecular optimization to system-level evaluation.
zh_title: AI驱动的RNA治疗设计：从分子优化到系统级评估
summary: 综述从分子优化与系统级评估衔接的视角，梳理RNA语言模型、生成模型与结构感知学习在RNA治疗设计中的进展。
key_points: 涵盖RNA语言模型与生成模型进展
比较siRNA、ASO、适配体、mRNA等约束
指出分子性质不等于生物学疗效
reason: 同行评审综述，梳理方向清晰但属综述类，按标准最高6分。
abstract: [British journal of pharmacology] RNA therapeutics are increasingly moving from empirical screening towards rational, computation-guided design. Recent advances in RNA language models, generative models and structure-aware learning have improved sequence representation, candidate generation and structure-constrained optimization. However, favourable molecular properties do not necessarily translate into desirable biological performance, because therapeutic outcomes also depend on modality-specific mechanisms, delivery and exposure, molecular interactions, cellular state, immune responses and network-level adaptation. Here, we review AI-enabled RNA therapeutic design through the specific lens of the interface between molecular optimization and system-level evaluation. We compare the design constraints of siRNAs, antisense oligonucleotides, aptamers, mRNAs and translation-oriented circRNAs, and examine the capabilities and current limitations of sequence-, generative- and structure-based computational models. We further discuss the data resources and perturbation representations required to connect molecular candidates with broader cellular-response models. In this context, virtual cells are considered as approximate computational frameworks for candidate prioritization and risk-oriented system-level assessment rather than complete digital replicas of living cells. Finally, we outline a conceptual generation-simulation-feedback-optimization framework for integrating molecular design with progressively higher-level evaluation. This perspective emphasizes the need for better interfaces among RNA design, pharmacological context and cellular-response modelling, rather than relying on molecular optimization alone.
zh_abstract: [British journal of pharmacology] RNA疗法正日益从经验性筛选转向理性的、计算引导的设计。RNA语言模型（RNA language models）、生成模型（generative models）和结构感知学习（structure-aware learning）的最新进展改善了序列表示、候选生成和结构约束优化。然而，有利的分子性质并不一定转化为理想的生物学表现，因为治疗结果还取决于模态特异性机制、递送和暴露、分子相互作用、细胞状态、免疫反应和网络层面适应。在此，我们通过分子优化与系统级评估之间接口这一特定视角，综述AI赋能的RNA治疗设计。我们比较siRNA、反义寡核苷酸（antisense oligonucleotides）、适配体（aptamers）、mRNA和面向翻译的circRNA的设计约束，并考察基于序列、生成式以及基于结构的计算模型的能力及当前局限性。我们进一步讨论将分子候选物与更广泛的细胞反应模型连接所需的数据资源和扰动表示。在此背景下，虚拟细胞（virtual cells）被视为用于候选优先排序和面向风险的系统级评估的近似计算框架，而非活细胞的完整数字复制品。最后，我们概述一个概念性的生成-模拟-反馈-优化框架，用于将分子设计与逐步更高层级的评估整合起来。这一观点强调需要在RNA设计、药理学语境和细胞反应建模之间建立更好的接口，而不是仅依赖分子优化。

title: Auxiliary modalities add no detectable discrimination or calibration over structured EHR for 30-day COPD readmission: evidence from a leakage-audited MIMIC-IV cohort
zh_title: COPD再入院预测：辅助模态未超结构化EHR
summary: 预印本在经时序泄漏审计的MIMIC-IV COPD队列中发现，心电图、胸片、临床文本等辅助模态对30天再入院预测的区分度与校准无额外提升。
key_points: MIMIC-IV队列n=1279，再入院比例约50%
比较朴素拼接等三种融合架构
对入院链接流程做了时序泄漏审计与修正
reason: 回顾性单数据集阴性结果，含泄漏审计，无外部验证，属值得一看上限
abstract: Background: Hospital readmission is a common and costly outcome in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Multimodal deep learning models combining structured electronic health record (EHR) data with physiological, imaging, and textual data have been proposed to improve its prediction, but whether such fusion outperforms EHR data alone, once temporal-leakage safeguards are applied, remains unclear. Methods: Using a stratified MIMIC-IV cohort of COPD patients enriched to about 50% readmission (natural prevalence 18.1%; n=1,279; 895/192/192 training/validation/test), we predicted 30-day, all-cause readmission from four frozen, pre-trained encoders (electrocardiogram, chest radiograph, clinical notes, structured EHR). We audited and corrected temporal leakage in the admission-linkage pipeline of each modality, then compared three fusion architectures (naive concatenation, scalar gated fusion, EHR-anchored residual fusion) against unimodal baselines and an EHR-alone reference, using bootstrap significance testing, a missingness stress test, and calibration analysis with and without post-hoc recalibration. Results: The audit corrected three previously undetected temporal-alignment issues, affecting 5-9% of patients for clinical notes, 29-43% for chest radiographs, and 53-58% for ECG. After correction, every modality except EHR showed near-chance discrimination alone (ROC-AUC 0.46-0.53), confirmed with a non-linear adapter probe. No fusion architecture significantly outperformed the EHR-alone baseline (ROC-AUC 0.63); removing auxiliary modalities improved rather than degraded fusion performance under stress testing. The raw Brier score was lower for all three fusion architectures than for EHR-alone (about 0.24 versus 0.32), but this reflected overconfidence of the EHR-alone probe (calibration slope 0.12); after logistic recalibration fitted on the validation set, Brier scores were indistinguishable (EHR-alone 0.239; fusion 0.240-0.244; all paired bootstrap 95% CIs included zero). Conclusions: Structured EHR data alone matched the discrimination and, after recalibration, the calibration of more complex multimodal fusion for 30-day COPD readmission prediction. These findings highlight the importance of rigorous temporal-leakage auditing in multimodal clinical prediction research and suggest that reformulating this task around temporal proximity to the outcome, rather than refining the fusion mechanism further, may be more productive for future
zh_abstract: 【背景】医院再入院是慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者中常见且代价高昂的结局。结合结构化电子健康记录（EHR）数据与生理、影像和文本数据的多模态深度学习模型已被提出用于改善其预测，但在应用时间泄漏防护措施后，这种融合是否优于仅使用 EHR 数据仍不清楚。【方法】使用一个分层 MIMIC-IV COPD 患者队列，富集至约 50% 再入院（自然患病率 18.1%；n=1,279；895/192/192 为训练/验证/测试），我们基于四个冻结的预训练编码器（心电图、胸片、临床笔记、结构化 EHR）预测 30 天全因再入院。我们审计并纠正了每种模态入院链接流程中的时间泄漏，然后比较三种融合架构（朴素拼接、标量门控融合、以 EHR 为锚的残差融合）与单模态基线及仅 EHR 参考，使用自助法（bootstrap）显著性检验、缺失值压力测试，以及有和无事后重校准的校准分析。【结果】审计纠正了三个此前未被发现的时间对齐问题，影响临床笔记 5-9% 的患者、胸片 29-43% 的患者和 ECG 53-58% 的患者。校正后，除 EHR 外，每种模态单独使用时均表现出接近随机的区分能力（ROC-AUC 0.46-0.53），并由非线性适配器探针确认。没有融合架构显著优于仅 EHR 基线（ROC-AUC 0.63）；在压力测试下，移除辅助模态改善而非降低融合性能。原始 Brier 分数在三个融合架构中均低于仅 EHR（约 0.24 对 0.32），但这反映了仅 EHR 探针的过度自信（校准斜率 0.12）；在验证集上拟合逻辑重校准后，Brier 分数无法区分（仅 EHR 0.239；融合 0.240-0.244；所有配对 bootstrap 95% CI 均包含零）。【结论】仅结构化 EHR 数据在 30 天 COPD 再入院预测中，其区分能力与更复杂的多模态融合相当，并在重校准后其校准也相当。这些发现凸显了在多模态临床预测研究中严格进行时间泄漏审计的重要性，并提示围绕与结局的时间接近性重新表述这一任务，而非进一步改进融合机制，可能对未来更有成效

title: Constructed Negatives Shape the Evaluation of Sequence-Based Protein--Protein Interaction Models
zh_title: 负样本构造方式影响序列型蛋白互作模型评测
summary: 研究发现，仅改变测试负样本的构造方式即可使序列型蛋白互作模型的AUPRC波动达0.26，并改变最优架构排序。
key_points: 固定正样本、蛋白不重叠划分与类别平衡，仅变负样本
六种负样本构造 × 四个序列模型（三个用蛋白语言模型）
只换测试负样本，AUPRC 变化最高达 0.26

reason: 预印本方法学分析，无外部验证与临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Many machine-learning tasks, including representation learning, rely on negative examples that are constructed rather than directly observed. This issue is especially important for protein--protein interaction (PPI) prediction, where experimentally established non-interactions are scarce. PPI models are therefore commonly trained and evaluated against sampled, unobserved protein pairs treated as negatives. We study how this construction affects model comparison. Keeping positives, protein-disjoint splits, class balance, and model selection fixed, we vary training and evaluation negatives independently across six constructions and four sequence-based models, three of which use protein language model (pLM) representations. Changing only the test negatives shifts AUPRC by up to 0.26, and the top-ranked architecture changes with the construction. Negatives matched to true partners in pLM representation space reduce all pLM-based models to near-chance performance, and shuffling partners within each class shows that the original pairing contributes little to AUROC. Constructed training negatives rarely outperform uniform sampling: on external data, they underperform it in 108 of 120 comparisons for the pLM-based models, with gains never exceeding 0.05 AUROC and losses up to 0.23. We release splits, negative-generation procedures, and evaluation code that allow training and evaluation negatives to be varied separately. Our results show that with constructed negatives, model comparisons are not just noisy but systematically sensitive to how negatives are defined, a methodological choice that is often left implicit.
zh_abstract: 许多机器学习任务，包括表示学习，依赖于构建而非直接观察到的负例。这个问题对于蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）预测尤为重要，因为实验确立的非相互作用十分稀缺。因此，PPI 模型通常使用采样、未观察到的蛋白质对作为负例进行训练和评估。我们研究这种构建方式如何影响模型比较。在保持正例、蛋白质不相交划分、类别平衡和模型选择不变的情况下，我们在六种构建方式和四个基于序列的模型之间独立改变训练负例和评估负例，其中三个模型使用蛋白质语言模型（pLM）表示。仅改变测试负例就会使 AUPRC 变化高达 0.26，且排名最高的架构会随构建方式而改变。在 pLM 表示空间中与真实伙伴匹配的负例使所有基于 pLM 的模型降至接近随机的性能，而在每个类别内打乱伙伴表明原始配对对 AUROC 贡献很小。构建的训练负例很少优于均匀采样：在外部数据上，对于基于 pLM 的模型，它们在 120 次比较中有 108 次表现不如均匀采样，增益从未超过 0.05 AUROC，损失高达 0.23。我们发布了划分、负例生成流程和评估代码，允许分别改变训练负例和评估负例。我们的结果表明，使用构建的负例时，模型比较不仅存在噪声，而且对负例定义方式具有系统性敏感，而这一方法论选择常常被隐式保留。

title: inClinico Agent for clinical trial endpoint prediction and prospective evaluation
zh_title: inClinico智能体：临床试验终点预测与前瞻评估
summary: 用注册时特征的机器学习系统预测I–IV期试验成败，输出0–1预测试验指数，并进行前瞻评估。
key_points: 按疗效与安全性终点分别建模
仅用注册时特征避免结果泄漏

reason: 含前瞻性评估与外部测试集，但为预印本且信息有限，6档
abstract: High attrition rates across clinical drug development impose immense clinical and financial burdens, yet prospectively forecasting whether an individual trial will achieve its primary endpoint remains challenging. Here we present a machine-learning system that predicts clinical trial success across phases I-IV, independently modeling studies with efficacy versus safety/toxicity primary endpoints. To prevent lookahead bias and outcome leakage, models are trained on registration-time features, including target and mechanism-of-action precedent, drug modality and novelty, trial design and operational characteristics, and frozen literature-derived target-choice embeddings. Each prediction yields a continuous Predictive Trial Index (PTI) between 0 and 1 reflecting success probability. On a test set of trials initiated in 2021 or later, the efficacy model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.828 (95% CI 0.812-0.845; n = 2,347) and the safety/toxicity model reached 0.809 (95% CI 0.787-0.831; n = 1,485). These models are embedded in inClinico Agent, an agentic AI system integrating frontier large language models (LLMs) with deterministic scoring engines, retrieval tools and specialized clinical skills. We also introduce ClinBench, a prospective benchmark of 2,040 ongoing trials evaluated by inClinico Agent and five frontier LLMs, establishing a leakage-free foundation for tracking prospective predictive accuracy as trials reach completion.
zh_abstract: 临床药物开发中的高流失率带来了巨大的临床和经济负担，但前瞻性预测单个试验能否达到其主要终点仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出一个机器学习系统，可预测 I-IV 期临床试验成功，并分别对以疗效为主要终点与以安全性/毒性为主要终点的研究建模。为防止前视偏倚和结局泄漏，模型基于注册时特征进行训练，包括靶点与作用机制先例、药物模态与新颖性、试验设计与运营特征，以及冻结的文献衍生靶点选择嵌入。每个预测产生一个 0 到 1 之间的连续预测试验指数（Predictive Trial Index，PTI），反映成功概率。在 2021 年或之后启动的试验测试集上，疗效模型的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为 0.828（95% CI 0.812-0.845；n = 2,347），安全性/毒性模型达到 0.809（95% CI 0.787-0.831；n = 1,485）。这些模型嵌入 inClinico Agent，这是一个智能体式 AI 系统，将前沿大语言模型（LLMs）与确定性评分引擎、检索工具和专业临床技能集成。我们还推出 ClinBench，一个由 inClinico Agent 和五个前沿 LLM 评估的 2,040 项正在进行的试验的前瞻性基准，为在试验完成时追踪前瞻性预测准确性建立了无泄漏基础。

abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate differential diagnoses for complex cases, but a useful second opinion must also be factually grounded, clinically coherent, actionable, and safe. We developed a multidimensional benchmark using 300 diagnostically resolved NEJM--MedQA cases: 110 for physician reference ratings and Judge calibration and 190 for held-out evaluation. A physician-calibrated LLM Judge evaluated 3,040 final reports and the corresponding structured primary-role outputs. Model identity separated report quality more strongly than response format. title: Beyond Sparse Captions: Aligning Slide-Level Text and Patch-Level Vision in Pathology

abstract: Contrastive vision-language (VL) pretraining in computational pathology has generally relied on curated image-caption datasets sourced from social media, educational videos, and research publications. These corpora are sparse relative to the diversity of tissue morphology and difficult to scale further, as pathologists do not routinely produce descriptive captions in clinical practice. We propose to instead leverage slide-level pathology reports which can be generated during routine diagnostic workflows in a scalable manner. A key challenge in this weakly-supervised setting is that pathology reports describe macroscopic, diagnostic findings while patch-level visual features describe microscopic findings. zh_abstract: 计算病理学中的对比视觉-语言（VL）预训练通常依赖于来自社交媒体、教育视频和研究出版物的精选图像-标题数据集。相对于组织形态的多样性，这些语料库是稀疏的，并且难以进一步扩展，因为在临床实践中病理学家不会常规生成描述性标题。我们提出转而利用切片级病理报告，这些报告可以在常规诊断工作流程中以可扩展的方式生成。在这种弱监督设置中的一个关键挑战是，病理报告描述宏观诊断发现，而 patch 级视觉特征描述微观发现。我们引入锁定图像多实例预训练（Locked Image Multiple Instance PreTraining，LIMIT），它通过冻结预训练视觉编码器并仅微调文本编码器来解决这一差距：报告嵌入

We apply mechanistic interpretability to locate one such mechanism in ViT-Base 16: a single attention head (L8H10) that functions as a dedicated annotation-reader on chest X-rays, attending to corner text rather than lung pathology in 62% of 200 COVID-19 images. The finding replicates across NIH ChestX-ray14 (79%), DeiT-Base (88%), and ViT-Large 16 (80%), establishing spurious annotation-attending heads as a consistent property of ViT-family architectures across two datasets and three architectures. We harmonize VinDr-CXR and PediCXR into a five-label classification task and evaluate six foundation models and two CNN baselines. All models are adapted using adult data only and tested in both the in-domain and pediatric domains using linear probing, partial fine-tuning, and full fine-tuning. The benchmark reveals a clear and consistent trend: all models suffer a substantial performance degr

title: Dual-graph deconvolution of enzyme fitness: an interpretable framework to identify and explain catalytic modulators
zh_title: 酶适应度的双图反卷积：可解释催化调节因子框架
summary: 预印本提出结合稳定性预测与共进化概率图模型的双图框架，分离酶活性效应并识别催化调节因子。
key_points: 混合稳定性预测与共进化图模型
分离稳定性无关的酶活性效应
揭示并实验验证生物物理通信通路
reason: 新可解释框架并有实验验证，预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Models trained on protein sequences can predict mutational effects, but their outputs represent a convolution of different phenotypes. Isolating stability-independent activity effects is essential for rational enzyme design, allosteric drug design and functional annotation, yet existing pLM-based deconvolution methods lack interpretability. Here, we introduce a hybrid framework that pairs stability predictors with probabilistic graphical models of coevolution. Benchmarked on all enzymes with available multidimensional deep mutational scanning data, our framework isolates stability-independent activity effects with a fidelity that matches analogous pLM-based approaches. Crucially, we reveal biophysically plausible communication pathways that align with previous knowledge and that we validate with experimental data across a diverse set of targets. This hybrid approach merges statistical and geometric deep learning into a zero-shot, explainable tool for targeted engineering and mechanistic discovery.
zh_abstract: 在蛋白质序列上训练的模型可以预测突变效应，但其输出代表不同表型的卷积。分离不依赖于稳定性的活性效应对理性酶设计、变构药物设计和功能注释至关重要，然而现有的基于pLM的解卷积方法缺乏可解释性。在此，我们引入一个混合框架，将稳定性预测器与共进化的概率图模型配对。在具有可用多维深度突变扫描数据的所有酶上进行基准测试，我们的框架以与类似基于pLM的方法相匹配的保真度分离出不依赖于稳定性的活性效应。至关重要的是，我们揭示了与先前知识一致的、生物物理学上合理的通讯通路，并在多样化的靶标集合上用实验数据进行了验证。这种混合方法将统计深度学习和几何深度学习融合为一个零样本、可解释的工具，用于靶向工程和机制发现。

title: FPG-Seg: Annotation-free Retinal Vessel Topology Segmentation
zh_title: FPG-Seg：无需标注的视网膜血管拓扑分割
summary: 预印本提出无标注流程，结合血管滤波、贝叶斯深度学习和拓扑图重建分割视网膜血管。

reason: 无标注方法多基准评估，预印本，值得一看
abstract: State-of-the art approaches to retinal vessel segmentation typically require extensive annotations, a highly time-consuming process, reliant on clinical expertise. We present FPG-Seg, an annotation-free pipeline for retinal vessel segmentation combining classical vesselness filtering, Bayesian deep learning and topology-aware graph reconstruction to segment retinal vessel topology without manual labels. Tested across four widely used benchmark datasets for retinal vessel segmentation, FPG-Seg attains a clDice of $0.74{-}0.78$, representing $86{-}98\%$ of the performance of an equivalent fully-supervised baseline, despite using no manual annotations for training or hyperparameter tuning. As part of this work, we also provide, to our knowledge, the first performance benchmark of an annotation-free vessel segmentation method on FIVES.
zh_abstract: 视网膜血管分割的最先进方法通常需要大量标注，这是一个高度耗时且依赖临床专业知识的流程。我们提出FPG-Seg，一个无需标注的视网膜血管分割流程，结合经典血管性滤波、贝叶斯深度学习和拓扑感知图重建，在无手动标签的情况下分割视网膜血管拓扑。在四个广泛使用的视网膜血管分割基准数据集上测试，FPG-Seg达到$0.74{-}0.78$的clDice，相当于等效全监督基线性能的$86{-}98\%$，尽管在训练或超参数调优中未使用任何手动标注。作为本工作的一部分，我们还提供了据我们所知首个无需标注的血管分割方法在FIVES上的性能基准。

title: DischargeBench: Pre-Deployment Evaluation of LLM Discharge Educators through Persona-Grounded Patient Simulation
zh_title: DischargeBench：出院教育的LLM部署前评测基准
summary: 构建基于患者人设模拟的多轮对话基准，用于在真实患者接触前评测LLM出院教育能力。

reason: 新发布的评测基准与数据集，规模中等且为模拟患者，属值得一看档
abstract: Effective discharge education is personalized: a clinician adapts the discharge plan to each patient's literacy, recall, and personality. Before large language models (LLMs) take on this role with real patients, they need to be evaluated in conversations with diverse patients, yet existing evaluations target static, artifact-generation, or question-answering tasks. We introduce **DischargeBench**, a pre-deployment benchmark in which a candidate LLM educator teaches a persona-grounded simulated patient in an open-ended, multi-turn conversation. We curate **MIMIC-IV-Ext-DischargeBench**, 320 cases across 16 ICD chapters, each paired with a patient persona that varies personality, education level, health literacy, and recall. Each conversation is scored on Conversation Quality, Topic Checklist Score (TCS), Simulated Comprehension Score (SCS), and a Claim-Level Safety Audit (CLSA) by an LLM
zh_abstract: 有效的出院教育是个性化的：临床医生会根据每位患者的读写能力、记忆力和个性来调整出院计划。在大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）与真实患者承担这一角色之前，需要在与多样化患者的对话中对它们进行评估，然而现有的评估针对的是静态任务、工件生成任务或问答任务。我们提出 **DischargeBench**，一个部署前基准，其中候选 LLM 教育者在开放式、多轮对话中教导一个基于人物设定的模拟患者。我们整理了 **MIMIC-IV-Ext-DischargeBench**，包含 16 个 ICD 章节的 320 个案例，每个案例都配有一个患者人物设定，其在个性、教育水平、健康素养和记忆力方面各不相同。每段对话由 LLM 根据对话质量（Conversation Quality）、主题清单得分（Topic Checklist Score, TCS）、模拟理解得分（Simulated Comprehension Score, SCS）和声明级安全审计（Claim-Level Safety Audit, CLSA）进行评分。

title: TimeCap: A Scalable Open-Source Pipeline for Captioning Wearable Health Time-Series Data
zh_title: TimeCap：可穿戴健康时序数据开源标注流水线
summary: 发布开源确定性时间序列描述生成流水线TimeCap，为可穿戴健康等时序数据提供可复现的文本标注。

abstract: Time-series data generated continuously across industrial, environmental, and especially health domains produce multimodal signals whose scale and heterogeneity make their processing and interpretation particularly challenging. Time-Series Language Models (TSLMs) promise scalable interpretation of these signals, yet remain bottlenecked by a fundamental lack of text-annotated time series pairs that are signal-grounded, reproducible, and extensible across modalities and schemas. Existing paired corpora are either closed or limited in scale and modality coverage. Annotation with large language models could scale them up, but its outputs cannot be regenerated exactly, which prevents others from re-deriving, extending, or auditing the resulting corpus. To address this, we release TimeCap, an open deterministic captioning pipeline with three reusable extractor tiers and a cross-channel synthes
zh_abstract: 在工业、环境，尤其是健康领域持续生成的时间序列数据会产生多模态信号，其规模和异质性使其处理和解读尤为具有挑战性。时间序列语言模型（Time-Series Language Models, TSLMs）有望对这些信号进行可扩展的解读，但仍受瓶颈制约：根本上缺乏以信号为基础、可复现，并可在不同模态和模式（schema）间扩展的文本标注时间序列对。现有的配对语料库要么封闭，要么在规模和模态覆盖上有限。使用大语言模型进行标注可以扩大其规模，但其输出无法被精确重新生成，这阻止了他人重新推导、扩展或审计所得语料库。为解决这一问题，我们发布 TimeCap，这是一个开放的确定性描述生成流水线，具有三个可复用的提取器层级和一个跨通道 synthes

zh_title: 双LLM共识流程记录Rett综合征治疗表型

abstract: Objective: Trofinetide, approved in 2023 as the first Rett syndrome treatment, lacks scalable real-world monitoring because chart review is labor-intensive. The pipeline filters notes by keyword, classifies each through two LLMs requiring consensus, and aggregates a patient-by-timepoint matrix. Architecture and prompt were selected on a diarrhea development set, then frozen and applied to the other 17 phenotypes with the phenotype definition substituted, as an out-of-sample test. The reported prompt comparison scores 183 expert-labeled cel

abstract: With people increasingly turning to AI chatbots for mental health support, the need to evaluate these tools is becoming more pressing. Recent benchmarks attempt to mimic a realistic setting by simulating multi-turn interactions with synthetic patients and evaluating them with an LLM-as-a-judge. However, the usefulness of these methods is limited because simulated patients can be overly forthcoming and self-reflective, and judgments typically involve opaque Likert scales with unclear practical utility. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MindEval2, an evaluation framework that consists of two components: Mental Health Quality Rubrics (MHQR), for evaluation, and MindSim, for patient simulation. For MHQR, we collaborate with PhD-level psychologists to develop a set of rubrics that break down response quality into explicit operational criteria that are more interpretable and actionable than e
zh_abstract: 随着人们越来越多地转向AI聊天机器人寻求心理健康支持，评估这些工具的需求变得更加迫切。最近的基准测试试图通过模拟与合成患者的多轮互动，并使用LLM作为评判者进行评估，来模仿现实环境。然而，这些方法的实用性有限，因为模拟患者可能过于主动和自省，而且判断通常涉及不透明的李克特量表，其实际效用不明确。为了弥合这些差距，我们引入了MindEval2，一个由两部分组成的评估框架：用于评估的心理健康质量评分标准（MHQR）和用于患者模拟的MindSim。对于MHQR，我们与博士级心理学家合作，开发了一套评分标准，将响应质量分解为明确的操作标准，这些标准比现有的更具可解释性和可操作性

We investigate two data-only poisoning attacks against protein design systems, targeting the pre-training corpus of autoregressive protein language models and the retrieval corpus of a text-guided protein generator. For the first, we pre-trained ProtGPT2 and ProGen2 variants of 300 million parameters, introducing poisoned protein sequences containing one of two triggers followed by one of three payloads. zh_abstract: 蛋白质基础模型日益支持生成新的生物序列，但它们对大型公共数据集的依赖为对抗性操纵其学习和检索的材料创造了机会。我们研究了两类仅针对数据的投毒攻击，攻击蛋白质设计系统，分别针对自回归蛋白质语言模型的预训练语料库以及文本引导蛋白质生成器的检索语料库。对于前者，我们预训练了 3 亿参数的 ProtGPT2 和 ProGen2 变体，引入包含两个触发器之一后接三个有效载荷之一的投毒蛋白质序列。在所有投毒运行中，两种架构在均匀和递增投毒计划下均获得了高度可靠的触发器依赖性生成。在递增暴露下，最早的多数激活仅发生在 200 个受污染示例之后，而对于

abstract: Accurate segmentation of tumors and organs-at-risk is essential for oncology but remains time-consuming and expertise-intensive. Existing AI systems often require manual spatial prompts or task-specific retraining, while generic class labels provide limited guidance for heterogeneous disease targets. Here we present SyRe, a text-prompted segmentation foundation model based on Synergistic vision-language Reinforcement, which strengthens bidirectional interaction between visual and linguistic representations. We introduce Color Region Description (CRD) to generate region-level semantic supervision and construct SyReData, comprising 20 million image-mask-description triplets across 9 modalities and 229 segmentation tasks. zh_abstract: 肿瘤和危及器官（organs-at-risk）的准确分割对肿瘤学至关重要，但仍然耗时且高度依赖专业知识。现有 AI 系统通常需要手动空间提示或任务特定的重新训练，而通用类别标签对异质性病变目标提供的指导有限。在此，我们提出 SyRe，一种基于协同视觉-语言强化（Synergistic vision-language Reinforcement）的文本提示分割基础模型，它增强了视觉与语言表示之间的双向交互。我们引入颜色区域描述（Color Region Description, CRD）以生成区域级语义监督，并构建 SyReData，其中包含跨 9 种模态和 229 个分割任务的 2000 万图像-掩码-描述三元组。使用多样化提示格式进行训练，可实现单目标、多目标和开放式分割，以及无效提示拒绝。SyRe 实现了准确的 se

abstract: Reliable evaluation of large language models in traditional Chinese medicine remains limited because existing benchmarks mainly focus on examination-style question answering or isolated generative tasks. We developed LingLanMedBench, a unified benchmark comprising 25,620 expert-verified items across 13 subtasks and five domains, covering knowledge, language understanding, information extraction, and diagnostic-therapeutic decision-making. LingLanMedBench standardizes task formats and evaluation metrics and further incorporates synonym-tolerant clinical-label matching, empirically derived hard subsets, and decision-recognition reformulations of open-ended clinical tasks. Fourteen open-source and proprietary models were evaluated under a standardized zero-shot protocol. Performance varied substantially across domains, model families, task formulations, and difficulty levels. The leading ov
zh_abstract: 对大型语言模型在中医药（traditional Chinese medicine）中的可靠评估仍然有限，因为现有基准主要集中于考试式问答或孤立的生成任务。我们开发了 LingLanMedBench，这是一个统一基准，包含跨 13 个子任务和五个领域的 25,620 个经专家验证的项目，涵盖知识、语言理解、信息抽取以及诊断-治疗决策。LingLanMedBench 标准化了任务格式和评估指标，并进一步纳入了同义词容忍的临床标签匹配、经验推导的困难子集，以及对开放式临床任务的决策识别重构。14 个开源和专有模型在标准化零样本协议下进行了评估。性能在不同领域、模型家族、任务表述和难度级别之间存在显著差异。领先的 ov

abstract: Infectious disease outbreaks often spread rapidly before signs of widespread transmission become apparent, leaving a big challenge for rapid response and effective intervention. However, current infectious-disease early-warning systems face three major challenges: fragmented epidemiological evidence across diverse surveillance sources, highly uneven data availability across diseases and geographic regions, and delayed warning procedure caused by manual data collection, analysis, and reporting. To address these challenges, we present EpiGuard, an autonomous, continually self-improving agentic platform for timely and reliable early warning of more than 50 infectious diseases across different regions. EpiGuard proactively monitors and captures newly released official surveillance records, using the latest available evidence for risk assessments. It dynamically adjusts its analytical strateg
zh_abstract: 传染病暴发往往在广泛传播的迹象变得明显之前就迅速扩散，这给快速响应和有效干预带来巨大挑战。然而，当前传染病早期预警系统面临三大挑战：来自不同监测来源的流行病学证据碎片化；不同疾病和地理区域之间的数据可得性高度不均衡；以及因人工数据收集、分析和报告导致的预警流程延迟。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 EpiGuard，一个自主、持续自我改进的智能体平台，用于对不同地区超过 50 种传染病进行及时可靠的早期预警。EpiGuard 主动监测并捕获最新发布的官方监测记录，使用最新可获得的证据进行风险评估。它动态调整其分析策略

abstract: Wrist-worn inertial measurement units (IMUs) provide a common sensing modality for tasks ranging from activity and gesture recognition to pose estimation, inertial odometry and clinical motor assessment. Existing wearable benchmarks evaluate performance across multiple tasks, but leave open how supervision for one task affects transfer to others and whether these tasks benefit from a shared representation. We present IMU-Bench, a benchmark of ten tasks from eight datasets for studying IMU multi-task performance and cross-task transfer. We compare six self-supervised methods pretrained on unlabeled recorded and simulated wrist motion, evaluating classification, pose and velocity estimation, and IMU-language retrieval. zh_abstract: 腕戴式惯性测量单元（IMUs）为从活动和手势识别到姿态估计、惯性里程计和临床运动评估等任务提供了一种常见传感模态。现有的可穿戴基准评估多个任务上的性能，但未阐明一个任务的监督如何影响向其他任务的迁移，以及这些任务是否能从共享表示中受益。我们提出 IMU-Bench，一个包含来自八个数据集的十个任务的基准，用于研究 IMU 多任务性能和跨任务迁移。我们比较了六种在未标注的记录和模拟腕部运动上预训练的自监督方法，评估分类、姿态与速度估计以及 IMU-语言检索。我们发现，我们的掩码自编码器 InrtlWrist 在十个任务中的九个上取得了最佳或并列最佳的冻结探针性能，且微调优于从头训练

abstract: Clinical reasoning LLMs need external medical knowledge, but retrieved evidence and reasoning chains can be outdated, poisoned, or hallucinated. Harmful knowledge can cause regression: changing a correct answer into an incorrect one. We construct a medical knowledge-poisoning benchmark covering retrieved evidence and reasoning chains, with seven attack families filtered by a three-judge "subtle-but-wrong" vote and paired clean exams that separate poisoning effects from question difficulty. No fixed knowledge-use strategy is robust across these settings: strong RAG methods trade robustness to poisoned evidence against accuracy when evidence is useful. title: Quantifying privacy risks in foundation model representations of brain MRI

abstract: Pretrained representations are increasingly used to share and reuse information from medical images without exposing the original scans, but it is unclear how much patient-specific information these representations retain. Under an attacker model with access to released embeddings, the corresponding public encoder, and auxiliary MRI scans, we evaluate patient linkage and sensitive-attribute inference. title: AI Scientists for Building Virtual-Cell Models

summary: 提出由自主智能体组成的 CellForge 系统，针对单细胞扰动数据自动调研文献、解析数据并生成可执行的模型假设与架构。

abstract: Autonomous agents, from virtual laboratories to biological data-analysis agents and co-scientists, have begun to turn scientific goals into hypotheses. Whether they can go further and convert real, noisy and complex biological data into executable model hypotheses and architectures that encode testable assumptions remains unclear. Predicting how cells respond to genetic and chemical perturbations is a natural test of this ability: it is central to decoding disease mechanisms and therapeutic discovery, yet it demands cross-disciplinary expertise rarely concentrated in a single research group. Here, we introduce CellForge, an organized team of autonomous agents for single-cell perturbation modeling. abstract: Catheter obstruction is the commonest cause of shunt failure; freehand insertion at Keen's point leaves the tip free in cerebrospinal fluid in only one case in ten. title: Toward Guarantees for Clinical Reasoning in Vision Language Models via Formal Verification

abstract: Skin tone classification is a fundamental task in computer vision, with applications in quantifying medical features, assessing demographic representativeness, and mitigating algorithmic bias. abstract: Deep unrolled models (DUM) have become the state-of-the-art for accelerated MRI reconstruction, yet their robustness under domain shift remains a critical barrier to clinical adoption. title: LLM-to-Flow Distillation: Teaching Natural Language Goals to Scientific Generators

abstract: Generative discovery in science requires coupling high-level scientific reasoning with the ability to generate samples respecting the structure of a design space. Yet these capabilities remain largely separated: foundation LLMs encode broad chemical and biological knowledge, while domain-specific flow- and diffusion-based generators capture the priors needed to produce valid sequences and geometries. We study how to align such scientific generators to high-level natural-language discovery goals without requiring an explicit proxy reward, which is often unavailable or poorly captured by learned predictors in experimental sciences. We introduce LLM-to-Flow Distillation (LFD), where a frozen LLM acts as an adaptive teacher for a domain-specific generator. Given a goal such as 'generate peptides with promising anticancer activity', the teacher constructs a curriculum of intermediate sub-goals aware of the flow's current capabilities, and progressively directs them toward the original discovery goal. At each round, the LLM judges sampled candidates under the current objective. These judgments induce preferences that are iteratively distilled into the generator through DPO. This procedure provides dense learning signals even when the initial model places negligible probability on designs satisfying the final goal, enabling adaptation toward poorly covered, out-of-distribution regions. Experiments on therapeutic peptides and small-molecule structure design demonstrate that LFD enables a new form of generative control: aligning arbitrary domain-specific scientific generators to scientific discovery tasks expressed via high-level natural-language goals.
zh_abstract: 科学中的生成式发现要求将高层次的科学推理与生成符合设计空间结构的样本的能力结合起来。然而，这些能力在很大程度上仍然彼此分离：基础LLM编码广泛的化学和生物学知识，而特定领域的流生成器和扩散生成器则捕获产生有效序列和几何结构所需的先验。我们研究如何在不要求显式代理奖励的情况下，将此类科学生成器与高层次自然语言发现目标对齐，而在实验科学中，这种显式代理奖励通常不可获得或无法由学习到的预测器很好地捕获。我们提出LLM到流蒸馏（LLM-to-Flow Distillation，LFD），其中冻结的LLM充当特定领域生成器的自适应教师。给定诸如“生成具有前景良好的抗癌活性的肽”这样的目标，教师构建一个了解流当前能力的中间子目标课程，并逐步将它们引向原始发现目标。在每一轮中，LLM根据当前目标评判采样得到的候选物。这些评判诱导出偏好，这些偏好通过DPO迭代蒸馏到生成器中。即使初始模型对满足最终目标的设计赋予可忽略的概率，该过程也能提供稠密的学习信号，从而能够适应覆盖较差的分布外区域。在治疗性肽和小分子结构设计上的实验表明，LFD实现了一种新形式的生成控制：将任意特定领域的科学生成器与通过高层次自然语言目标表达的科学发现任务对齐。

abstract: [Knee surgery, sports traumatology, arthroscopy : official journal of the ESSKA] Musculoskeletal care is being reshaped by population aging, multimorbidity, frailty, osteoporosis, sarcopenia, polypharmacy and increasing vulnerability to postoperative loss of independence. Artificial intelligence (AI) has entered orthopaedic research, but its clinical translation remains constrained. Many models address isolated diagnostic, imaging or short-term prediction tasks rather than the longitudinal care trajectories that determine outcomes in older musculoskeletal patients. The central limitation is therefore not simply whether older adults are represented in datasets, but whether AI systems are valid across the continuum of geriatric orthopaedic care. This review argues for a transition from task-specific orthopaedic AI toward continuum-of-care AI for the aging musculoskeletal patient. Upstream, radiomics, longitudinal osteoarthritis phenotyping, opportunistic computed tomography (CT)-based skeletal assessment and AI-augmented dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) modelling may improve prediction of disease progression, fracture risk, treatment failure and surgical timing. At the point of intervention, AI-assisted arthroplasty planning may help move total knee arthroplasty from generic alignment targets toward phenotype-specific reconstruction strategies that account for constitutional alignment, bone morphology, ligament envelope, neuromuscular control, frailty and functional reserve. Perioperatively, automated frailty and sarcopenia phenotyping, wearable gait analysis and multimodal temporal models integrating imaging, electronic health records, laboratory data, medications, patient-reported outcomes and wearable signals may support dynamic risk prediction. After discharge, continuous monitoring of mobility, sleep, pain trajectories, wound-related symptoms and rehabilitation adherence may help close the high-risk surveillance gap during the 90-day postoperative episode. However, clinical adoption requires more than high discrimination. Explainable AI should be understood as one component of a broader trust framework that also includes calibration, uncertainty quantification, decision-curve analysis, external and prospective validation, workflow integration, post-deployment monitoring and accountability. The future of orthopaedic AI is not simply better diagnosis or more precise surgery, but longitudinal, multimodal support across the full care continuum: predicting progression, selecting treatment, personalizing surgery, optimizing perioper
zh_abstract: [Knee surgery, sports traumatology, arthroscopy : official journal of the ESSKA] 肌肉骨骼护理正在被人口老龄化、多病共存、衰弱、骨质疏松、肌少症、多重用药以及术后独立性丧失易感性增加所重塑。人工智能（AI）已进入骨科研究，但其临床转化仍受限。许多模型处理孤立的诊断、影像或短期预测任务，而不是决定老年肌肉骨骼患者结局的纵向照护轨迹。因此，核心局限不只是老年人是否被纳入数据集，而是AI系统是否在老年骨科照护连续体上有效。本综述主张从任务特异性的骨科AI转向面向衰老肌肉骨骼患者的照护连续体AI。在上游，放射组学、纵向骨关节炎表型分析、机会性计算机断层扫描（CT）骨骼评估和AI增强的双能X线吸收测定法（DXA）建模可能改善对疾病进展、骨折风险、治疗失败和手术时机的预测。在干预时点，AI辅助的关节置换规划可能有助于将全膝关节置换术从通用对线目标转向考虑体质性对线、骨形态、韧带包膜、神经肌肉控制、衰弱和功能储备的表型特异性重建策略。围手术期，自动化衰弱和肌少症表型分析、可穿戴步态分析以及整合影像、电子健康记录、实验室数据、药物、患者报告结局和可穿戴信号的多模态时间模型可能支持动态风险预测。出院后，对活动能力、睡眠、疼痛轨迹、伤口相关症状和康复依从性的持续监测可能有助于弥合术后90天高风险期中的监测缺口。然而，临床采用需要的不仅仅是高判别力。可解释AI应被理解为更广泛信任框架的一个组成部分，该框架还包括校准、不确定性量化、决策曲线分析、外部和前瞻性验证、工作流程整合、部署后监测和问责。骨科AI的未来不只是更好的诊断或更精确的手术，而是贯穿整个照护连续体的纵向、多模态支持：预测进展、选择治疗、个性化手术、优化围手术

abstract: [Advances in clinical and experimental medicine : official organ Wroclaw Medical University] The expanding use of machine learning (ML) in clinical research has highlighted persistent methodological weaknesses that undermine the validity and interpretability of reported findings. Common issues include data leakage, inappropriate validation strategies, unstable model performance, and overinterpretation of predictive results. Importantly, strong predictive accuracy does not necessarily translate into clinical utility or biological insight, and poorly validated models may create a misleading impression of robustness. This editorial proposes a concise set of reporting guidelines to improve transparency, reproducibility, and the critical appraisal of ML-based analyses. The framework emphasizes key elements required for evaluation, including study objectives, data preprocessing, validation design, model development, performance assessment, and interpretation. Additional considerations address domain-specific challenges such as deep learning, missing data, and time-dependent structures. Rather than limiting methodological flexibility, these guidelines establish a minimal reporting standard that enables readers and reviewers to assess the credibility and generalizability of findings. By promoting clarity and completeness in reporting, they aim to reduce bias, improve reproducibility, and support the responsible integration of ML methods into clinical research.
zh_abstract: [《临床与实验医学进展：弗罗茨瓦夫医科大学官方刊物》（Advances in clinical and experimental medicine : official organ Wroclaw Medical University）] 机器学习（ML）在临床研究中日益广泛的应用，凸显了持续存在的方法学弱点，这些弱点会削弱所报告发现的有效性和可解释性。常见问题包括数据泄漏、不恰当的验证策略、不稳定的模型性能以及对预测结果的过度解读。重要的是，较高的预测准确性并不一定转化为临床效用或生物学洞见，而验证不佳的模型可能造成稳健性的误导性印象。这篇社论提出了一组简明的报告指南，以改善基于ML分析的透明度、可重复性和批判性评价。该框架强调评估所需的关键要素，包括研究目标、数据预处理、验证设计、模型开发、性能评估和解释。其他考虑事项涉及特定领域的挑战，例如深度学习、缺失数据和时间依赖结构。这些指南并非限制方法学灵活性，而是建立最低报告标准，使读者和审稿人能够评估发现的可信度和可推广性。通过促进报告的清晰性和完整性，它们旨在减少偏倚、提高可重复性，并支持将ML方法负责任地整合到临床研究中。

abstract: [Oral and maxillofacial surgery clinics of North America] Facial feminization surgery is central to gender-affirming craniofacial care, combining skeletal and soft tissue procedures that align facial appearance with gender identity and improve psychosocial well-being. Because the forehead, supraorbital rims, orbits, zygoma, nose, mandible, and chin strongly shape gender perception, careful planning is essential. Virtual surgical planning enables 3-dimensional analysis, simulation, patient communication, and safe transfer of the plan to the operating room. Artificial intelligence may automate segmentation, measurement, and parts of planning, while classifiers, morphing, and predictive shape models can help individualize feminization goals, constrained by surgical safety, patient autonomy, soft-tissue uncertainty, and surgeon judgment.

abstract: [Health science reports] Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is one of the most urgent global public health threats, especially in low- and middle-income countries. In 2019, bacterial AMR was estimated to have directly caused approximately 1.27 million deaths and to have been associated with 4.95 million deaths worldwide. Rapid identification of resistant infections is important, yet established diagnostics are very slow. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) has revolutionized microbiology and infectious disease diagnostics. This review explores the space of AI-enabled diagnostics for AMR detection and characterization. This literature review was conducted from January to September 2026 using PubMed/MEDLINE, Google Scholar, and other electronic databases with keywords including "AI," "AMR," "deep learning," "genomic diagnostics," and "point-of-care (POC) testing." Following screening and full-text assessment, 67 Peer-reviewed articles and systematic reviews were included to support the synthesis presented in the manuscript, while non-peer-reviewed articles and studies lacking direct AI relevance were excluded. Titles and abstracts were screened before full-text review. AI-enhanced diagnostics were reported to shorten turnaround time for AMR detection with promising but heterogeneous predictive performance; for example, pooled estimates across antimicrobial stewardship applications indicate an area under the curve of approximately 0.72. They also support improving antimicrobial stewardship and enable early therapeutic optimization in laboratory and POC settings, enabling real-time clinical decision-making. Despite these achievements, evidence for direct improvements in patient outcomes and routine bedside effectiveness remains limited. AI-driven diagnostic tools represent a promising strategy to bridge laboratory innovation and bedside application in combating AMR. The tools have the capacity to improve patient outcomes and enhance antimicrobial stewardship as they can accurately detect resistance patterns and support real-time clinical decisions. However, long-term sustainability, long-term success, and global impact can be achieved by continued validation, regulatory alignment, and equitable implementation across diverse healthcare settings.
zh_abstract: [Health science reports] 抗微生物药物耐药性（AMR）是最紧迫的全球公共卫生威胁之一，尤其是在低收入和中等收入国家。2019年，估计细菌性AMR直接导致约127万人死亡，并与全球495万人死亡相关。快速识别耐药感染很重要，然而现有诊断方法非常缓慢。近年来，人工智能（AI）已彻底改变微生物学和感染性疾病诊断。本综述探讨了用于AMR检测与表征的AI赋能诊断领域。本文献综述于2026年1月至9月进行，使用PubMed/MEDLINE、Google Scholar和其他电子数据库，关键词包括“AI”、“AMR”、“深度学习”、“基因组诊断”和“即时检测（POC）”等。经筛选和全文评估后，纳入67篇同行评审文章和系统综述，以支持手稿中呈现的综合分析；同时排除非同行评审文章以及缺乏直接AI相关性的研究。全文审查前先筛选标题和摘要。据报道，AI增强诊断可缩短AMR检测的周转时间，其预测性能有前景但不均一；例如，跨抗微生物药物管理应用的合并估计显示曲线下面积约为0.72。它们还支持改善抗微生物药物管理，并在实验室和POC环境中实现早期治疗优化，从而实现实时临床决策。尽管取得这些成就，但关于直接改善患者结局和常规床旁有效性的证据仍然有限。AI驱动的诊断工具构成了一种有前景的策略，可弥合抗击AMR中实验室创新与床旁应用之间的差距。这些工具有能力改善患者结局并增强抗微生物药物管理，因为它们能够准确检测耐药模式并支持实时临床决策。然而，长期可持续性、长期成功和全球影响可以通过持续验证、监管协调以及在不同医疗环境中的公平实施来实现。

title: AI-Assisted Instruction Versus Peer Learning for Sustained Lumbar Puncture Competency

summary: 注册临床试验比较AI智能模拟器、同伴互助与床旁教学对住院医师腰椎穿刺技能保持的效果。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Second Affiliated Hospital, Zhejiang University, School of Medicine; conditions: Lumbar Puncture; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 100; status: COMPLETED] This study compared three teaching methods for training resident physicians in lumbar puncture, a critical medical procedure used to collect spinal fluid for diagnosing conditions like meningitis. One hundred thirty-five residents were randomly assigned to either traditional bedside teaching, peer-assisted learning (where trainees practiced in pairs and gave each other feedback), or artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted training using a smart simulator that provided real-time voice feedback on technique. All residents were tested immediately after training and again three months later to see how well they retained their skills. Right after training, all three groups performed equally well. However, after three months, both the peer-learning and AI groups scored significantly higher on practical skills than the traditional group, showing that these newer methods help slow skill decay. The AI group showed the greatest advantages in procedural standardization, pre-procedure assessment, post-procedure care, and operating speed. Meanwhile, residents in the peer-learning group reported the highest satisfaction with classroom interaction and teaching methods. In short, while all three approaches work well for short-term training, AI-assisted and peer-assisted learning are more effective than traditional teaching at helping residents maintain their lumbar puncture skills over time, with AI excelling in technical precision and efficiency, and peer learning offering a more engaging and collaborative learning experience.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：浙江大学医学院附属第二医院；条件：腰椎穿刺；类型：干预性；分期：不适用；入组：100；状态：已完成] 本研究比较了三种培训住院医师进行腰椎穿刺的教学方法，腰椎穿刺是一种用于采集脊髓液以诊断脑膜炎等疾病的关键医疗操作。135名住院医师被随机分配到传统床旁教学、同伴辅助学习（受训者成对练习并互相给予反馈）或使用智能模拟器的人工智能（AI）辅助培训（该模拟器对技术提供实时语音反馈）。所有住院医师在培训后立即接受测试，并在三个月后再次测试，以了解他们保留技能的程度。培训后立即测试时，三组表现同样好。然而，三个月后，同伴学习组和AI组在实践技能上的得分均显著高于传统组，表明这些较新的方法有助于减缓技能衰退。AI组在操作标准化、操作前评估、操作后护理和操作速度方面表现出最大优势。与此同时，同伴学习组的住院医师对课堂互动和教学方法的满意度最高。简而言之，虽然这三种方法在短期培训中效果都很好，但AI辅助学习和同伴辅助学习在帮助住院医师随时间推移保持腰椎穿刺技能方面比传统教学更有效，其中AI在技术精准性和效率方面表现突出，而同伴学习提供了更具参与性和协作性的学习体验。

title: Artificial Intelligence-assisted Primary Care for Influenza Vaccination Among Chronic Patients in China (AIPC-Flu)
