abstract: A patient's pathology case spans tens of slides from distinct specimens and anatomical sites, each carrying non-redundant, site-specific evidence. Forming a patient-level conclusion therefore requires locating the slides relevant to a given question and integrating complementary findings across them. However, existing pathology agents analyze one slide at a time and describe morphology rather than measure it, leaving evidence acquisition across a patient's specimens and patient-level quantification underexplored. To address this gap, we propose PlanPath, an agentic framework for patient-level pathology visual question answering (VQA). PlanPath turns the question into an exploration plan that specifies the evidence required, routes to the slides likely to carry it, and drives coarse-to-fine acquisition from tissue architecture down to individual cells. zh_abstract: 一个患者的病理病例跨越来自不同标本和解剖部位的数十张切片，每张切片都承载着非冗余的、部位特异性的证据。因此，要形成患者层面的结论，就需要定位与给定问题相关的切片，并整合这些切片中的互补发现。然而，现有的病理学智能体（agent）一次只分析一张切片，并且是描述形态学而非对其进行测量，这使得跨患者标本的证据获取以及患者层面的量化仍未得到充分探索。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 PlanPath，一个用于患者层面病理学视觉问答（VQA）的智能体框架。PlanPath 将问题转化为一份探索计划，该计划明确规定所需的证据、路由到可能携带该证据的切片，并驱动从组织架构到单个细胞的由粗到细的获取。组织级和细胞级工具提供“

abstract: Jev has attracted considerable attention for its rapid, generalizable decision-making, yet its medical reliability remains under explored. To address this gap, our study compares various types of system-one decision models across 15 medical datasets comprising 8,742 instances under a unified protocol. abstract: We present a real-time, hybrid framework for occlusion handling and depth-aware tracking in minimally invasive surgeries (MIS). Occlusions caused by surgical instruments often obscure the region of interest (ROI), affecting surgical precision. To address this, our approach integrates enhanced You Only Look Once (YOLO) based detection, Particle Filtering (PF), and monocular depth estimation using Multiple Depth Estimation Accuracy with Single Network (MiDaS). Occlusion is detected using a distance-based threshold between instruments and ROI. Experimental results demonstrate robust instrument detection with a confidence score of 0.85, effective occlusion event handling, and accurate depth prediction with an MAE of 0.34 cm and RMSE of 0.53 cm. abstract: [Diabetes, metabolic syndrome and obesity : targets and therapy] As a typical chronic complication of diabetes, the management of diabetic foot ulcers has long faced multiple challenges, including the highly subjective nature of wound assessment, patients'limited capacity for self-care at home, and the difficulty in predicting healing outcomes. The emergence of artificial intelligence (AI) technology offers new approaches to addressing these challenges. Based on recent domestic and international literature, this paper systematically reviews the research progress of artificial intelligence in the care of diabetic foot ulcers, focusing on four key dimensions: intelligent wound assessment (eg deep learning-based image analysis models achieving an F1 score of 93.1% for infection identification and 92.8% accuracy for area assessment), patient self-health management (eg mobile health applications and wearable monitoring devices), the development and application of smart dressings (eg responsive biomaterials and sensor integration), and the prediction of healing trends (eg machine learning prediction models, with support vector machines achieving 85.3% accuracy and an AUC of 0.922 in predicting complete DFU healing). It summarizes key technological achievements and the current status of clinical translation, provides an in-depth analysis of existing shortcomings (including insufficient algorithm generalizability, lack of prospective clinical validation, and absence of data standardization), and outlines future development directions (encompassing multimodal integration, explainable artificial intelligence, and implementation science research), with the aim of offering guidance for the further application of artificial intelligence technology in the field of chronic wound care.
zh_abstract: [Diabetes, metabolic syndrome and obesity : targets and therapy] 作为糖尿病的一种典型慢性并发症，糖尿病足溃疡的管理长期以来面临多重挑战，包括伤口评估高度主观、患者居家自我护理能力有限，以及愈合结局难以预测。人工智能（AI）技术的出现为应对这些挑战提供了新途径。基于近期国内外文献，本文系统综述了人工智能在糖尿病足溃疡护理中的研究进展，聚焦四个关键维度：智能伤口评估（例如基于深度学习的图像分析模型在感染识别中达到93.1%的F1分数，在面积评估中达到92.8%的准确率）、患者自我健康管理（例如移动健康应用程序和可穿戴监测设备）、智能敷料的开发与应用（例如响应性生物材料和传感器集成），以及愈合趋势预测（例如机器学习预测模型，其中支持向量机在预测DFU完全愈合方面达到85.3%的准确率和0.922的AUC）。本文总结了关键技术成果和临床转化现状，深入分析了现有不足（包括算法泛化能力不足、缺乏前瞻性临床验证以及缺乏数据标准化），并概述了未来发展方向（涵盖多模态整合、可解释人工智能和实施科学研究），旨在为人工智能技术在慢性伤口护理领域的进一步应用提供指导。

abstract: [Aesthetic surgery journal] As artificial intelligence (AI) has become widely accessible, physicians and patients increasingly turn to AI for personal and professional uses. Whether or not you use AI in your practice, other physicians use it in ways that affect you and your patients, and so do cybercriminals. It is incumbent upon plastic surgeons and their staff to educate themselves about the potential advantages of AI, as well as potential medical and legal liabilities related to it. abstract: [Journal of the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons. Global research & reviews] The past decade has been marked by the progressive integration of artificial intelligence (AI), especially in the form of machine learning and deep learning. Pediatric orthopaedics remains an underexplored area in AI, especially in the context of congenital deformities such as clubfoot. A scoping review would help organize the various uses of AI in this domain by identifying studies and categorizing them based on the technique used and their applications, exposing gaps, and informing future studies to support AI integration in pediatric care. A Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses-based analysis was conducted, and several databases were used to scope for articles (MEDLINE, PubMed, Scopus, Google Scholar) using a set of keywords and mapped-out terms. A total of 16 studies met all eligibility criteria and were included in this review. These studies covered the use of AI, machine learning, or computational modeling over a broad range of objectives such as diagnosis, treatment, gait analysis, and prognostic modeling. AI is moving from promise to practice in clubfoot diagnosis, decision making, and even relapse detection. Indeed, across 16 studies, AI applied as different forms, such as deep learning classifiers and finite element models, shows potential to offer solutions to long-standing clinical challenges such as subjective assessments and variability in treatment.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons. Global research & reviews] 过去十年以人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）的逐步整合为标志，尤其是以机器学习和深度学习的形式。小儿骨科在人工智能领域仍是一个探索不足的领域，尤其是在诸如马蹄内翻足（clubfoot）等先天性畸形背景下。一项范围综述将有助于梳理人工智能在该领域的各种用途，通过识别研究并根据所用技术及其应用进行分类，揭示空白，并为未来研究提供信息，以支持人工智能在小儿骨科诊疗中的整合。进行了基于系统评价和Meta分析首选报告项目（Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses, PRISMA）的分析，并使用若干数据库（MEDLINE、PubMed、Scopus、Google Scholar）结合一组关键词和映射词表进行文章范围检索。共16项研究符合所有纳入标准并纳入本综述。这些研究涵盖了人工智能、机器学习或计算建模在诊断、治疗、步态分析和预后建模等广泛目标中的应用。在马蹄内翻足诊断、决策甚至复发检测中，人工智能正从前景走向实践。事实上，在16项研究中，以不同形式应用的人工智能，如深度学习分类器和有限元模型，显示出有潜力为长期存在的临床挑战提供解决方案，例如主观评估和治疗差异性。

abstract: [Infectious diseases & clinical microbiology] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly influencing healthcare, with growing relevance in infectious diseases and clinical microbiology. This review summarizes current applications of machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), and large language models (LLMs) in these areas while critically evaluating their strengths and limitations. Although AI has shown promising performance in image analysis, molecular diagnostics, risk prediction, and clinical decision support, its routine implementation remains constrained by limited external validation, heterogeneous datasets, algorithmic bias, and challenges in generalizability and explainability. The review also discusses AI's emerging role in scientific writing and the ethical and practical considerations associated with its clinical adoption. Overall, current evidence suggests that AI should be regarded as a complementary decision-support technology whose safe and effective integration depends on rigorous validation, high-quality data, and appropriate clinical oversight.
zh_abstract: 【传染病与临床微生物学】人工智能（AI）正日益影响医疗保健，在传染病与临床微生物学领域的相关性不断增强。本综述总结了机器学习（ML）、深度学习（DL）和大语言模型（LLMs）在这些领域的当前应用，同时对其优势与局限性进行了批判性评价。尽管AI在图像分析、分子诊断、风险预测和临床决策支持方面已表现出有前景的性能，但其常规实施仍受限于外部验证不足、数据集异质性、算法偏倚以及泛化性与可解释性方面的挑战。本综述还讨论了AI在科学写作中正在显现的作用，以及与其临床采用相关的伦理和实践考量。总体而言，当前证据提示，AI应被视为一种互补性的决策支持技术，其安全有效的整合取决于严格的验证、高质量的数据和适当的临床监督。

title: Artificial intelligence in biomedical visualization and education: a narrative review.
zh_title: AI在生物医学可视化与教育中的叙述性综述
summary: 叙述性综述梳理AI在生物医学可视化中的应用，涉及合成医学影像、视觉语言模型、三维重建与医学教育。
key_points: 检索2017至2026年文献
涵盖文生图与合成医学影像
关注医学教育与临床沟通
reason: 叙述性综述，无系统检索结论，综述上限档内偏低
abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Biomedical visualization increasingly spans traditional medical illustration, synthetic medical imaging, vision-language systems, and patient-specific 3D reconstruction. This narrative review examines applications of artificial intelligence (AI) across this field, with particular attention to medical education and scientific and clinical communication. We searched PubMed/MEDLINE and IEEE Xplore for English-language literature published from January 2017 through September 2026, supplemented by targeted searches of publisher databases and reference-list screening. Included publications addressed AI-enabled medical or anatomical illustration, text-to-image generation, synthetic medical imaging, vision-language models, 3D reconstruction, or immersive biomedical visualization. Current evidence indicates that diffusion models can rapidly generate visually persuasive and customizable drafts, whereas segmentation-guided synthesis and anatomy-aware 3D methods offer stronger structural control in defined tasks. However, direct evaluations of general-purpose text-to-image systems consistently identify fabricated anatomy, incorrect labels, prompt- and model-dependent variability, demographic bias, and limited reliability for complex structures or procedures. Vision-language models can support prompt refinement, annotation, and consistency checking, but they cannot ensure scientific accuracy and may evaluate flawed AI outputs more favorably than human experts. Evidence supporting AI-generated educational illustrations remains less mature than that supporting conventional 3D and virtual-reality learning environments. We therefore distinguish established applications from emerging or prospective uses and propose an expert-supervised workflow incorporating documented prompts and model versions, structure-specific validation, manual correction, and transparent disclosure. AI should currently be treated as a drafting and visualization aid, with domain-expert verification required before educational, clinical, or scientific use.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in public health] 生物医学可视化日益涵盖传统医学插图、合成医学成像、视觉-语言系统以及患者特异性3D重建。这篇叙述性综述考察人工智能（AI）在这一领域中的应用，特别关注医学教育以及科学和临床传播。我们检索了 PubMed/MEDLINE 和 IEEE Xplore 中2017年1月至2026年9月发表的英文文献，并以对出版商数据库的定向检索和参考文献列表筛查作为补充。纳入的出版物涉及AI赋能的医学或解剖学插图、文本到图像生成、合成医学成像、视觉-语言模型、3D重建或沉浸式生物医学可视化。当前证据表明，扩散模型可以快速生成在视觉上有说服力且可定制的草稿，而分割引导的合成和解剖结构感知的3D方法在特定任务中提供更强的结构控制。然而，对通用文本到图像系统的直接评估一致发现：虚构的解剖结构、错误标签、依赖于提示和模型的可变性、人口统计学偏倚，以及对复杂结构或操作可靠性有限。视觉-语言模型可以支持提示细化、注释和一致性检查，但它们无法确保科学准确性，并可能比人类专家更倾向于正面评价有缺陷的AI输出。支持AI生成教育插图的证据仍不如支持传统3D和虚拟现实学习环境的证据成熟。因此，我们区分已确立的应用与新兴或前瞻性用途，并提出一种专家监督的工作流程，纳入有记录的提示和模型版本、结构特异性验证、人工校正以及透明披露。目前应将AI视为起草和可视化辅助工具，在教育、临床或科学使用前需要领域专家验证。

title: Operationalizing clinical artificial intelligence through secure FHIR pipelines: a zero-trust cloud reference architecture for EHR interoperability.
zh_title: 基于安全FHIR管线的临床AI零信任云参考架构
summary: 理论文章提出以证据连续边界控制为核心、面向EHR互操作的零信任云参考架构，用于治理临床AI的数据与模型流转。
key_points: 指出FHIR仅标准化交换，未保证AI使用被授权与可问责
提出数据、模型或流程变更须有策略决策与版本化证据
归纳八项需求并组织为五个功能层
reason: 架构设想与理论推导，无实现或评估数据
abstract: [Frontiers in digital health] Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) standardizes clinical exchange but does not establish that a downstream artificial intelligence (AI) use remains authorized, semantically consistent, or accountable. This Hypothesis and Theory article proposes evidence-continuous boundary control: a material data, model, or workflow transition is governed by an applicable policy decision and linked to versioned evidence of its prerequisites, execution, and disposition. The framework arose from continuing healthcare-interoperability research and was formalized through standards analysis, targeted evidence synthesis, and explicit design inference. Documented revision searches distinguish external evidence from architectural decisions. Eight requirements are organized into five functional layers: clinical sources, an interoperability edge, a zero-trust control plane, a segregated cloud data and AI plane, and governance and monitoring. Applications are consumers, not a sixth layer. An illustrative adult readmission-risk workflow connects identity, policy, source versions, features, model release, scoring, presentation, and human action. Its symbolic FHIR R4 evidence linkage includes explicit R5 translation cautions and policy-aware authorization, including consent where applicable. Six propositions test incremental value against a well-run contemporary platform without removing its native safeguards; simulated ablations isolate particular links. Independent reference standards, denominators, support, counterevidence, and inconclusive conditions expose operational and human-factors trade-offs. A bounded synthetic-data companion implementation makes selected exchange controls inspectable; it does not implement the complete clinical-AI architecture or validate its propositions. No empirical architecture evaluation, patient dataset, clinical effectiveness, or independent expert validation is reported. Staged future studies must establish incremental benefit without disproportionate burden or inappropriate reliance.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in digital health] Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources（FHIR）规范了临床交换，但并未确立下游人工智能（AI）使用仍获授权、语义一致或可问责。这篇《假设与理论》文章提出证据连续性边界控制：实质性的数据、模型或工作流转换由适用的策略决策进行管控，并链接到其先决条件、执行和处置的版本化证据。该框架源于持续进行的医疗互操作性研究，并通过标准分析、针对性证据综合和明确的设计推断得以形式化。有记录的修订检索将外部证据与架构决策区分开。八项要求被组织为五个功能层：临床来源、互操作性边缘、零信任控制平面、隔离的云数据与 AI 平面，以及治理与监控。应用是消费者，而非第六层。一个示例性成人再入院风险工作流连接身份、策略、来源版本、特征、模型发布、评分、呈现和人工行动。其符号化 FHIR R4 证据链接包括明确的 R5 转换注意事项和策略感知授权，在适用时包括同意。六项命题在未移除其原生保障措施的情况下，测试相对于运行良好的当代平台的增量价值；模拟消融分离特定链接。独立参考标准、分母、支持、反证和不确定条件揭示运行和人为因素的权衡。一个有界的合成数据伴随实现使选定的交换控制可检查；它未实现完整的临床 AI 架构，也未验证其命题。未报告实证架构评估、患者数据集、临床有效性或独立专家验证。分阶段的未来研究必须在不造成不成比例负担或不适当依赖的情况下确立增量获益。

title: Human β defensin type 2 based novel antimicrobial peptide prediction using both molecular dynamics simulation and artificial intelligence methods.
zh_title: 分子动力学结合AI预测hBD-2衍生抗菌肽
summary: 研究设计32个hBD-2多位点突变体，结合既往247个点突变数据训练AI模型，预测其与SARS-CoV-2 RBD的结合稳定性与结合能。
key_points: 以hBD-2为骨架设计32个多位点突变体
结合既往247个点突变数据训练AI模型
预测突变体与RBD的结构稳定性与结合能
reason: 纯计算设计，样本仅数百突变体，无外部或湿实验验证，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in chemistry] The global health crisis triggered by SARS-CoV-2 has highlighted the urgent need for effective treatments. Although several anti-viral drugs targeting SARS-CoV-2 have been developed, there remains considerable interest in exploring natural antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) secreted by the human innate immune system as alternative therapeutic agents. Human β defensin type 2 (hBD-2) has been found to bind to the receptor-binding domain (RBD) of SARS-CoV-2 and block the virus entry. In order to design effective anti-virial drugs based on hBD-2, 32 block-mutants (mutation at more than one site simultaneously) were designed, and their interaction with RBD were predicted in terms of structural stability and binding energy. In combination with data from a total of 247 hBD-2 point-mutants reported in our previous work, artificial intelligence (AI) models were trained to design more efficient hBD-2 variants. With that, advanced AI approaches, including convolutional neural network (CNN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) models were employed to predict hBD-2 mutant sequences with potentially enhanced binding affinity with RBD compared with the wildtype peptide. Based on the predicted sequences, the AlphaFold program was applied to predict the structures of AMPs, and then all-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations were performed to calculate the binding interaction energies between each hBD-2-based AMP and the RBD as a measure of binding affinity. Structural stability was also evaluated through analyses of Root Mean Square Deviation (RMSD), Root Mean Squared Fluctuation (RMSF), the number of hydrogen bonds formed, and buried surface area. The results indicate that several AMPs exhibited more stable binding with RBD than the wildtype, highlighting their potential as novel hBD-2-derived antiviral candidates against SARS-CoV-2. Furthermore, based on the obtained results, the LSTM model demonstrated greater effectiveness than the CNN model in designing novel hBD-2-based anti-virial drugs against CoV-2.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in chemistry] 由 SARS-CoV-2 引发的全球卫生危机凸显了对有效治疗的迫切需求。尽管已开发出若干靶向 SARS-CoV-2 的抗病毒药物，但探索由人类先天免疫系统分泌的天然抗菌肽（AMPs）作为替代治疗剂仍有相当大的兴趣。已发现人β防御素2型（hBD-2）可结合 SARS-CoV-2 的受体结合域（RBD）并阻断病毒进入。为了基于 hBD-2 设计有效的抗病毒药物，设计了 32 个区块突变体（block-mutants，即同时在多个位点发生突变），并从结构稳定性和结合能方面预测了它们与 RBD 的相互作用。结合我们先前工作中报告的共 247 个 hBD-2 点突变体的数据，训练了人工智能（AI）模型以设计更有效的 hBD-2 变体。据此，采用包括卷积神经网络（CNN）和长短期记忆（LSTM）模型在内的先进 AI 方法，预测与野生型肽相比可能具有增强的 RBD 结合亲和力的 hBD-2 突变体序列。基于预测序列，应用 AlphaFold 程序预测 AMPs 的结构，然后进行全原子分子动力学（MD）模拟，计算每个基于 hBD-2 的 AMP 与 RBD 之间的结合相互作用能，作为结合亲和力的量度。还通过分析均方根偏差（RMSD）、均方根波动（RMSF）、形成的氢键数量和埋藏表面积来评估结构稳定性。结果表明，若干 AMPs 与 RBD 的结合比野生型更稳定，突显了它们作为针对 SARS-CoV-2 的新型 hBD-2 衍生抗病毒候选物的潜力。此外，基于所获得的结果，在设计针对 CoV-2 的新型基于 hBD-2 的抗病毒药物方面，LSTM 模型比 CNN 模型表现出更大的有效性。

title: Beyond binary dentistry: Should artificial intelligence think more like clinicians?
source: PubMed · European journal of oral sciences
zh_title: 超越二元牙科：AI是否应更像临床医生思考？
summary: 短评指出牙科AI多依赖离散二分类，未反映临床不确定性，建议以模糊逻辑等方式表达渐变状态。
key_points: 批评牙科AI的二分类范式
临床决策常在不完整信息下进行
建议用模糊逻辑表达不确定性
reason: 观点短文，无数据，仅概念倡议，属增量档
abstract: [European journal of oral sciences] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly influencing dental diagnosis and clinical decision-making, yet many AI systems continue to represent disease and treatment outcomes through discrete categories. Although binary classification has contributed substantially to diagnostic performance, it does not always reflect how clinicians reason in practice. Dental decisions are frequently made under incomplete information, biological variability, and competing clinical findings, requiring dentists to weigh probabilities, alternative explanations, and degrees of confidence rather than simply choosing between two outcomes. This short communication argues that future dental AI should better represent this inherent clinical uncertainty. Fuzzy logic provides one possible conceptual framework, allowing partial membership and graded states rather than forcing complex biological conditions into rigid categories. Its potential value in dentistry extends beyond computation: it may help AI communicate uncertainty in ways that are more consistent with clinical reasoning. Such systems could provide graded diagnostic confidence, competing possibilities, or degrees of treatment suitability, rather than presenting apparently definitive answers. This approach may also support explainability and reduce inappropriate reliance on algorithmic recommendations. The future of dental AI may therefore depend not only on improving predictive accuracy, but also on representing the grey zones in which much of clinical dentistry takes place.
zh_abstract: [European journal of oral sciences] 人工智能（AI）正日益影响口腔诊断与临床决策，但许多 AI 系统仍以离散类别来表示疾病和治疗结局。尽管二分类已对诊断性能做出了重大贡献，但它并不总能反映临床医生在实践中推理的方式。口腔决策常常是在信息不完整、生物学变异以及相互竞争的临床发现的情况下做出的，这要求牙医权衡概率、替代解释和置信程度，而不是简单地在两种结局之间做出选择。本简讯认为，未来的口腔 AI 应更好地表征这种固有的临床不确定性。模糊逻辑提供了一种可能的概念框架，允许部分隶属和分级状态，而不是将复杂的生物学状况强行归入僵化的类别。它在口腔医学中的潜在价值超越了计算本身：它可能有助于 AI 以更符合临床推理的方式传达不确定性。此类系统可以提供分级的诊断置信度、相互竞争的可能性或治疗适宜程度，而不是给出看似确定的答案。这种方法还可能支持可解释性，并减少对算法建议的不当依赖。因此，口腔 AI 的未来可能不仅取决于提高预测准确性，还取决于能否表征临床口腔医学大部分实践所处的灰色地带。

title: Precision surgical oncology for hepatocellular carcinoma.
zh_title: 肝细胞癌精准外科肿瘤学综述
summary: 一篇叙述性综述梳理分子免疫分型、影像组学、ctDNA、人工智能与数字病理在肝癌精准治疗中的角色。
key_points: 综述涵盖分子免疫分型、影像组学、ctDNA与AI
作者指出预后性能不等于临床效用
多数方法尚未充分验证用于常规治疗选择
reason: 叙述性综述，AI仅为其中一项，无新数据，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a heterogeneous tumor-liver-host disease in which treatment selection depends on tumor burden, liver function, portal hypertension, performance status, and patient preferences. Although hepatic resection and other established treatment modalities remain central to curative and disease-controlling strategies, emerging biological and digital technologies may provide additional information beyond conventional clinical assessment. However, their prognostic performance does not necessarily establish clinical utility, and many remain insufficiently validated for routine treatment selection. This narrative review examines the evolving role of precision-oriented approaches in HCC, including molecular and immune profiling, radiomics, circulating tumor DNA, artificial intelligence, and digital pathology. We classify these approaches into three evidence tiers: established clinical practice, investigational clinical tools, and future hypotheses. We then propose Precision Surgical Oncology as an author-developed, hypothesis-generating framework in which guideline-based assessment is followed by biological and host-risk refinement, multidisciplinary interpretation, individualized treatment within established therapeutic pathways, and longitudinal reassessment. Precision Surgical Oncology is intended to complement, rather than replace, evidence-based HCC management. Its future clinical value will depend on prospective validation, reproducibility, defined clinical actionability, equitable implementation, and demonstration of improved patient outcomes.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] 肝细胞癌（HCC）是一种异质性肿瘤-肝脏-宿主疾病，其治疗选择取决于肿瘤负荷、肝功能、门静脉高压、体能状态和患者偏好。尽管肝切除术和其他已确立的治疗方式仍是治愈性和疾病控制策略的核心，但新兴生物学和数字技术可能提供超出常规临床评估的额外信息。然而，它们的预后性能并不一定确立临床效用，许多方法仍未得到充分验证以用于常规治疗选择。这篇叙述性综述考察了精准导向方法在HCC中不断演变的作用，包括分子和免疫分析、影像组学、循环肿瘤DNA、人工智能和数字病理学。我们将这些方法分为三个证据层级：已确立的临床实践、研究性临床工具和未来假设。我们随后提出精准外科肿瘤学（Precision Surgical Oncology）作为一个由作者开发的、产生假设的框架，其中基于指南的评估之后进行生物学和宿主风险细化、多学科解读、在已确立的治疗路径内进行个体化治疗以及纵向再评估。精准外科肿瘤学旨在补充而非替代循证HCC管理。其未来临床价值将取决于前瞻性验证、可重复性、明确的临床可操作性、公平实施以及证明患者结局改善。

title: Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) in schizophrenia: enhancing transparency in clinical decision-making.
zh_title: 精神分裂症可解释AI辅助临床决策综述
summary: 该综述讨论可解释AI在精神分裂症神经影像与电生理数据中的应用，以提升临床决策透明度。
key_points: 精神分裂症诊断仍主要依赖DSM-5/ICD-11症状标准
涉及MRI/fMRI、DTI、PET、脑电等模态
强调需要客观生物标志物与决策支持
reason: 综述类，无原始数据或外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in systems biology] Schizophrenia is a chronic and severe psychiatric disorder affecting nearly 1% of the global population, characterized by positive symptoms such as hallucinations and delusions, negative symptoms including avolition and affective flattening, and cognitive impairments that compromise social and occupational functioning. Despite advances in psychiatry, diagnosis remains largely symptom-based, relying on criteria from the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM-5) and the International Classification of Diseases (ICD-11), highlighting the need for objective biomarkers and improved clinical decision support. Neuroimaging modalities, including structural and functional magnetic resonance imaging (MRI/fMRI), diffusion tensor imaging (DTI), positron emission tomography (PET), as well as electrophysiological techniques such as electroencephalography (EEG) and magnetoencephalography (MEG), have revealed abnormalities in brain connectivity, dopaminergic signaling, sensory processing, and network dysfunction associated with schizophrenia. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly machine learning (ML), have enabled prediction of diagnosis, treatment response, and relapse risk using multimodal clinical, neuroimaging, and genetic data. However, the "black-box" nature of many AI models limits transparency, interpretability, and clinician trust, restricting translation into practice. Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) addresses these challenges by providing interpretable, transparent, and clinically accountable models that support decision-making while preserving ethical and regulatory standards. By integrating explainable models with multimodal data, clinicians can use them as an adjunct for precision psychiatry, facilitating biomarker discovery, personalized treatment strategies, and trustworthy, actionable decisions, ultimately enhancing transparency and improving outcomes in schizophrenia care.

abstract: [Frontiers in nutrition] Unhealthy dietary patterns remain a major modifiable contributor to the global burden of obesity, type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), cardiovascular disease, and cancer. However, individuals can respond markedly differently to identical foods, limiting the effectiveness of one-size-fits-all dietary guidance. This review examines the application of artificial intelligence (AI) to personalized nutrition interventions across three interconnected layers. At the biological level, inter-individual variability can be characterized by three mechanistic dimensions: nutrigenomic variation, which influences nutrient metabolism and disease susceptibility; metabolomic biomarkers, which objectively capture dietary exposure and early metabolic alterations; and the gut microbiome, which bidirectionally mediates diet-host interactions. At the technological level, AI integrates these dimensions into multimodal digital profiles. Machine learning models predict individual postprandial glycemic and lipemic responses, with reported correlations of up to r = 0.77 in large cohorts; deep learning and computer vision automate dietary assessment; natural language processing and large language models (LLMs) support nutrition counseling; knowledge graphs enable constraint-aware food recommendations; and digital-twin and adaptive closed-loop systems incorporating continuous glucose monitoring and wearable-device data support real-time nutritional interventions. However, the strength of clinical evidence varies across disease domains. Glycemic management in T2DM and prediabetes currently has the most mature randomized controlled trial evidence: an AI-enabled personalized intervention combining algorithmic dietary personalization with CGM-linked feedback improved glycemic endpoints compared with a Mediterranean diet, while a fully automated AI-delivered diabetes prevention program achieved outcomes non-inferior to those of human coaching. In obesity, cardiovascular disease, oncology, and gastrointestinal disorders, the evidence remains mixed or preliminary. Clinical translation also faces substantial challenges, including biased and inconsistently standardized dietary and multi-omics data; the underrepresentation of non-European populations, which limits model generalizability and raises concerns about health equity; limited model explainability; privacy and data-governance challenges; immature regulatory pathways for adaptive software as a medical device; and specific risks associated with

title: Graph-Enhanced Disease Trajectory Discovery and Temporal Endpoint Forecasting from Longitudinal Electronic Health Records
zh_title: 基于纵向电子病历的图增强疾病轨迹发现与终点预测
summary: 在MIMIC-IV v3.1上构建图增强框架，先划分患者再建图，学习仅训练集内的连续住院转移，用于疾病轨迹发现与时间终点预测。

reason: 预印本，指标提升幅度有限且效果在部分时间窗反而变差
abstract: Longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) can reveal disease-progression structure, while useful forecasting requires leakage-controlled discovery, censor-aware outcomes, and inspectable trajectory evidence. We developed a graph-enhanced framework in MIMIC-IV v3.1 that splits patients before graph construction, learns train-only consecutive-admission transitions, and freezes endpoint-specific branching-motif policies selected on validation data. The final catalog contained 99,527 motifs, and a time-aware Transformer retrieved at most 24 patient-compatible motifs per endpoint through endpoint-specific cross-attention. Across five training seeds, micro-AUPRC increased from 0.9330 to 0.9357, while event-time MAE decreased from 676.9 to 657.7 days (reduction 19.2 days; 95% paired patient-cluster bootstrap CI, 13.8-24.8). Timing effects were heterogeneous: MAE worsened for events within 730 days but improved by 58.9 days for events occurring after 730 days. In an exploratory internal temporal split, branch conditioning reduced conditional event-time MAE by 26.9 days (95% CI, 23.0-30.8) without evidence of better micro-AUPRC. Corrected survival evaluation over the supported 0-2,555-day interval did not establish macro C-index or integrated Brier score superiority over a matched history-only discrete-hazard model. A directed, degree-matched GNN repair substantially improved unseen-edge discovery, yet replacing GNN-derived scores within fixed motif identities did not improve downstream forecasting. These results position branching motifs as structured trajectory context whose main value is long-range timing support rather than uniformly stronger endpoint discrimination, survival prediction, or causal explanation.
zh_abstract: 纵向电子健康记录（EHRs）能够揭示疾病进展结构，而有用的预测需要受泄漏控制的发现、删失感知的结局以及可检查的轨迹证据。我们在 MIMIC-IV v3.1 中开发了一个图增强框架，该框架在图构建之前拆分患者，学习仅基于训练集的连续入院转换，并冻结在验证数据上选择的端点特异性分支基序策略。最终目录包含 99,527 个基序，一个时间感知 Transformer 通过端点特异性交叉注意力为每个端点检索最多 24 个患者兼容基序。在五个训练种子中，micro-AUPRC 从 0.9330 增加到 0.9357，而事件时间 MAE 从 676.9 天降至 657.7 天（减少 19.2 天；95% 配对患者聚类 bootstrap CI，13.8-24.8）。时间效应具有异质性：对于 730 天内的事件，MAE 变差，但对于 730 天后发生的事件，MAE 改善了 58.9 天。在一项探索性内部时间拆分中，分支条件化将条件事件时间 MAE 降低了 26.9 天（95% CI，23.0-30.8），但没有证据表明 micro-AUPRC 更好。在支持的 0-2,555 天区间上进行的校正生存评估，未能确立其相对于匹配的仅历史离散风险模型在宏观 C-index 或积分 Brier 分数上的优越性。一种有向、度匹配的 GNN 修复显著改善了未见边发现，但在固定基序身份内替换 GNN 衍生分数并未改善下游预测。这些结果将分支基序定位为结构化轨迹背景，其主要价值是长程时间支持，而不是一致更强的端点判别、生存预测或因果解释。

title: Predicting Live Birth After Fresh Embryo Transfer in IVF/ICSI: Differential ICM/Trophectoderm Morphology Encoding and a Hybrid Attention--Logistic Regression Ensemble
zh_title: IVF新鲜胚胎移植活产预测：ICM/滋养层形态编码与注意力集成模型
summary: 单中心616例新鲜胚胎移植周期，提出ICM与滋养层差异化形态编码，并用混合注意力网络加逻辑回归集成预测活产。
key_points: 单中心616周期，251例活产、365例非活产
提出ICM与滋养层差异化加权形态编码
注意力网络与逻辑回归集成，无外部验证
reason: 单中心小样本回顾性建模，仅内部验证，属增量档
abstract: Predicting live birth before fresh embryo transfer could support shared decision-making in IVF/ICSI, but routine clinical data are small, heterogeneous, and contain pathway-dependent variables prone to outcome leakage. We aimed to construct a curated single-centre IVF/ICSI dataset and develop a prediction model suited to small tabular clinical data. \textit{Materials and Methods:} We assembled 616 fresh embryo-transfer cycles (251 live birth, 365 non-live birth) with clinical, laboratory, and embryological predictors, and embryo morphology encoded with a novel differential weighting of the inner cell mass and trophectoderm. After KNN imputation, robust scaling, and selection of 50 features, we developed a Hybrid Attention Network (HAN), a learnable feature-attention gate followed by a compact multilayer perceptron, and a HAN + logistic-regression (LR) ensemble with a validation-tuned weight. Models were benchmarked against classical machine learning, TabPFN, and text-serialized language models on a held-out test set; AUC-ROC was the primary metric. \textit{Results:} The HAN + LR ensemble achieved the highest test AUC-ROC (0.710; accuracy 0.710, F1 0.630), ahead of the HAN backbone alone (0.700), logistic regression (0.667), the TabPFN + LR hybrid (0.666), and TabPFN (0.650). Text-serialized language models performed near chance (AUC $\le$ 0.61). The differentially weighted trophectoderm feature ranked highest by consensus importance across models. \textit{Discussion:} A compact attention network combined with a linear model outperformed both components and strong foundation-model baselines on a small clinical cohort. \textit{Conclusion:} The curated dataset and HAN + LR ensemble offer a transparent, reproducible basis for IVF/ICSI live-birth prediction; external validation is the next step.
zh_abstract: 在新鲜胚胎移植前预测活产可支持IVF/ICSI中的共享决策，但常规临床数据规模小、异质性强，且包含易导致结局泄漏的路径依赖变量。我们旨在构建一个经整理的单中心IVF/ICSI数据集，并开发一种适用于小型表格临床数据的预测模型。【材料与方法】我们汇总了616个新鲜胚胎移植周期（251例活产，365例非活产），包含临床、实验室和胚胎学预测变量，并以一种新的对内细胞团和滋养层进行差异加权的方式编码胚胎形态。经过KNN插补、稳健缩放和选择50个特征后，我们开发了混合注意力网络（HAN），一种可学习的特征注意力门控后接紧凑多层感知机，以及带验证调优权重的HAN+逻辑回归（LR）集成模型。模型在留出测试集上与经典机器学习、TabPFN和文本序列化语言模型进行基准比较；AUC-ROC为主要指标。【结果】HAN+LR集成模型取得了最高测试AUC-ROC（0.710；准确率0.710，F1 0.630），优于单独的HAN骨干（0.700）、逻辑回归（0.667）、TabPFN+LR混合模型（0.666）和TabPFN（0.650）。文本序列化语言模型表现接近随机水平（AUC ≤ 0.61）。经差异加权的滋养层特征在跨模型的共识重要性中排名最高。【讨论】一个紧凑的注意力网络与线性模型结合，在一个小型临床队列上优于其两个组成部分以及强大的基础模型基线。【结论】该经整理数据集和HAN+LR集成模型为IVF/ICSI活产预测提供了透明、可重复的基础；外部验证是下一步。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Multimodal Neuroimaging Research on Depression: A Bibliometric Analysis.
zh_title: 抑郁症多模态神经影像AI研究的文献计量分析
summary: 基于Web of Science对2001-2025年1232篇文献做计量分析，描绘AI多模态抑郁症神经影像研究的演进与合作网络。

abstract: [Psychiatry investigation] To conduct a systematic bibliometric review of artificial intelligence (AI)-based multimodal neuroimaging research in depression, mapping its evolution, collaborative networks, and intellectual foundations to guide future translation. Records were retrieved from Web of Science Core Collection (search date: 1 September 2025) using terms for depression, neuroimaging modalities, and AI/machine learning (ML)/deep learning. English, peer-reviewed articles/reviews (2001-2025) were screened; 1,232 studies were retained after deduplication and filtering. Analyses included annual output trends, co-authorship networks (countries/institutions/authors), keyword co-occurrence clustering with burst detection, and co-citation/bibliographic coupling using VOSviewer (v1.6.20) and Bibliometrix (v4.5.1). Annual publications rose from <20/year to 202 in 2024; 2025 counts (n=173) reflect January-August only. The international network spans 42 countries/regions linked by 320 co-authorship ties (total link strength=1,228; density of approximately 0.37). USA, China, and the UK constitute the epistemic core, with expanding participation from India, Brazil, and Iran. Institutional and author overlays indicate a small-world, hierarchical organization (205 institutions; 10 collaboration communities; author network 168 researchers) characterized by a productive core and long tail. Six keyword clusters delineate a functional workflow: 1) biomarkers/phenotypes, 2) functional connectivity, 3) machine-learning/computational approaches, 4) multimodal/precision psychiatry, 5) diagnostic classification/algorithm development, and 6) structural imaging/comorbidity. Co-citation and coupling reveal a progression from early ML and connectivity foundations to deep/graph models, multimodal fusion, explainability, and treatment-oriented prediction. AI-based multimodal neuroimaging in depression has evolved into a coherent, translationally focused field. Current trends emphasize model validation, interpretability, and cross-site generalization, supported by expanding international collaboration. Future priorities include harmonized data sharing, explainable modeling, and theory-informed clinical translation.
zh_abstract: [Psychiatry investigation] 旨在对抑郁症中基于人工智能（AI）的多模态神经影像研究进行系统性文献计量学综述，描绘其演变、合作网络与知识基础，以指导未来的转化应用。从 Web of Science 核心合集（检索日期：2025年9月1日）检索记录，使用与抑郁症、神经影像模态以及 AI/机器学习（ML）/深度学习相关的检索词。筛选了英文同行评审的文章/综述（2001—2025年）；去重和过滤后保留1,232项研究。分析内容包括年度产出趋势、合著网络（国家/机构/作者）、带突现检测的关键词共现聚类，以及使用 VOSviewer（v1.6.20）和 Bibliometrix（v4.5.1）进行的共被引/文献耦合分析。年度发文量从每年<20篇上升至2024年的202篇；2025年的计数（n=173）仅涵盖1月至8月。该国际网络覆盖42个国家/地区，由320条合著联系相连（总联系强度=1,228；密度约为0.37）。美国、中国和英国构成知识核心，印度、巴西和伊朗的参与不断扩大。机构与作者叠加图谱显示其呈小世界、层级化组织（205个机构；10个合作团体；作者网络168位研究者），特征为高产核心与长尾。六个关键词聚类勾勒出一个功能性工作流程：1）生物标志物/表型，2）功能连接，3）机器学习/计算方法，4）多模态/精准精神病学，5）诊断分类/算法开发，6）结构影像/共病。共被引与耦合分析揭示了一条演进路径：从早期 ML 与连接性基础，发展到深度/图模型、多模态融合、可解释性以及面向治疗的预测。抑郁症中基于 AI 的多模态神经影像已发展成为一个连贯的、以转化为导向的领域。当前趋势强调模型验证、可解释性和跨站点泛化能力，并得到不断扩大的国际合作的支撑。未来的优先事项包括协调一致的数据共享、可解释建模以及以理论为依据的临床转化。

abstract: Seizure prediction and detection, essential for clinical treatment of epilepsy, remain the crucial task of this neurological disease. EEG and iEEG are widely used to analyze epilepsy due to its capability of capturing discriminative brain activities at high time resolution. Currently, most of the existing seizure prediction systems are single-modal in nature, which limits its application to a variety of clinical conditions. Therefore, a common framework to analyze seizures with both EEG and iEEG signals needs to be developed. This paper presents a new framework of multimodal seizure classification integrating the heterogeneous EEG and iEEG recording

abstract: Eye diseases are a major global cause of blindness and vision impairment, highlighting the need for accurate and early diagnosis to prevent further deterioration. Despite advances in medical imaging, classifying retinal diseases from fundus images remains challenging due to the complexity and subtlety of visual features. This study aims to develop and validate LightHybridNet, a novel lightweight hybrid deep learning framework, to improve the classification of eye diseases from fundus images. The model incorporates architectural features, such as depthwise separable convolutions and compound scaling mechanisms, to enhance diagnostic accuracy and robustness. To validate the model, the ODIR-5K dataset, comprising 8 disease categories, was used. To enhance image quality, pre-processing approaches were applied, including histogram equalisation, colour space conversion, and contrast adjustment

title: Learning Who Benefits Most: Multi-Treatment Causal Ranking for Population Health Stratification
zh_title: 多治疗因果排序用于人群健康分层
summary: 提出PROMETHEUS框架，将人群健康分层表述为多治疗因果排序问题，按预期增量获益对符合条件的患者-治疗机会排序，而非追求完全校准的个体疗效估计。
key_points: 以增量获益排序替代个体治疗效应精确估计
将每次护理强度提升与维持现有路径比较
跨患者与护理方案生成全局可比排序
reason: 预印本方法框架，摘要未提供实证验证结果
abstract: Population health stratification frameworks, such as the Italian DM77, organize patients by clinical need and care pathways but offer limited guidance on which care changes to prioritize under constrained resources. We present PROMETHEUS (Proactive Resource Optimization through Multi-treatment Effect-based Targeting in Healthcare Environments Using Stratification), a framework that formulates population health stratification as a multi-treatment causal ranking problem. Its objective is to order eligible patient-treatment opportunities by expected incremental benefit rather than obtain perfectly calibrated individual treatment-effect estimates. Each clinically admissible care intensification is compared with maintaining the patient's current pathway. Treatments are learned jointly to produce a globally comparable ranking across patients and care profiles, within domains sharing a reference condition, outcome, follow-up horizon, and benefit scale. This separates clinical need, treatment benefit, and resource-constrained allocation. PROMETHEUS combines doubly robust causal signals with a Siamese neural ranking model and contrastive representation pretraining. The shared representation captures similarities across care transitions, supporting prioritization under capacity constraints. Synthetic experiments and semi-synthetic experiments using real administrative covariates from ASL Benevento evaluate ranking quality, allocation value, robustness, and failure modes. The results support the framework's ability to recover generated benefit orderings and prioritize care opportunities in the evaluated settings. PROMETHEUS provides a preclinical approach to actionable stratification; validation with observed treatment-outcome data is required before clinical use.
zh_abstract: 人口健康分层框架，例如意大利 DM77，按临床需求和护理路径组织患者，但对于在资源受限下应优先进行哪些护理改变提供的指导有限。我们提出 PROMETHEUS（Proactive Resource Optimization through Multi-treatment Effect-based Targeting in Healthcare Environments Using Stratification），一个将人口健康分层表述为多治疗因果排序问题的框架。其目标是根据预期增量获益对符合条件的患者-治疗机会进行排序，而不是获得完全校准的个体治疗效果估计。每种临床可允许的护理强化都与维持患者当前路径进行比较。治疗被联合学习，以在共享参考状况、结局、随访时间和获益尺度的领域内，产生跨患者和护理特征的全局可比排序。这将临床需求、治疗获益和资源受限分配分开。PROMETHEUS 将双重稳健因果信号与孪生神经排序模型和对比表示预训练相结合。共享表示捕获护理转换之间的相似性，支持在容量约束下进行优先级排序。使用来自 ASL Benevento 的真实行政协变量的合成实验和半合成实验评估排序质量、分配价值、稳健性和失效模式。结果支持该框架在所评估设置中恢复生成的获益排序并优先考虑护理机会的能力。PROMETHEUS 为可操作分层提供了一种临床前方法；在临床使用前需要用观察到的治疗-结局数据进行验证。

title: Noisy-Label Calibration with Multiple Unreliable Labels
zh_title: 多不可靠标注下的噪声标签校准
summary: 针对医学标注与众包中多标注者标签可能出错的问题，提出在干净标签分布下评估与重校准二分类预测器的方法。
key_points: 提出噪声校正ECE（NC-ECE）分箱估计量
推导非渐近偏差界并估计未知噪声概率
给出基于损失与直方图的事后重校准方法
reason: 方法学预印本，医学标注仅为应用动机，属增量档
abstract: In medical annotation and crowdsourcing, multiple annotators assign labels to each example, but these labels may be incorrect. Treating such noisy labels as ground truth can bias calibration evaluation. To address this problem, we propose methods for evaluating and recalibrating a fixed binary predictor under the underlying clean-label distribution, using only noisy annotations. First, given annotator-specific noise probabilities, we propose Noise Corrected ECE (NC-ECE), a binned estimator of expected calibration error (ECE) under class-conditional noise. We derive non-asymptotic bounds on the estimator's bias. Then, we propose practical algorithms for estimating unknown noise probabilities under conditional independence and label-orientation assumptions. We also develop loss-based and histogram post-hoc recalibration with clean-risk and calibration guarantees, respectively. Experiments on semi-synthetic benchmarks show that the proposed ECE estimator closely tracks its clean-label oracle counterpart and that the recalibration methods substantially improve latent-label calibration, whereas uncorrected recalibration against noisy annotations can degrade it.
zh_abstract: 在医学标注与众包中，多个标注者为每个样本分配标签，但这些标签可能是错误的。将此类噪声标签视为真值会使校准评估产生偏差。为解决这一问题，我们提出了在潜在干净标签分布下，仅使用噪声标注来评估和重新校准一个固定二分类预测器的方法。首先，给定标注者特定的噪声概率，我们提出噪声校正 ECE（Noise Corrected ECE, NC-ECE），一种在类别条件噪声下对期望校准误差（ECE）的分箱估计器。我们推导了该估计器偏差的非渐近界。随后，我们提出在条件独立与标签方向假设下估计未知噪声概率的实用算法。我们还分别开发了基于损失的和基于直方图的事后重新校准方法，分别具有干净风险保证与校准保证。在半合成基准上的实验表明，所提出的 ECE 估计器密切跟踪其干净标签神谕（oracle）对应物，且这些重新校准方法大幅改善了潜在标签校准，而针对噪声标注的未校正重新校准则可能使其恶化。

title: BFHD: Bidirectional Feature Harmonization Decomposition for Heterogeneous Clinical Assessments
zh_title: BFHD：异构临床评估的双向特征调和分解
summary: 将跨中心、跨时间异构临床量表调和建模为测量级双向可恢复问题，提出带输出门控的分解框架。
key_points: 把调和定义为测量级双向可翻译性问题
框架强制双向耦合翻译并显式分解
在合成数据与真实临床评估对上实验
reason: 预印本方法学工作，验证限于合成与少量真实配对，属增量档
abstract: Clinical assessments are often collected using heterogeneous assessment systems across centers and time, leading to records that mix different but related sets of measurements. This motivates harmonization beyond total-score linking. We formulate clinical harmonization at the measurement level as a bidirectional recoverability problem: given paired observations from two assessment systems, the goal is to identify which measurements can be reliably translated in both directions within an application-defined tolerance, while separating non-translatable components. We propose Bidirectional Feature Harmonization Decomposition (BFHD), a feasibility-driven framework that enforces bidirectionally coupled translation and uses feature-wise output gating to produce an explicit decomposition in the original measurement space. Experiments on synthetic data and real clinical assessment pairs show that BFHD achieves broader feasible harmonization coverage and improved subset stability compared to baselines.
zh_abstract: 临床评估常在不同中心与不同时间使用异质的评估系统进行采集，导致记录中混合了不同但相关的测量集合。这促使我们需要超出总分连接（total-score linking）的协调（harmonization）。我们将测量层面的临床协调表述为一个双向可恢复性问题：给定来自两个评估系统的配对观测，目标是在应用所定义的容差内，识别哪些测量能够在两个方向上可靠地相互转换，同时分离出不可转换的成分。我们提出双向特征协调分解（Bidirectional Feature Harmonization Decomposition, BFHD），一个以可行性为驱动的框架，它强制施行双向耦合转换，并使用逐特征输出门控在原始测量空间中产生显式分解。在合成数据与真实临床评估配对上进行的实验表明，与基线相比，BFHD 实现了更广的可行协调覆盖范围并提高了子集稳定性。

summary: 叙述性综述梳理机器学习与深度学习从生物标志物、临床变量、认知量表与神经影像等多模态数据预测认知衰退与痴呆的主要方法。

abstract: [Journal of Alzheimer's disease reports] Population aging has increased the prevalence of neurodegenerative disorders associated with dementia, with Alzheimer's disease remaining the leading cause worldwide. Early identification of individuals at risk of cognitive decline, particularly those with mild cognitive impairment, remains a major clinical and scientific challenge. In this context, artificial intelligence has emerged as a promising framework for prognostic modeling and for the identification of clinically relevant predictors of disease onset and progression. This narrative review provides a theoretical and historical synthesis of the main machine learning and deep learning approaches used to predict cognitive decline and dementia from multimodal data, including biomarkers, clinical and demographic variables, cognitive measures, and neuroimaging markers. The review examines the methodological evolution of the field, from traditional statistical approaches to ensemble methods and deep neural architectures, and discusses the growing role of multimodal and longitudinal data integration. It also highlights major unresolved issues, including limited external validation, reduced interpretability, restricted generalizability, and the gap between predictive performance and clinical implementation. Overall, artificial intelligence has substantially advanced prediction research in cognitive decline and dementia, but its routine clinical adoption will depend on more rigorous validation, improved transparency, and stronger integration between neuroscience, clinical practice, and data science.

zh_abstract: 选择合适的医生是患者寻求医疗照护时的一项关键挑战。医生推荐系统能识别相关医生，但患者仍难以比较其个人资料以做出决定。我们提出列表呈现优化（slate presentation optimization）：给定患者的医疗病例和固定的、排好序的医生列表，我们生成简短的、针对病例的摘要，使医生更易于比较，同时仍以医生资料中的信息为依据。为了在不依赖真实患者交互的情况下优化医生呈现，我们开发了一个离线框架，使用以人物角色为条件的 LLM（persona-conditioned LLMs）来模拟患者选择。我们从每个医疗病例中提取的属性生成患者人物角色，并评估呈现内容的事实准确性、相关性、自然性和模拟患者选择。我们还使用第二个 LLM 评审器（LLM judge），其在 optimizati 期间未见

title: Per-Bundle, Pre-Reconstruction Inversion for Temporal CT: Flux-Compensation Design and Multi-Patient Generalization
zh_title: 时间CT逐束预重建反演：通量补偿与多患者泛化
summary: 预印本提出时间CT逐束反演框架，含无先验基线、通量补偿设计，以及在19例患者语料上训练的神经网络残差校正器。
key_points: SNN2高斯-牛顿估计器作为无先验基线
N0FC蝶形与管电流调制压缩通量动态范围
V8c残差校正器基于19例患者语料训练
reason: 方法预印本，仅19例患者、无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Paper 1 established the per-bundle statistical limits of Temporal CT (TCT) and benchmarked a learned prior on a single patient at a uniform incident count $N_0$. This paper lifts both restrictions. SNN2, a Gauss-Newton estimator, converges to the per-bundle Poisson maximum-likelihood solution and is the prior-free baseline. N$_0$FC, a bow-tie and tube-current-modulation co-design, compresses within-bundle photon-flux dynamic range. V8c is a neural-network residual corrector trained on a 19-patient corpus stratified by water-equivalent diameter (WED). T2bp, a per-patient empirical-Bayes post-processor, combines per-bundle Poisson likelihoods with a prior built from the patient's own bundles; it requires no training, so it cannot inherit a mismatched training prior. Results use Paper 1's bias-charged Dose Inflation Factor (DIF), extended to per-ray budgets. V8c beats SNN2 on in-distributio
zh_abstract: 论文 1 确立了时间 CT（Temporal CT, TCT）的每束统计极限，并在均匀入射计数 $N_0$ 下，对单个患者上的学习先验进行了基准测试。本文解除了这两项限制。SNN2 是一种高斯-牛顿估计器，收敛到每束泊松最大似然解，并且是无先验基线。N$_0$FC 是一种蝶形（bow-tie）与管电流调制（tube-current-modulation）的协同设计，压缩束内光子通量动态范围。V8c 是一个神经网络残差校正器，在按水等效直径（water-equivalent diameter, WED）分层的 19 名患者语料库上训练。T2bp 是一种逐患者经验贝叶斯后处理器，将每束泊松似然与由该患者自身束构建的先验相结合；它不需要训练，因此不能继承不匹配的训练先验。结果使用论文 1 的偏置加载剂量膨胀因子（bias-charged Dose Inflation Factor, DIF），并扩展到每射线预算。V8c 在分布内（in-distributio）优于 SNN2

By connecting insights across biological scales and modalities, Quine helps scientists computationally search a space far larger than intuition allows and prioritize hypotheses before they reach the lab. title: An AI-powered Virtual Reality Brief Intervention for Hospitalized Patients With Alcohol-Associated Liver Disease (SOBER-VR)

summary: 克利夫兰诊所注册一项1期试验，评估AI驱动的VR简短干预用于酒精相关肝病住院患者，计划入组30人且尚未招募。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: The Cleveland Clinic; conditions: Alcohol-associated Liver Disease; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: PHASE1; enrollment: 30; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Alcohol-associated liver disease (ALD) is a leading cause of preventable liver-related morbidity and mortality, with hospitalizations for ALD increasing significantly in recent years. Many patients with ALD and active alcohol use disorder (AUD) are discharged from the hospital without receiving evidence-based behavioral interventions, despite hospitalization representing a teachable moment when patients may be more motivated to change. Psychosocial support in this setting is often limited by short inpatient stays, provider shortages, and workflow barriers. Novel digital health approaches are needed to increase access to structured, personalized behavioral support during hospitalization. This project aims to assess the feasibility, usability, and clinical relevance of SOBER-VR, a virtual reality (VR) and artificial intelligence (AI)-powered digital therapeutic that delivers motivational interviewing (MI) to hospitalized patients with ALD and active alcohol use. SOBER-VR uses immersive VR to enhance emotional salience and a large language model (LLM)-driven conversational agent to simulate reflective, MI-consistent interactions. The intervention is brief (10-15 minutes), self-guided, and delivered using sanitized, standalone VR headsets with real-time support from trained staff. Using the NIH ORBIT Model for behavioral intervention development, this Phase Ib single-arm feasibility study will recruit 30 hospitalized patients with ALD and active alcohol use. Participants will use SOBER-VR during their inpatient stay and complete structured assessments post-discharge. The study will evaluate feasibility (recruitment, engagement, and retention), acceptability, usability, and safety of SOBER-VR. Preliminary signals of clinical impact, such as readiness to change, attitude to AUD treatment, among others, will also be explored.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：The Cleveland Clinic；疾病：酒精相关性肝病；类型：干预性；分期：1期；入组人数：30；状态：尚未开始招募] 酒精相关性肝病（ALD）是可预防的肝脏相关患病和死亡的主要原因之一，近年来因ALD住院的人数显著增加。许多ALD合并活动性酒精使用障碍（AUD）的患者出院时未接受基于证据的行为干预，尽管住院期代表一个可教育的时机，患者此时可能更有改变动机。在此情境下的心理社会支持常受限于住院时间短、医护人员短缺和工作流程障碍。需要新型数字健康方法来增加住院期间获得结构化、个性化行为支持的机会。本项目旨在评估SOBER-VR的可行性、可用性和临床相关性；SOBER-VR是一种由虚拟现实（VR）和人工智能（AI）驱动的数字疗法，可向因ALD且存在活动性饮酒而住院的患者提供动机式访谈（MI）。SOBER-VR使用沉浸式VR增强情绪显著性，并使用大语言模型（LLM）驱动的对话代理来模拟反思性的、符合MI的互动。该干预简短（10-15分钟）、自我引导，通过经消毒的独立VR头显实施，并由受过培训的工作人员提供实时支持。采用NIH ORBIT行为干预开发模型，这项Ib期单臂可行性研究将招募30名因ALD且存在活动性饮酒而住院的患者。参与者将在住院期间使用SOBER-VR，并在出院后完成结构化评估。该研究将评估SOBER-VR的可行性（招募、参与和留存）、可接受性、可用性和安全性。还将探索临床影响的初步信号，例如改变准备度、对AUD治疗的态度等。

zh_title: AI 心电图特征评估 STEMI 心肌再灌注研究
summary: 一项尚未招募的观察性研究拟结合 AI 心电图特征、冠脉造影参数与心脏影像，评估 STEMI 患者 PCI 后心肌再灌注。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Assiut University; conditions: ST Elevation (STEMI) Myocardial Infarction, Microvascular Obstruction (MVO); type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 90; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study aims to evaluate myocardial reperfusion in patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) undergoing primary percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI). Although primary PCI successfully restores blood flow in the blocked coronary artery, some patients continue to have impaired blood flow within the small vessels of the heart muscle, a condition known as microvascular obstruction (MVO). This complication may be associated with greater myocardial injury and poorer clinical outcomes. The study will investigate whether artificial intelligence (AI)-derived electrocardiographic (ECG) features, coronary angiographic parameters, and cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) findings can provide complementary information about myocardial reperfusion. Patients undergoing primary PCI will be assessed using ECG and angiographic findings, while CMR will be used to evaluate myocardial injury and microvascular obstruction. The main objective is to determine whether combining AI-derived ECG features and angiographic parameters can improve the prediction of CMR-detected microvascular obstruction after primary PCI. The findings may help identify patients at increased risk of impaired myocardial reperfusion and support future risk assessment strategies following STEMI.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：Assiut University；疾病：ST段抬高型（STEMI）心肌梗死、微血管阻塞（MVO）；类型：观察性；入组人数：90；状态：尚未招募] 本研究旨在评估接受直接经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）的ST段抬高型心肌梗死（STEMI）患者的心肌再灌注情况。尽管直接PCI成功恢复了阻塞冠状动脉的血流，但部分患者心肌小血管内的血流仍然受损，这种情况称为微血管阻塞（MVO）。这种并发症可能与更严重的心肌损伤和更差的临床结局相关。本研究将探讨人工智能（AI）衍生的心电图（ECG）特征、冠状动脉造影参数和心脏磁共振（CMR）检查结果能否提供关于心肌再灌注的补充信息。接受直接PCI的患者将使用ECG和血管造影结果进行评估，而CMR将用于评估心肌损伤和微血管阻塞。主要目的是确定结合AI衍生的ECG特征和血管造影参数能否改善对直接PCI后CMR检测到的微血管阻塞的预测。研究结果可能有助于识别心肌再灌注受损风险增加的患者，并支持STEMI后未来的风险评估策略。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Maltepe University; conditions: Nursing Education; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 34; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This quasi-experimental study aims to evaluate the multidimensional effects of an artificial intelligence-supported newborn simulation training program based on Kolb's Experiential Learning Theory on nursing students' self-efficacy, knowledge, health literacy, satisfaction, and confidence in learning. The study will be conducted with third-year nursing students at Maltepe University during the Fall semester. The design incorporates a single-group, three-time measurement model: pre-test (baseline before training), mid-test (after simulation observation/demonstration), and post-test (after individual application and reflection). The intervention spans a total of 12 weeks. Data will be collected using an introductory information form, the Multidimensional Assessment Scale for Assessment and Care of Newborns, and the Student Satisfaction and Self-Confidence in Learning Scale. Statistical analyses will include descriptive statistics, repeated measures ANOVA or Friedman tests, and correlation analyses.

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Gazi University; conditions: Minor Trauma Requiring Suturing, Pain, Anxiety; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 96; status: RECRUITING] Patients scheduled to undergo suturing for minor trauma in the emergency department frequently experience anticipatory pain and anxiety before the procedure. These experiences may negatively affect perceived pain, cooperation with treatment, adherence, satisfaction, and the overall care experience. However, the realities of emergency department practice, including crowding, high patient volume, staff shortages, and increased workload, may limit effective nurse-patient communication and comprehensive patient education. Patients awaiting suturing for minor trauma often experience uncertainty, prolonged waiting, fear of the procedure, and concern about pain. These factors may increase anxiety, which can further intensify pain perception and negatively influence patients' cooperation with treatment and satisfaction with care. Previous reports indicate that many patients waiting in emergency departments seek information about waiting times, care processes, and their medical conditions, highlighting a substantial need for accessible and reliable information. During this waiting period, patients may increasingly use artificial intelligence-based digital resources to obtain information about their health condition and the procedure they are about to undergo. However, information generated by artificial intelligence may be inaccurate, incomplete, or insufficiently tailored to the clinical context. Therefore, such information should be reviewed and validated by healthcare professionals before being provided to patients. This study aims to evaluate the effect of an artificial intelligence-assisted patient education material delivered during the pre-suturing waiting period on pain and anxiety levels among patients with minor trauma in the emergency department. It is also expected that the educational material developed within the scope of this study may contribute to patient education and supportive care in emergency department settings.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：Gazi University；疾病：需要缝合的轻微创伤、疼痛、焦虑；类型：INTERVENTIONAL；分期：NA；入组人数：96；状态：RECRUITING] 计划在急诊科因轻微创伤接受缝合的患者，常在操作前经历预期性疼痛和焦虑。这些体验可能对感知疼痛、治疗配合度、依从性、满意度以及整体照护体验产生负面影响。然而，急诊科实践的现实情况，包括拥挤、患者数量大、人员短缺和工作量增加，可能限制有效的护患沟通和全面的患者教育。等待因轻微创伤接受缝合的患者常经历不确定性、漫长等待、对操作的恐惧以及对疼痛的担忧。这些因素可能增加焦虑，而焦虑可进一步加剧疼痛感知，并对患者治疗配合度和照护满意度产生负面影响。既往报告表明，许多在急诊科等待的患者会寻求关于等待时间、照护流程及其医疗状况的信息，凸显出对可及且可靠信息的巨大需求。在这一等待期间，患者可能越来越多地使用基于人工智能的数字资源来获取有关其健康状况和即将接受操作的信息。然而，人工智能生成的信息可能不准确、不完整或未充分贴合临床情境。因此，此类信息在提供给患者前应由医疗专业人员审查和验证。本研究旨在评估在缝合前等待期间提供的AI辅助患者教育材料对急诊科轻微创伤患者疼痛和焦虑水平的影响。还预期本研究范围内开发的教育材料可能有助于急诊科环境中的患者教育和支持性照护。

abstract: Accurate and efficient analysis of dental radiographs has become increasingly important for disease diagnosis and clinical decision making. In particular, dental radiographs segmentation plays a critical role as it is challenging due to several reasons, such as low contrast, noise in the images, variations in the image quality, etc. Previous studies have primarily addressed these challenges using convolutional neural networks (CNN)-based models. Therefore, we mainly compared four segmentation models, including Pyramid Scene Parsing Network (PSPNet), DeepLabV3, UNet, and UNet++, through a fair, controlled experimentation setting under varying conditions such as image sizes and batch sizes. abstract: [Soins. Gerontologie] Dignity is a concept frequently invoked in bioethics, both in the literature and in practice. However, those who use the term rarely describe or define it, despite the word's multiple meanings. This article explores its various meanings, highlighting the relational context in which it is situated, whether it is attributed or intrinsic. The discussion focuses on the impact of AI-powered assistive robots, designed to combat isolation and loneliness, as well as on relationality and dignity in the broadest sense.
zh_abstract: [Soins. Gerontologie] 尊严是一个在生命伦理学文献和实践中经常被援引的概念。然而，尽管该词有多种含义，使用该词的人却很少描述或定义它。本文探讨其各种含义，强调其所处的关系性语境，无论它是被赋予的还是内在的。讨论聚焦于旨在对抗孤立和孤独的AI驱动辅助机器人的影响，以及最广义上的关系性和尊严。

abstract: Mixed methods research offers established strategies for integrating qualitative and quantitative evidence, but less guidance for integrating two computational representations of the same qualitative corpus. This methodological study introduces Parallel-Then-Integrated (PTI), a four-step procedure for explicit and traceable integration. We present PTI using 1,203 interview paragraphs from 29 mothers in Nepal. The two representations were ontology-guided Patient Voice (PV) coding with PVminer and data-driven themes generated through non-negative matrix factorization (NMF). A theme-complete crosswalk documented convergence, divergence, and preprocessing-sensitive differences. Depression status, based on Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) scores, served as a secondary external anchor for exploratory association checks.
